poetry_tang_0967c0bc.summary: A woman recalls her childhood romance and laments the loneliness of her husband's absence. Her steadfast devotion reveals a deep longing for reunion.

poetry_tang_5db1c985.title: Frontier Song I
poetry_tang_5db1c985.summary: Amidst the desolate frontier, veterans grow old in the dust. The poet warns the young against the hollow pride of romanticized martial glory.

poetry_tang_9c2cec60.title: Frontier Song II
poetry_tang_9c2cec60.summary: The biting frontier cold highlights the bleakness of ancient battlefields. Through images of bones and dust, the poet expresses pity for war's cruelty.

poetry_tang_aa0fca89.title: Remembering Cui Shaofu
poetry_tang_aa0fca89.summary: The serene moonlight evokes thoughts of a distant friend. Gazing toward the river, the poet laments their separation, revealing a lingering sense of longing.

poetry_tang_d640bc31.title: Spring Palace Tune
poetry_tang_d640bc31.summary: Spring blooms in the palace, contrasting the favorite's joy with the cold outside. The poem subtly captures the sorrow of a neglected woman.

poetry_tang_a874af0d.title: Changxin Lament II
poetry_tang_a874af0d.summary: A palace maid wanders at dawn, envying even the cold crows. This contrast evokes a lingering sense of abandonment and deep resentment.

poetry_tang_a0bbb523.title: Out of the Frontier
poetry_tang_a0bbb523.summary: A lonely fortress stands amidst yellow sands and white clouds. The hopelessness of the unreachable spring breeze captures the soldiers' profound isolation.

poetry_tang_7b90ed4c.title: Cicada
poetry_tang_7b90ed4c.summary: The poet uses the cicada to mirror his own integrity and drifting life. Its mournful cry highlights his steadfast character despite his hardships.

poetry_tang_b7325cd5.title: Han Stele
poetry_tang_b7325cd5.summary: This poem recounts Han Yu’s inscription for a military victory, praising the immortality of his prose. It concludes that while stone erodes, great literature endures.

poetry_tang_3efeb174.title: Wind and Rain
poetry_tang_3efeb174.summary: Amidst wind and rain, the poet drifts alone, lamenting the coldness of the world. His overwhelming sorrow remains unsoothed, leaving only bitterness.

poetry_tang_e0227556.title: To Linghu Langzhong
poetry_tang_e0227556.summary: Long separated from his friend, the poet sends a letter expressing his longing. Comparing himself to a sickly Sima Xiangru, he reveals his deep loneliness.

poetry_tang_d45159d6.title: Sui Palace
poetry_tang_d45159d6.summary: The Sui Palace lies in ruins, its past luxury vanished. The poet reflects on history, lamenting how a ruler's decadence inevitably leads to ruin.

poetry_tang_7ef8106e.title: Choubi Post
poetry_tang_7ef8106e.summary: Visiting the post where Zhuge Liang planned his campaigns, the poet laments that talent cannot always reverse fate. The hero's failure evokes profound regret.

poetry_tang_77b6146c.title: Untitled I
poetry_tang_77b6146c.summary: The poet recalls a joyful gathering, lamenting the loneliness of parting. The profound connection between hearts is ultimately overshadowed by the burden of official duties.

poetry_tang_cbad97ab.title: Untitled I
poetry_tang_cbad97ab.summary: The dream figure is elusive, and letters remain unfinished upon waking. Facing the unreachable distance, the poet is trapped in hopeless longing.

poetry_tang_5619c7cc.title: Untitled II
poetry_tang_5619c7cc.summary: Spring rain brings blooming flowers, yet triggers the poet's melancholy. He laments that love is like ashes, a futile consumption of the soul.

poetry_tang_6cc9442d.title: Falling Flowers
poetry_tang_6cc9442d.summary: Falling flowers dance in the sunset, and the poet cannot bear to sweep them away. It reflects pity for spring and sorrow over fleeting time.

poetry_tang_7cd0545b.title: Because of This
poetry_tang_7cd0545b.summary: Newlyweds are separated as the husband leaves for court. The poem satirizes how official life cruelly disrupts marital happiness.

poetry_tang_afc0b2da.title: Untitled
poetry_tang_afc0b2da.summary: Parting is difficult, and the poet uses the silkworm and candle to symbolize deep devotion. Despite the distance, he clings to hope for a message.

poetry_tang_d4e4aa94.title: Jade Pond
poetry_tang_d4e4aa94.summary: King Mu could not return to the Jade Pond despite his swift horses. The poem uses myth to lament life's transience and the loss of time.

poetry_tang_46fb1e20.title: Spring Rain
poetry_tang_46fb1e20.summary: In the spring rain, the poet is lonely, unable to reach his distant love. Dreams offer fleeting beauty, but waking brings only vast, empty skies.

poetry_tang_8820207b.title: Untitled II
poetry_tang_8820207b.summary: The poet dwells in solitude, reflecting on love as a fleeting dream. Though aware that longing is futile, he remains lost in a melancholic obsession.

poetry_tang_704db188.title: Jia Sheng
poetry_tang_704db188.summary: Using Emperor Wen's meeting with Jia Yi, the poet critiques rulers who ignore the people to discuss spirits. It conveys deep regret over wasted talent.

poetry_tang_928daf55.title: Cool Thoughts
poetry_tang_928daf55.summary: In the cool autumn night, the poet leans on the railing, awaiting news from afar. Dreams and reality blur, revealing the loneliness of a distant traveler.

poetry_tang_1c32f37f.title: North Qingluo
poetry_tang_1c32f37f.summary: Visiting a hermit monk amidst setting sun and falling leaves, the poet realizes the world is but dust. He finds inner peace, transcending love and hate.

poetry_tang_d56687e8.title: Red Cliff
poetry_tang_d56687e8.summary: A rusted halberd sparks reflections on the Battle of Red Cliff and historical fate. Without the eastern wind, the outcome would have been entirely different.

poetry_tang_134725bf.title: Night Thoughts at Zhangtai
poetry_tang_134725bf.summary: Amidst a bleak, rainy autumn night, the poet longs for a friend who never arrives. Watching geese fly south, he finds no way to send his sorrow.

poetry_tang_4e6d7d51.title: Jinling Painting
poetry_tang_4e6d7d51.summary: The painting depicts the desolate ruins of the Southern Dynasties. The poet laments that art captures the sorrowful essence of history's rise and fall.

poetry_tang_f5eb6197.title: Terrace City
poetry_tang_f5eb6197.summary: The ruins of Taicheng are desolate, yet the willows remain. The poet sighs that the glory of the six dynasties was a dream, witnessed only by indifferent nature.

poetry_tang_f8ed0afe.title: Farewell
poetry_tang_f8ed0afe.summary: The poet bids farewell to a frustrated friend, urging him to retire to the mountains. The tone conveys indifference toward worldly success and comfort in the friend's retreat.

poetry_tang_eb6f004a.title: Farewell to Qi Wuqian
poetry_tang_eb6f004a.summary: The poet sees off a friend who failed the exams, lamenting the hardships of officialdom. The imagery of a lonely village at sunset underscores the sorrow of parting and empathy for his friend.

poetry_tang_24c8feaa.title: Green Stream
poetry_tang_24c8feaa.summary: The poet wanders along the Green Stream, immersed in its serene beauty. Through descriptions of the water and pines, he reveals a tranquil, reclusive state of mind.

poetry_tang_6401ab47.title: Farming by Wei River
poetry_tang_6401ab47.summary: The poem depicts the peaceful life of a Wei River farm, showing a harmonious scene of herdsmen and farmers. It concludes with a longing for such rustic tranquility.

poetry_tang_17818512.title: Ode to Xishi
poetry_tang_17818512.summary: Using Xishi's rise from a washerwoman to a queen, the poet critiques the hypocrisy of social climbers. It ends with a warning against vain imitation, leaving a cold, critical impression.

poetry_tang_4f8eeab8.title: Ballad of the Old General
poetry_tang_4f8eeab8.summary: An old general recalls his past battlefield glory, lamenting his current unfulfilled ambitions. The poem blends heroic passion with the melancholy of an aging warrior.

poetry_tang_99b66256.title: Ballad of Peach Blossom Spring
poetry_tang_99b66256.summary: A fisherman discovers a hidden paradise, witnessing its serene beauty. When he fails to find it again, the poem leaves a sense of longing for a vanished ideal.

poetry_tang_3d1b8199.title: Ballad of Luoyang Maiden
poetry_tang_3d1b8199.summary: The poet contrasts the luxurious life of a Luoyang noblewoman with the plight of a poor washerwoman. This juxtaposition highlights the indifference of the world and social inequality.

poetry_tang_99d97ea9.title: To Pei Di at Wangchuan
poetry_tang_99d97ea9.summary: The poet depicts the quiet autumn scenery of Wangchuan. Through a drunken encounter with a friend, he conveys a sense of worldly detachment and leisure.

poetry_tang_d5834ee3.title: Replying to Zhang Shaofu
poetry_tang_d5834ee3.summary: The poet expresses a desire for reclusion in his later years. By answering with a fisherman's song, he reveals an open-minded attitude toward life's successes and failures.

poetry_tang_c7e2c856.title: Farewell to Li of Zizhou
poetry_tang_c7e2c856.summary: The poem describes the deep mountain rain and local customs of Shu. In bidding farewell, the poet offers his sincere expectations for the friend's governance.

poetry_tang_12688ff9.title: Passing Xiangji Temple
poetry_tang_12688ff9.summary: The poet ventures deep into the mountains to find an ancient temple. Amidst the cold, serene landscape, he experiences the meditative power of Buddhist practice.

poetry_tang_b23fc883.title: Southern Mountains Retreat
poetry_tang_b23fc883.summary: Wandering through the mountains, the poet finds enlightenment where the water ends and clouds rise. It reflects a state of spontaneous ease and detachment.

poetry_tang_4e6c1ef0.title: Returning to Songshan
poetry_tang_4e6c1ef0.summary: Leaving office to return to Songshan, the poet finds solace in the twilight journey. It captures his longing for the peace and belonging of reclusion.

poetry_tang_3f245d08.title: Zhongnan Mountain
poetry_tang_3f245d08.summary: Gazing at Mount Zhongnan, the poet describes the shifting mists before asking a woodcutter for directions, highlighting the mountain's vast and mysterious nature.

poetry_tang_89015506.title: Boating on Han River
poetry_tang_89015506.summary: Boating on the Han River, the poet is captivated by the magnificent landscape. He eventually finds himself lost in the beauty of Xiangyang's scenery.

poetry_tang_3095131c.title: Imperial Poem: Spring View
poetry_tang_3095131c.summary: The poet follows the imperial carriage through a rainy, blooming palace garden. He shifts focus from scenery to duty, emphasizing his administrative purpose over mere leisure.

poetry_tang_973f61b8.title: Morning Audience at Daming Palace
poetry_tang_973f61b8.summary: The poem depicts the majestic morning audience at Daming Palace with officials gathering in awe. It concludes with the poet’s graceful departure after fulfilling his courtly duties.

poetry_tang_dc7a8d6f.title: Replying to Guo Jishi
poetry_tang_dc7a8d6f.summary: The poet describes the quiet, routine life within the palace and laments his growing age. He expresses a desire to retire from office, responding to his friend's inquiry.

poetry_tang_f2490452.title: Rain at Wangchuan Estate
poetry_tang_f2490452.summary: After rain, the Wangchuan estate is tranquil and lush with rural life. The poet finds peace in nature, reflecting a desire to detach from worldly conflicts.

poetry_tang_4a6bdd0d.title: Miscellaneous Poems II
poetry_tang_4a6bdd0d.summary: The poet asks a traveler from his hometown about the plum blossoms. These simple lines convey a profound and poignant longing for his distant home.

poetry_tang_065dfd1c.title: Song of Weicheng
poetry_tang_065dfd1c.summary: A light morning rain refreshes the willows in Weicheng. The poet urges his friend to share a final drink, highlighting the sorrow of impending separation.

poetry_tang_10067969.title: Ascending Leyou Plain
poetry_tang_10067969.summary: Self-deprecatingly calling himself inept, the poet yearns for a quiet life. Gazing at the Zhaoling Mausoleum before leaving, he is filled with historical reflection.

poetry_tang_b653bb5e.title: Farewell I
poetry_tang_b653bb5e.summary: The poet praises a young girl's beauty, comparing her to a budding flower. He concludes that no one in the bustling city can match her charm.

poetry_tang_5b9c8905.title: Farewell II
poetry_tang_5b9c8905.summary: The poet forces a smile to bid farewell, yet his inner sorrow mirrors the weeping candle. This profound grief lingers through the sleepless night.

poetry_tang_2b9b22fc.title: Expressing My Feelings
poetry_tang_2b9b22fc.summary: Reflecting on his dissipated years in Yangzhou, the poet laments that his decade of indulgence was but a fleeting dream. He is left with only a reputation for fickleness and lingering regret.

poetry_tang_795c31a3.title: Staying Overnight
poetry_tang_795c31a3.summary: A lonely traveler in an inn finds his longing for home stirred by a cold lamp and wild geese. Waking to the misty river, he is left with a profound sense of solitude.

poetry_tang_b11c1431.title: Palace Ladies' Song
poetry_tang_b11c1431.summary: Listening to music from the palace, a neglected lady laments her lost favor while still young. She sits alone by the incense burner until dawn, consumed by sorrow.

poetry_tang_f5b44153.title: Moonlight Thoughts on Separation
poetry_tang_f5b44153.summary: In a time of war, brothers are scattered and displaced across the land. Watching the moon, they share the same tearful longing for their separated kin.

poetry_tang_db7d7ad5.title: Autumn Ascent, Lan Mountain
poetry_tang_db7d7ad5.summary: Ascending a mountain, the poet is moved by the autumn scenery to miss his friend. He looks forward to a reunion, turning his solitude into a hopeful anticipation.

poetry_tang_5923ae1e.title: Summer Thoughts, Southern Pavilion
poetry_tang_5923ae1e.summary: On a cool summer night, the poet enjoys the scenery but feels lonely without a companion. This solitude sparks a deep, dream-filled longing for his friend.

poetry_tang_8652a87f.title: Overnight Stay, Waiting
poetry_tang_8652a87f.summary: As night falls over the silent mountains, the poet waits alone under the pines for his friend. The failure to arrive leaves him in a quiet, melancholy state.

poetry_tang_a7cbf9d8.title: Song of Returning Home
poetry_tang_a7cbf9d8.summary: The poet leaves a noisy ferry to retreat to the mountains. The moonlit forest offers a sense of serene detachment.

poetry_tang_ce70f4b4.title: Autumn Feelings, Qinzhong
poetry_tang_ce70f4b4.summary: Living abroad, the poet misses his mentor due to poverty. The autumn wind and cicadas evoke deep sorrow over unfulfilled ambitions.

poetry_tang_d0a7d86e.title: Overnight, Tonglu River
poetry_tang_d0a7d86e.summary: Aboard a boat, the poet sheds tears for distant friends amid lonely cries of apes. The bleak night highlights his profound homesickness.

poetry_tang_987ef2ee.title: Early Cold, River Thoughts
poetry_tang_987ef2ee.summary: Cold winds blow over the river as the poet gazes toward his distant home. The vast, misty water stirs a sense of aimless wandering.

poetry_tang_57239cfe.title: Farewell to Wang Wei
poetry_tang_57239cfe.summary: With no career prospects, the poet chooses to retreat home. His departure reflects a lonely resignation over the scarcity of true friends.

poetry_tang_0848d128.title: Qingming Feast, Daoist Mei's
poetry_tang_0848d128.summary: During Qingming, the poet visits a Daoist's home to admire spring. The ethereal setting inspires a longing for immortality and seclusion.

poetry_tang_8957767f.title: Ascending Xian Mountain
poetry_tang_8957767f.summary: Climbing the mountain, the group reflects on the passage of time. Reading the ancient monument leaves the poet moved to tears.

poetry_tang_74aa34fb.title: Year End Return
poetry_tang_74aa34fb.summary: Disillusioned by his career, the poet returns to his mountain home. The year-end moonlight shining through his window mirrors his lonely heart.

poetry_tang_c6dca9ce.title: New Year's Eve Thoughts
poetry_tang_c6dca9ce.summary: On New Year's Eve, the traveler faces snow and a lonely lamp in a foreign land. He feels the ache of distance from family, ending in a melancholic reflection on his wandering life.

poetry_tang_a5aefc4f.title: Lizhou Southern Crossing
poetry_tang_a5aefc4f.summary: The poem depicts the tranquil Lizhou ferry with birds in flight. It turns toward a desire to emulate Fan Li, leaving the reader with a sense of detachment from worldly affairs.

poetry_tang_9badd482.title: Jade Lute Lament
poetry_tang_9badd482.summary: Sleepless on a cool bed, the speaker watches the moon and passing geese. The scene evokes a deep, quiet loneliness and the lingering sorrow of a long-distance longing.

poetry_tang_01dd58a9.title: Seeing Off Eastbound Traveler
poetry_tang_01dd58a9.summary: Amidst autumn leaves, the poet bids farewell to a friend departing by boat. The scene shifts to the vast river, leaving a sense of longing for a future reunion.

poetry_tang_9e15bff0.title: Su Wu's Temple
poetry_tang_9e15bff0.summary: Visiting Su Wu's temple, the poet laments the hero's lost years and changing times. It leaves a heavy feeling of historical sorrow and the futility of worldly ambition.

poetry_five_dynasties_19563968.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian I
poetry_five_dynasties_19563968.summary: A woman slowly dresses, her beauty reflected in mirrors alongside embroidered birds. The scene captures intimate domesticity, subtly hinting at an underlying loneliness.

poetry_five_dynasties_5b7c2455.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian II
poetry_five_dynasties_5b7c2455.summary: Warmth inside contrasts with the misty, moonlit river scene outside. The poem blends dream and reality, leaving a lingering sense of delicate, melancholic beauty.

poetry_five_dynasties_08025d0b.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian III
poetry_five_dynasties_08025d0b.summary: A woman behind a screen hides her sorrow despite her elegant appearance. The contrast between blooming flowers and her unspoken heart leaves a poignant, lingering sadness.

poetry_five_dynasties_50c1df69.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian IV
poetry_five_dynasties_50c1df69.summary: Spring blossoms bloom by the pond, yet the lady's smile hides deep sorrow. The beautiful scene contrasts with the lack of news from afar, leaving a lingering melancholy.

poetry_five_dynasties_3b175c0e.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian V
poetry_five_dynasties_3b175c0e.summary: Apricot blossoms glisten with dew as morning orioles wake the dreamer. She dresses before the mirror, but the sweet spring dream fades, leaving only faint sadness.

poetry_five_dynasties_33c1a178.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian VI
poetry_five_dynasties_33c1a178.summary: Parting under the moon, the sound of the traveler's horse fades away. Candles melt like tears, and as flowers fall, the dreamer wakes to profound loneliness.

poetry_five_dynasties_fe3f8901.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian VII
poetry_five_dynasties_fe3f8901.summary: Peonies bloom after rain while the lady adorns herself. She gazes from the tower in vain, and the return of swallows only deepens her longing.

poetry_five_dynasties_8192b36c.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian VIII
poetry_five_dynasties_8192b36c.summary: Flowers fade and birds cease singing under the moonlight. Sleepless and lonely by the dim lamp, she weeps as the spring slips away.

poetry_five_dynasties_97ecdb76.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian IX
poetry_five_dynasties_97ecdb76.summary: Pear blossoms shine like snow, yet mountains separate her from her beloved. Swallows return, but he does not, leaving her embroidered robes stained with tears.

poetry_five_dynasties_a233a697.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian X
poetry_five_dynasties_a233a697.summary: Gazing at distant mountains through spring rain and willow mist. News remains absent, and as grass spreads across the horizon, her deep feelings go unshared.

poetry_five_dynasties_0037b7ac.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian XI
poetry_five_dynasties_0037b7ac.summary: After the Qingming rain, the setting sun illuminates fallen petals. The lady leans silently against the door at dusk, consumed by profound loneliness and sorrow.

poetry_five_dynasties_0378c8c9.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian XII
poetry_five_dynasties_0378c8c9.summary: In the quiet moonlit chamber, a woman removes her makeup. Memories fade like falling petals, leaving behind only lingering sorrow.

poetry_five_dynasties_55e9b684.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian XIII
poetry_five_dynasties_55e9b684.summary: Amidst spring rain, the woman dreams of past happiness. Gazing from the bridge, her longing turns into deep, soul-crushing melancholy.

poetry_five_dynasties_d1a67444.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian XIV
poetry_five_dynasties_d1a67444.summary: Bamboo shadows dance in the cold moonlight as the woman reflects on her sorrow. Thoughts of her distant homeland bring tears to her eyes.

poetry_five_dynasties_04033fad.title: Water Clock Song I
poetry_five_dynasties_04033fad.summary: Spring rain and the water clock mark a lonely night. Her secret dream of a lover remains unknown, leaving only deep regret.

poetry_five_dynasties_ee23c049.title: Water Clock Song II
poetry_five_dynasties_ee23c049.summary: As spring fades with the setting moon, she leans alone against the railing. Past joys feel like a dream, leaving endless, unfillable longing.

poetry_five_dynasties_0129614e.title: Water Clock, Part 3
poetry_five_dynasties_0129614e.summary: A brief, tender meeting leaves hearts intertwined like melting wax. Waking to a cold bed, she is left with only the fading night.

poetry_five_dynasties_4f9603ed.title: Water Clock, Part 4
poetry_five_dynasties_4f9603ed.summary: Rare meetings fuel long-lasting yearning behind green curtains. As the moon shines and dawn approaches, her anticipation turns to profound despair.

poetry_five_dynasties_af32ba05.title: Water Clock, Part 5
poetry_five_dynasties_af32ba05.summary: The mournful horn sounds from the tower as geese fly away. Watching the departing sails, she faces the dawn with a heavy heart.

poetry_five_dynasties_aae874bb.title: Return Home: Fragrant Jade
poetry_five_dynasties_aae874bb.summary: Fragrant Jade wakes amid dying candles. It captures her sorrowful morning thoughts.

poetry_five_dynasties_7dade2d7.title: Return Home: Double Cheeks
poetry_five_dynasties_7dade2d7.summary: Bright cheeks and fluttering robes. The verse depicts her morning indolence with deep tenderness.

poetry_five_dynasties_ddde69e8.title: Wine Spring: Flowers Reflecting Willows
poetry_five_dynasties_ddde69e8.summary: Rain over the pond. Shifting to loneliness, it leaves an echo of void.

poetry_five_dynasties_40c6ee90.title: Wine Spring: Sun on Gauze Window
poetry_five_dynasties_40c6ee90.summary: Sunlight on gauze and spring grief. Gazing afar brings longing and sorrow.

poetry_five_dynasties_3255effe.title: Wine Spring: Chu Maid Unreturned
poetry_five_dynasties_3255effe.summary: Spring waters and a lone tower. Yearning for a traveler, it leaves deep heartbreak.

poetry_five_dynasties_c52c1596.title: Wine Spring: Ribbon with Scent
poetry_five_dynasties_c52c1596.summary: Fragrant ribbons and red beans. Reminiscing over the past, it leaves profound heartbreak.

poetry_five_dynasties_1fa54ba3.title: Pacifying the West: Envoy's Farewell
poetry_five_dynasties_1fa54ba3.summary: Parting in snow. Shifting to unreturned travelers, flute notes seal eternal sorrow.

poetry_five_dynasties_1dae22ea.title: Pacifying the West: Swallow Prepares to Fly
poetry_five_dynasties_1dae22ea.summary: Swallows and spring hues. It portrays a decorated chamber under the bright moon.

poetry_five_dynasties_ee82979d.title: Pacifying the West: Rain, Oriole, Spring
poetry_five_dynasties_ee82979d.summary: In late spring rain, a woman gazes in her mirror, longing for a distant lover. The scarcity of wild geese deepens her sorrow.

poetry_five_dynasties_88f78e41.title: Willow Branch: Longest Strips
poetry_five_dynasties_88f78e41.summary: Willow branches sway gracefully by the palace, mirroring a dancer's waist. The sight of spring water by the bridge intensifies the traveler's heartbreak.

poetry_five_dynasties_6e1d5a38.title: Willow Branch: South Palace Wall East
poetry_five_dynasties_6e1d5a38.summary: Golden willows and blooming apricots line the imperial road. This vibrant spring scenery only serves to sharpen the traveler's sense of loss.

poetry_five_dynasties_16f8001e.title: Willow Branch: Su Xiao's Willows
poetry_five_dynasties_16f8001e.summary: Willows drape over Su Xiao’s bridge as the spring breeze stirs. Behind closed gates, the scene captures a sense of quiet, lonely beauty.

poetry_five_dynasties_e2cb7b07.title: Willow Branch: Golden Threads
poetry_five_dynasties_e2cb7b07.summary: Golden willow threads drape over palace tiles, evoking hidden sorrows. Rain-drenched branches brushing against railings heighten the atmosphere of imperial melancholy.

poetry_five_dynasties_e7ecee2d.title: Willow Branch: Guanwa Palace West
poetry_five_dynasties_e7ecee2d.summary: Willows by the palace reflect passing sails. They symbolize the traveler's urgent desire to return, overshadowing the lush grass of spring.

poetry_five_dynasties_e938fa05.title: Willow Branch: Two Yellow Orioles
poetry_five_dynasties_e938fa05.summary: Orioles sing amidst the willow branches. The delicate, thread-like leaves stir the restless heart of the wanderer far from home.

poetry_five_dynasties_e1f7f59b.title: Willow Branch: Imperial Willows
poetry_five_dynasties_e1f7f59b.summary: Imperial willows frame the palace windows in a scene of elegance. A woman completes her makeup, waiting in the morning breeze with anticipation.

poetry_five_dynasties_a5f32373.title: Willow Branch: Oriole by Loom
poetry_five_dynasties_a5f32373.summary: A weaver pauses her loom to mourn her distant husband amidst oriole songs. The desolate frontier spring leaves her feeling profound loneliness.

poetry_five_dynasties_c9fd9bef.title: Southern Song: Golden Parrot in Hand
poetry_five_dynasties_c9fd9bef.summary: A girl holding a golden parrot secretly admires a man. She longs to marry him and live as a devoted pair.

poetry_five_dynasties_56ab9887.title: Southern Song: Willow Like Silk
poetry_five_dynasties_56ab9887.summary: Amidst willow branches, a beauty watches the bustling city streets from her curtain. She follows the scented carriage, yearning for romance.

poetry_five_dynasties_f32eec5d.title: Southern Song: Loose Hairpin
poetry_five_dynasties_f32eec5d.summary: A woman dresses with care but remains haggard from constant longing. The blooming flowers only deepen her sense of sorrowful isolation.

poetry_five_dynasties_d84dc590.title: Southern Song: Fine Golden Glow
poetry_five_dynasties_d84dc590.summary: A beautifully adorned woman rests on her pillow, moved by the orioles. The birds' song behind the curtain evokes deep longing for him.

poetry_five_dynasties_9e104db1.title: Southern Song: Pollen Dusting

poetry_song_160501c1.summary: The poet visits Jinling's ruins, lamenting the lost glory of the Southern Dynasties. Facing desolate walls and returning swallows, a profound sense of historical transience lingers.

poetry_song_d842efd0.title: Elegant Chamber Grievance
poetry_song_d842efd0.summary: Revisiting old haunts, the poet recalls a past parting. Confronted by change, his sorrow transforms into uncontrollable tears.

poetry_song_759cd9d1.title: Worshipping Stars and Moon
poetry_song_759cd9d1.summary: The poet encounters a beauty by moonlight, feeling as if meeting a celestial being. Yet the dream fades, leaving him in a lonely inn with only the sound of autumn insects.

poetry_song_04c354b6.title: General Yu-chi's Cup
poetry_song_04c354b6.summary: Wandering through river outposts, the poet recalls past joys in the capital. In the lonely night, only his dreams can bridge the distance to his beloved.

poetry_song_790c805d.title: Butterflies Adore Flowers
poetry_song_790c805d.summary: Moonlight wakes the poet, signaling an imminent departure that leaves his pillow damp with tears. Holding hands in the cold wind, they share a moment of profound reluctance.

poetry_song_cb09a778.title: Night-Flying Magpie
poetry_song_cb09a778.summary: After a farewell at the river bridge, the poet returns alone through the cold night. Revisitng the site, he finds only weeds and sunset, deepening his sense of loss.

poetry_song_3319c42b.title: Frontier River Command
poetry_song_3319c42b.summary: On a cold, silent autumn night, the poet sits alone by a lamp, unable to sleep. Waking from wine, he faces the endless, lonely night.

poetry_pre-qin_85954cbe.title: Creeping Mallow
poetry_pre-qin_85954cbe.summary: Creeping mallows grow in the valley as a woman harvests them to weave cloth. Her desire to return home to her parents reflects simple filial piety and domestic life.

poetry_pre-qin_6a126eb5.title: Rolling Ears
poetry_pre-qin_6a126eb5.summary: A woman picking herbs thinks of her traveling husband, drinking to ease her sorrow and leaving a lingering ache.

poetry_pre-qin_0a1105db.title: Intertwined Trees
poetry_pre-qin_0a1105db.summary: Lush trees entangled with vines bless a noble family with endless prosperity and peace, radiating joy and harmony.

poetry_pre-qin_f7ecc5cb.title: Locusts
poetry_pre-qin_f7ecc5cb.summary: Locusts flutter and gather in abundance, praising a flourishing lineage with many descendants. It radiates vitality.

poetry_pre-qin_b3eac971.title: Rabbit Snare
poetry_pre-qin_b3eac971.summary: Brave warriors set nets to guard their lords, praised as the nation's steadfast shield and loyal defenders.

poetry_pre-qin_19baa80a.title: Plantain
poetry_pre-qin_19baa80a.summary: Women joyfully gather plantain herbs, sharing the simple delight of harvest. It leaves a rustic, happy feeling.

poetry_pre-qin_3c314553.title: Han River's Breadth
poetry_pre-qin_3c314553.summary: A man gazes at the wide Han River, longing for a maiden he cannot reach, leaving a poignant ache of unattainability.

poetry_pre-qin_d5c825eb.title: Ru River Embankment
poetry_pre-qin_d5c825eb.summary: A wife misses her husband by the river, and their reunion brings solace despite hard times, showing deep devotion.

poetry_pre-qin_40a15df6.title: Unicorn's Hoof
poetry_pre-qin_40a15df6.summary: Praising the unicorn's auspicious body parts to bless the noble sons, leaving a mood of great reverence and hope.

poetry_pre-qin_bce5f0bb.title: Magpie's Nest
poetry_pre-qin_bce5f0bb.summary: The poem uses the magpie's nest as a metaphor for a bride moving into her new home amidst a grand procession. This imagery evokes a sense of solemnity and joy.

poetry_pre-qin_c5bc5581.title: Gathering Mugwort
poetry_pre-qin_c5bc5581.summary: A woman gathers mugwort by the water for ancestral rites. Her diligent labor reflects a deep sense of piety and respect for ritual traditions.

poetry_pre-qin_a4b2f8e9.title: Grass Insects
poetry_pre-qin_a4b2f8e9.summary: A woman gathers wild greens while longing for her lover, her heart heavy with anxiety. Upon their reunion, her distress transforms into peace and relief.

poetry_pre-qin_5f912b69.title: Gathering Duckweed
poetry_pre-qin_5f912b69.summary: A young woman gathers aquatic plants to prepare offerings for the ancestral temple. The poem captures a serene, solemn atmosphere of religious devotion.

poetry_pre-qin_f19a4ae8.title: Sweet Pear Tree
poetry_pre-qin_f19a4ae8.summary: People protect the pear tree where Duke Zhao once rested, refusing to cut it down. This reverence expresses the public's deep affection for a virtuous leader.

poetry_pre-qin_f247825c.title: Dew on the Road
poetry_pre-qin_f247825c.summary: Facing coercive pressure, a woman firmly rejects an unwanted marriage proposal. Her defiance reveals a courageous spirit determined to preserve her personal dignity.

poetry_pre-qin_38f16563.title: Lambs
poetry_pre-qin_38f16563.summary: The poet describes an official's lambskin robes to praise his composed and dignified demeanor. This portrait highlights the grace of an upright gentleman.

poetry_pre-qin_d2be374b.title: Rumbling Thunder
poetry_pre-qin_d2be374b.summary: Amidst rumbling thunder, a noble man remains far from home, unable to rest. The poem is filled with longing, expressing a heartfelt wish for his safe return.

poetry_pre-qin_f6d07fec.title: Plum Trees
poetry_pre-qin_f6d07fec.summary: A woman watches plums fall, urgently wishing for a suitor to claim her. The poem captures the anxious longing of youth.

poetry_pre-qin_f8324d7d.title: Little Star
poetry_pre-qin_f8324d7d.summary: Officials toil under starlight, lamenting their unequal fate. The contrast between their labor and the elite's ease evokes deep melancholy.

poetry_pre-qin_c616ff53.title: River's Tributary
poetry_pre-qin_c616ff53.summary: A spurned woman wanders by the river, moving from resentment to self-consolation. Her final song reflects a resilient sense of dignity.

poetry_pre-qin_132cfb3f.title: Dead Elk in Wild
poetry_pre-qin_132cfb3f.summary: A hunter uses game wrapped in white grass to woo a girl, who responds with shy caution. It depicts the innocence of wild romance.

poetry_pre-qin_7e3a56e3.title: How Beautiful They Are
poetry_pre-qin_7e3a56e3.summary: The poet admires the magnificent carriage of a royal bride, reflecting on her noble lineage. It conveys awe and envy for the grand wedding.

poetry_pre-qin_6825e16a.title: Royal Hunting
poetry_pre-qin_6825e16a.summary: A hunter hits multiple targets with one shot, displaying immense skill. The poem praises the virtuous beast Zouyu, creating a harmonious scene.

poetry_pre-qin_9c16fd01.title: Cypress Boat
poetry_pre-qin_9c16fd01.summary: The poet suffers in isolation, finding no comfort from others, yet remains firm in spirit. This struggle reveals a noble, unyielding character.

poetry_pre-qin_8d4fdd70.title: Green Robe
poetry_pre-qin_8d4fdd70.summary: A husband sees a green robe and is overcome with grief for his late wife. The garment becomes a vessel for his enduring sorrow.

poetry_pre-qin_38f4bcdc.title: Swallows
poetry_pre-qin_38f4bcdc.summary: Bidding farewell to a departing friend with tears. Mourning separation while cherishing virtue leaves deep sorrow.

poetry_pre-qin_6f5c0f3c.title: Sun and Moon
poetry_pre-qin_6f5c0f3c.summary: Rebuking fickle love under the sun and moon. Betrayed trust leaves a profound feeling of heartbreak.

poetry_pre-qin_f6f23821.title: Whirlwind
poetry_pre-qin_f6f23821.summary: Yearning for an unfaithful lover through violent winds. Sleepless nights filled with thunder leave lingering grief.

poetry_pre-qin_b0baab0a.title: Beat the Drums
poetry_pre-qin_b0baab0a.summary: Drums force a soldier into distant war, breaking marriage vows. Separation and hardship leave profound despair.

poetry_pre-qin_6778252d.title: Southern Wind
poetry_pre-qin_6778252d.summary: Gentle winds blow over thorns, praising a mother's toil. Unfilial children unable to comfort her leave sorrow.

poetry_pre-qin_0bac919d.title: Pheasants
poetry_pre-qin_0bac919d.summary: Flying pheasants spark longing for an absent husband. Distance and blocked paths leave an aching heart.

poetry_pre-qin_16c15dea.title: Bitter Gourd Leaves
poetry_pre-qin_16c15dea.summary: Facing deep waters and calling geese, awaiting a lover. Loyal patience leaves a hopeful, yearning atmosphere.

poetry_pre-qin_78ed9316.title: Valley Wind
poetry_pre-qin_78ed9316.summary: An abandoned wife recounts past hardships and betrayal. Cruel rejection leaves bitter resentment and grief.

poetry_pre-qin_0444e70b.title: Returning Home
poetry_pre-qin_0444e70b.summary: As dusk falls, the laborer yearns to return home. They lament that only for the lord's sake do they endure the dew and mud.

poetry_pre-qin_8cdce7ff.title: Mound of Hair
poetry_pre-qin_8cdce7ff.summary: A woman rebukes officials for their delay and indifference to duty. She feels abandoned, leaving a sense of deep resentment and helplessness.

poetry_pre-qin_1b68e1d7.title: Simply
poetry_pre-qin_1b68e1d7.summary: The poet admires the dancer's vigor before shifting to thoughts of a distant, virtuous person. It expresses a longing for talent.

poetry_pre-qin_21387ca2.title: Spring Water
poetry_pre-qin_21387ca2.summary: A married woman misses her homeland and family, seeking solace in travel. The poem conveys profound homesickness and a desire to return.

poetry_pre-qin_1af03b6d.title: North Gate
poetry_pre-qin_1af03b6d.summary: An official struggles under heavy duties and domestic criticism. Blaming fate for his misery, he expresses deep despair and resignation.

poetry_pre-qin_221ca160.title: North Wind
poetry_pre-qin_221ca160.summary: Amidst biting winds and snow, the poet urges a loved one to flee together. It captures a sense of urgency and shared devotion.

poetry_pre-qin_4a5fa506.title: New Terrace
poetry_pre-qin_4a5fa506.summary: Duke Xuan of Wei builds a terrace to seize his daughter-in-law, leading to a shameful tragedy. The poem is a biting satire of corruption.

poetry_pre-qin_0555bf37.title: Two Sons in Boat
poetry_pre-qin_0555bf37.summary: Two brothers sail away, leaving the poet anxious for their safety. The poem evokes a lingering sense of worry and deep concern.

poetry_pre-qin_d586fd51.title: Thorns on Wall
poetry_pre-qin_d586fd51.summary: The poem uses wall thorns to symbolize court scandals that cannot be spoken. It conveys indignation and helplessness regarding the moral decay of the elite.

poetry_yuan_c2b024b6.title: Poem: Blue Gown Tears
poetry_yuan_c2b024b6.summary: The scene opens with a brothel at dawn, bustling with the arrival and departure of guests. It captures the weary, forced nature of life in the pleasure quarters.

poetry_yuan_76d82fbc.title: Poem: World's Joy
poetry_yuan_76d82fbc.summary: A courtesan laments her inherited fate just as the poet Bai Juyi arrives. This sudden encounter disrupts her numbness with a sense of irony.

poetry_yuan_94a0857c.title: Poem: Drunk Returning
poetry_yuan_94a0857c.summary: The madam greedily welcomes the scholars, while the courtesan observes with cold detachment. It reveals the transactional nature of the brothel and her disdain.

poetry_yuan_abbeef1e.title: Poem: Rear Garden Flower
poetry_yuan_abbeef1e.summary: Scholars visit the pleasure quarters, and the courtesan hosts them despite her inner conflict. This social mismatch creates an atmosphere of absurdity and bitterness.

poetry_yuan_ad315bb7.title: Poem: Golden Goblet
poetry_yuan_ad315bb7.summary: The courtesan mocks the scholars' insincerity with sharp, biting words. She views their presence as a misfortune, expressing deep resentment toward their frivolous behavior.

poetry_yuan_ea568601.title: Poem: Deceived
poetry_yuan_ea568601.summary: The courtesan urges the scholars to leave to avoid trouble and disgrace. Her words are firm yet carry the sorrow of one forced to submit to reality.

poetry_yuan_dc204af4.title: Poem: Just Right
poetry_yuan_dc204af4.summary: As they part, the courtesan laments her lowly status and the pain of separation. Her sorrow over life's transience leaves a haunting and profound impression.

poetry_yuan_7972fba9.title: Poem: Rolling Embroidered Ball
poetry_yuan_7972fba9.summary: The heroine steadfastly rejects her mother's pressure to remarry, affirming her loyalty to Bai Juyi. Drawing on the example of Li Bai, she displays a defiant spirit and unwavering devotion.

poetry_yuan_9f95a477.title: Poem: If a Scholar
poetry_yuan_9f95a477.summary: The heroine rebukes her mother and the wealthy suitor for their greed. She remains firm in her rejection, revealing a clear-eyed disdain for worldly materialism.

poetry_yuan_9f19d3f4.title: Poem: Chattering
poetry_yuan_9f19d3f4.summary: Waiting in vain for her lover, the heroine interprets every sound as a sign of his return. Her longing shifts into a harrowing fear of his death, leaving a sense of profound grief.

poetry_yuan_b78c7bb5.title: Poem: Drunk Peace
poetry_yuan_b78c7bb5.summary: Burning paper money to honor her husband, the heroine feels his spirit lingering nearby. Caught between mourning and spectral visions, she is overwhelmed by a haunting sense of loss.

poetry_yuan_e11968ab.title: Poem: One Finale
poetry_yuan_e11968ab.summary: Reflecting on past vows amidst life's inevitable changes, the heroine resolves to sever her earthly ties. Her farewell is marked by a poignant resignation to the passage of time.

poetry_yuan_becfc77b.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Second Act
poetry_yuan_becfc77b.summary: Amidst the desolate sounds of nature by the river, the heroine laments her lonely, wandering life. Her sorrow blends into the bleak landscape, evoking a deep sense of isolation.

poetry_yuan_17e5010e.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Fourth Act
poetry_yuan_17e5010e.summary: The heroine recounts her tragic fall from grace into the hardships of a courtesan's life. Her lament over lost dignity and current misery creates a powerful, bitter confession.

poetry_yuan_77566ed8.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: New Water Melody
poetry_yuan_77566ed8.summary: The vast, hazy sunset over the river paints a scene of natural beauty. The poet laments that no artist could ever capture the profound sorrow hidden within this landscape.

poetry_yuan_63327523.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Stopping Horse
poetry_yuan_63327523.summary: Facing the vast river, she likens the alien land to a desolate exile. It leaves profound sorrow.

poetry_yuan_c5559dc9.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Step by Step Charm
poetry_yuan_c5559dc9.summary: Lying awake, she laments her fate and calls for a pipa to ease her grief. It evokes deep isolation.

poetry_yuan_afb9bc39.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Stirring Zither Pipa
poetry_yuan_afb9bc39.summary: The pipa stirs ancient and recent griefs, making flute music preferable. It lingers with deep melancholy.

poetry_yuan_c6021f14.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Drunk in East Wind
poetry_yuan_c6021f14.summary: After sizing up the visitor, she casts coins into the water, vowing reunion in death. It is tragic and fierce.

poetry_yuan_cc7a4223.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Hanging Gada
poetry_yuan_cc7a4223.summary: Hearing of sudden separation, she tearfully retreats. It leaves a feeling of shock and agonizing reluctance.

poetry_yuan_c28cfe8b.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Seven Brothers
poetry_yuan_c28cfe8b.summary: She laments her lonely days and her husband's constant drunkenness with nowhere to turn. It is desolate.

poetry_yuan_b2daccef.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Collecting Jiangnan
poetry_yuan_b2daccef.summary: The painted boat returns under moonlight, turning into a waiting stone for her love. It leaves lingering yearning.

poetry_yuan_acc41f94.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Great Clear Song
poetry_yuan_acc41f94.summary: Using the East Mountain allusion, she depicts her lover quietly leaving past the bridge. It leaves a sense of loss.

poetry_yuan_d7e63915.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Mandarin Duck Ending
poetry_yuan_d7e63915.summary: The pipa's sorrow draws tears from the official, evoking deep melancholy. The emotional resonance leaves a lingering sense of tragic longing.

poetry_yuan_116ee51e.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Powder Butterfly
poetry_yuan_116ee51e.summary: A woman reflects on her life in the official's mansion before a sudden imperial summons. Fear and uncertainty dominate her transition to the palace.

poetry_yuan_fed1bf60.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Drunk Spring Wind
poetry_yuan_fed1bf60.summary: Forced before imperial guards, the woman feels the weight of unpredictable royal power. Her anxiety reflects the vulnerability of her position.

poetry_yuan_e9abef78.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Welcoming Immortals
poetry_yuan_e9abef78.summary: Unfamiliar with court etiquette, the woman kneels in fear, begging for mercy. Her plea highlights a desperate attempt to share her sorrow.

poetry_yuan_3fc7f43b.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Variation
poetry_yuan_3fc7f43b.summary: The woman recalls her lover's literary talent, which is thwarted by family opposition. The contrast between genius and prejudice leaves a bitter sting.

poetry_yuan_799bed55.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Red Peony
poetry_yuan_799bed55.summary: The woman scorns the merchant's vulgarity and greed. This disdain emphasizes her own helplessness as she drifts with the current.

poetry_yuan_77c7b24c.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Red Embroidered Shoes
poetry_yuan_77c7b24c.summary: A merchant fakes a death notice to force the woman into marriage. The revelation of this scheme sparks intense anger and despair.

poetry_yuan_ed5b8ef0.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Joyful Spring's Arrival
poetry_yuan_ed5b8ef0.summary: Under pressure from greed, the woman is forced to submit to a new life. Her resignation leaves a profound sense of tragic loss.

poetry_yuan_efb24ef0.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Universal Joy
poetry_yuan_efb24ef0.summary: Xunyang port glows with sunset. Tears fall into cold waves as the lute plays, leaving deep sorrow.

poetry_yuan_c1d6b75e.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Three Joys
poetry_yuan_c1d6b75e.summary: A moonlit boat meets Lord Bai, lifting her sorrow. A bittersweet feeling lingers.

poetry_yuan_db86c7e9.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Old Bao
poetry_yuan_db86c7e9.summary: Scholars and beauties part amid worldly trials, leaving a haunting sense of impermanence.

poetry_yuan_1ac9d084.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Calling Sound
poetry_yuan_1ac9d084.summary: Courtiers stand solemn in the hall until old friends finally meet, stirring quiet sighs.

poetry_yuan_c38b871d.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Picking Silver Lamp
poetry_yuan_c38b871d.summary: Old confidants feign ignorance upon reunion, leaving a lingering, poignant resentment.

poetry_yuan_98bbc76e.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Mallow Greens
poetry_yuan_98bbc76e.summary: The scholar seemed merely romantic, yet possessed grand statecraft. It leaves surprise.

poetry_yuan_39069699.title: Tears of Jiangzhou Sima: Follow-up Ending
poetry_yuan_39069699.summary: Weary of the world's trials, youthful passions fade to white hair. Peace finally prevails.

poetry_yuan_cbeea5c5.title: Thunder on Dedication Tablet: Crimson Lips
poetry_yuan_cbeea5c5.summary: Half a life lost in worldly dust, a poor scholar lacks any refuge. Full of bleakness.

poetry_yuan_2093d745.title: Thunder on Dedication Tablet: Rear Garden Flower
poetry_yuan_2093d745.summary: Long-separated brothers reunite under the omen of a lamp flame. It captures a rare moment of warmth amidst hardship.

poetry_yuan_fe07070a.title: Thunder on Dedication Tablet: Oil Gourd
poetry_yuan_fe07070a.summary: A scholar laments that years of studying classics bring only hunger and poverty. It expresses deep resentment toward the futility of his efforts.

poetry_yuan_e76639c7.title: Thunder on Dedication Tablet: World's Joy
poetry_yuan_e76639c7.summary: An impoverished scholar reflects on the coldness of the world when advised to seek patronage. It conveys a sense of weary resignation.

poetry_yuan_32bda58e.title: Thunder on Dedication Tablet: Nezha's Command
poetry_yuan_32bda58e.summary: The poet contrasts ancient virtuous friendships with the lack of integrity in his time. It highlights his frustration with the current era.

poetry_yuan_511dc0a5.title: Thunder on Dedication Tablet: Parasitic Grass
poetry_yuan_511dc0a5.summary: The poet mocks the promise that study leads to wealth and beauty, contrasting it with harsh reality. It reflects disillusionment with the examination system.

poetry_yuan_602aaa3b.title: Thunder on Dedication Tablet: Variation
poetry_yuan_602aaa3b.summary: The poet laments that the clever suffer while the foolish prosper. It is a biting satire on the inverted values of society.

poetry_yuan_fe2000fd.title: Thunder on Dedication Tablet: Six Yao Preface
poetry_yuan_fe2000fd.summary: Reflecting on a life wasted in pursuit of scholarly status, the poet feels too ashamed to return home. It reveals deep regret and exhaustion.

poetry_yuan_a59326e7.title: Thunder on Dedication Tablet: Drunk to Return
poetry_yuan_a59326e7.summary: The poet mocks the uneducated wealthy who succeed easily, contrasting them with his own plight. It ends with cynical disdain for the unfair system.

poetry_yuan_8f051b4b.title: Thunder on Dedication Tablet: Earning Finale
poetry_yuan_8f051b4b.summary: A scholar seeks fame, pinning his hopes on a recommendation letter. His words reveal anxiety and longing, reflecting the frustration of a difficult career path.

poetry_yuan_50d5e89a.title: Thunder on Dedication Tablet: Appreciating Flowers
poetry_yuan_50d5e89a.summary: The poet drifts like Wang Ziyou, living in poverty. Through scenes of visiting monks and scholars, he expresses the loneliness of being unrecognized.

poetry_yuan_a37c65ed.title: Immortal Melody: Half Piece
poetry_yuan_a37c65ed.summary: A woman waits for her lover behind a half-open door. Her feelings linger between anticipation and disappointment, leaving a sense of melancholy longing.

poetry_yuan_8e7e879a.title: Central Melody: Red Shoes of Life
poetry_yuan_8e7e879a.summary: The coldness of the world leaves the poet alone with a dim lamp and freezing bed. The desolate setting mirrors his inner sorrow and disillusionment.

poetry_yuan_dcbf6689.title: Shang Melody: Phoenix Tree Leaf Reminiscence
poetry_yuan_dcbf6689.summary: The ancient Red Cliff is now overgrown with grass, and heroic deeds are mere gossip for fishermen. History's passage evokes the vanity of fame.

poetry_yuan_1d3748a3.title: Double Tune: Wild Geese Passing, Leisure
poetry_yuan_1d3748a3.summary: The poet abandons fame for a secluded life of gardening and tea. This shift to pastoral living reveals a serene, detached contentment.

poetry_yuan_cd94f57d.title: Yellow Bell: Drunken Flower Shadow, Su Qing
poetry_yuan_cd94f57d.summary: The river is vast, and a lone sail fades into the distance. Failing to find Su Qing, the poet feels profound loneliness amidst the empty landscape.

poetry_yuan_9997b8f8.title: Earth-Scouring Wind: Greeting a Monk
poetry_yuan_9997b8f8.summary: The poet encounters a beautiful woman in a temple, reading her heartfelt inscription on the wall. This unexpected meeting and sincere confession stir his emotions.

poetry_yuan_84724d87.title: Four Gates: On a Treacherous Accusation
poetry_yuan_84724d87.summary: A woman is falsely accused of breaking vows, feeling deep injustice. Like a shadow in a bamboo grove, she waits in vain, left with bitter sorrow.

poetry_yuan_102fd158.title: Ancient Water Immortal: Unwashable Tears
poetry_yuan_102fd158.summary: Facing false accusations, a woman weeps, unable to clear her name. She sees through the world's coldness, lamenting the futility and helplessness of life.

poetry_yuan_e6211647.title: Stabbing Ancient: Star-Gazing Vows
poetry_yuan_e6211647.summary: Lovers vow under stars and moon, sharing joyful moments. Yet, reality breaks their promises, leaving them separated and profoundly lonely.

poetry_yuan_29d78ef7.title: Coda: Idling by Flowers
poetry_yuan_29d78ef7.summary: A courtesan spends her days in pleasure quarters, selling smiles to survive. She knows the bitterness behind the glamour, always preparing for inevitable departures.

poetry_yuan_0ee179ae.title: Liangzhou: Seduction's Deception
poetry_yuan_0ee179ae.summary: A profligate youth indulges in dissipation, only to end up penniless and abandoned. Such hollow, pleasure-seeking relationships ultimately result in nothing.

poetry_yuan_26afd7a9.title: Yuediao: Farewell Song
poetry_yuan_26afd7a9.summary: As the sun sets and a boat departs, the tolling bells shatter the joy. The bleak scenery mirrors the traveler's sorrow, leaving a heartbreaking impression.

poetry_yuan_258bf62c.title: Purple Flower: Wasting Away
poetry_yuan_258bf62c.summary: A woman withers away, enduring the long night in solitude. With dreams shattered and the past gone like smoke, she feels utterly lost.

poetry_yuan_415d306d.title: Mocking Song: Farewell Melancholy
poetry_yuan_415d306d.summary: Parting sorrow lingers, intensified by the moonlight. Facing the ancient shores and reeds, the woman feels deep melancholy and uncertainty about the future.

poetry_yuan_ebfd8ee5.title: Coda: Reluctant Parting
poetry_yuan_ebfd8ee5.summary: This piece depicts vibrant spring scenery with singing birds. The parting scene and drizzling rain heighten the lingering sorrow of separation.

poetry_yuan_9468142f.title: Purple Flower Prelude: Spring Splendor
poetry_yuan_9468142f.summary: This song presents gorgeous spring scenery of green mountains and fragrant blooms. It celebrates a prosperous time of peace, leaving a cheerful and appreciative mood.

poetry_yuan_a9b0b1ba.title: Little Peach Blossom: Spring Beauty
poetry_yuan_a9b0b1ba.summary: The lyric shows a luxurious spring landscape intertwined with blooming flowers and waterfowl. The call of cuckoos deepens the feeling of lingering in nature.

poetry_yuan_e34a3238.title: Mocking Song: Appreciating Spring
poetry_yuan_e34a3238.summary: The poem depicts joyful scenes of appreciating flowers and festive music in suburban gardens. This natural splendor leaves a lively and joyful impression.

poetry_yuan_2c107cb1.title: Double Tune: Autumn Lake View
poetry_yuan_2c107cb1.summary: The works outline tranquil scenes of lakes and mountain seclusion, blending reflections on fame and wine. It leaves a broad yet slightly desolate sentiment.

poetry_yuan_b9d3bc1b.title: Central Tune: Mountain Notes
poetry_yuan_b9d3bc1b.summary: The poems showcase the leisurely life of mountain seclusion and tranquil natural scenery. Far from fame, the poet finds peace in nature.

poetry_yuan_b4aa3429.title: Central Tune: Embroidered Shoes
poetry_yuan_b4aa3429.summary: The writings depict mountain outings, rustic retirement, and year-end reflections. Finding solace in nature, the poet leaves a leisurely and detached mood.

poetry_yuan_6ec8f966.title: Double Tune: Drunken East Wind, Fishing Terrace
poetry_yuan_6ec8f966.summary: The song portrays a leisurely life of fishing and secluded living among green mountains. Far from fame, the poet embraces a carefree and natural state of mind.

poetry_yuan_0c39e4a2.title: Double Tune: Celebrating East Garden
poetry_yuan_0c39e4a2.summary: The poet depicts a reclusive life and natural scenery to express indifference toward fame. The poem transitions from idle scenes to transcending heroic ambition, leaving a sense of worldly detachment.

poetry_yuan_04482eab.title: Central Tune: Greeting Immortals, Recalling Past
poetry_yuan_04482eab.summary: Depicting farewells and nostalgia by the West Lake, the poem shifts from joyful gatherings to the sorrow of parting. It concludes with misty rain imagery, evoking a deep sense of melancholy.

poetry_yuan_cfb61910.title: Yuediao: Leaning on Rail, Lake
poetry_yuan_cfb61910.summary: Capturing spring lake scenes and nightly sorrows, the poem moves from bright light to quiet solitude. Through images of fading blossoms and flowing water, it creates a cold, profound longing.

poetry_yuan_b5d20c84.title: Central Tune: Mountain Slope, Spring
poetry_yuan_b5d20c84.summary: The poem contrasts spring festivities with the desolation of parting, shifting from prosperity to bleakness. It ends with a departing carriage, leaving a sense of lingering regret and helplessness.

poetry_yuan_3cf29ab1.title: Southern Tune: Four Jade Slabs, Leisure
poetry_yuan_3cf29ab1.summary: The poet depicts an elegant reclusive life, moving from a yearning for immortality to contentment with reality. The poem conveys a serene sense of distancing from conflict and embracing the seasons.

poetry_yuan_22c08f1c.title: Central Tune: Joyful Spring, Jian Lake
poetry_yuan_22c08f1c.summary: Recording lake excursions and life as a traveler, the poem shifts from joyful exploration to the loneliness of a guest. Through cuckoo calls and tea-picking songs, it leaves a complex feeling of displacement.

poetry_yuan_5ec02eec.title: Southern Tune: Scolding Jade, Tea Song
poetry_yuan_5ec02eec.summary: With self-mockery, the poet reviews his career, shifting from disdain for power to an insistence on reclusion. The ending, with a lonely lamp and pear blossoms, evokes a bleak and solitary poetic mood.

poetry_yuan_d96f5f0f.title: Double Tune: Water Immortal, Visiting Plum
poetry_yuan_d96f5f0f.summary: Through visiting plum blossoms and lake gatherings, the poem moves from nostalgia for the past to present joy. Ending with the sunset and returning crows, it leaves a sense of tranquility after the festivities.

poetry_yuan_591c7ec6.title: Double Tune: Breaking Laurel, Cold Food
poetry_yuan_591c7ec6.summary: This piece depicts the vibrant scenes of West Lake during Cold Food and summer. The poet reflects on the scenery, leaving a lingering sense of melancholy over the passage of time.

poetry_yuan_f44fce3e.title: Central Tune: Full Courtyard Fragrance, Lake
poetry_yuan_f44fce3e.summary: The poem showcases the lively atmosphere of West Lake with music, flowers, and willows. The blend of bustling scenery and lotus-picking boats creates a joyful and relaxed mood.

poetry_yuan_e36e57f6.title: Central Tune: Universal Joy, Re-visiting West Lake
poetry_yuan_e36e57f6.summary: Revisiting West Lake, the poet blends picturesque views with late spring decay. Comparing past and present, he expresses deep nostalgia for the beauty and a sense of aging.

poetry_yuan_68ae44d9.title: Double Tune: Clear River, Solitary Drink
poetry_yuan_68ae44d9.summary: Under the cold moon, the poet drinks alone to soothe his sorrows. The loneliness after the party disperses reveals a desolate and introspective inner world.

poetry_yuan_3294e76e.title: Yuediao: Little Peach Blossom, Lake Pavilion Night
poetry_yuan_3294e76e.summary: On an autumn night at the lake pavilion, mandarin ducks contrast with the poet's solitude. He uses the autumn scenery to express sorrow, leaving a lingering, poignant feeling.

poetry_yuan_84b30611.title: Central Tune: Morning Emperor, Lake
poetry_yuan_84b30611.summary: Sleeping under reeds by the lake, the poet seeks detachment in nature. This leisurely retreat reflects a broad-minded attitude of indifference toward fame and fortune.

poetry_yuan_1a2c191e.title: Double Tune: Drunken East Wind, Lake View
poetry_yuan_1a2c191e.summary: Evening views of West Lake reveal the beauty of painted boats and lotus flowers. The poet finds solace in nature, expressing a detached, leisurely spirit through poetry and chess.

poetry_yuan_deb5cc16.title: Yuediao: Sky Pure Sand, Gushan Snow Night
poetry_yuan_deb5cc16.summary: On a snowy night at Gushan, plum blossoms and cold snow create a stark, beautiful scene. The poet finds inspiration in this solitude, leaving an elegant, transcendent impression.

poetry_yuan_ed6bd5bb.title: Proper Tune: Drunken Peace, Lake
poetry_yuan_ed6bd5bb.summary: The poem depicts a serene lake scene after rain, shifting to reflections on life's transience. It conveys a sense of detachment from worldly gains through the lens of melancholy.

poetry_yuan_24efad1e.title: Double Tune: Wind Entering Pines, Ninth Day
poetry_yuan_24efad1e.summary: On the Double Ninth Festival, the poet enjoys the autumn scenery and chrysanthemums. Despite aging, his poetic spirit remains vibrant, reflecting an optimistic and composed outlook.

poetry_yuan_3e869548.title: Proper Tune: Little Liangzhou, Spring Return
poetry_yuan_3e869548.summary: Returning from a spring lake excursion, the poet observes lively wine shops and festive boats. The scene captures a luxurious, carefree atmosphere of spring leisure.

poetry_yuan_525269c8.title: Evening Sun, Mountain Painting
poetry_yuan_525269c8.summary: The setting sun and returning crows create a quiet, picturesque landscape. As crowds depart, the moon and plum blossoms evoke a sense of serene solitude.

poetry_yuan_25aad543.title: Golden Waves, Wine Cup
poetry_yuan_25aad543.summary: The scene of painted towers and ladies in the sunset reflects a life of refined leisure. It conveys a sense of elegant, languid beauty.

poetry_yuan_33689346.title: Visiting Gao Shi Du
poetry_yuan_33689346.summary: Visiting a friend, the poet finds joy in the sounds of pines and flowing water. The secluded environment inspires a feeling of detachment from worldly cares.

poetry_yuan_d3d2e78e.title: Poetic Thoughts in Snow
poetry_yuan_d3d2e78e.summary: Searching for plum blossoms after snow, the poet finds poetic inspiration in the icy, pure landscape. The imagery evokes a refined and tranquil aesthetic.

poetry_yuan_2dd87099.title: Drunken Inscription at Lakeside Hall
poetry_yuan_2dd87099.summary: The contrast between the lively lakeside hall and the solitary fisherman creates a balanced narrative. It leaves the reader longing for a peaceful, idyllic retreat.

poetry_yuan_c711abc6.title: Golden Sutra: Lakeside Hermitage
poetry_yuan_c711abc6.summary: The poem depicts a tranquil lakeside hermit life, moving from lotus-picking songs to autumn landscapes. The shift from spring vitality to autumn stillness leaves a feeling of detached leisure and gentle nostalgia.

poetry_yuan_5d0c572e.title: Qin Tower Moon
poetry_yuan_5d0c572e.summary: The poet visits old West Lake haunts, lingering at the bayberry grove. As clouds darken over Wushan and rain threatens, he must depart, leaving a sense of melancholy over the fleeting nature of beautiful moments.

poetry_yuan_1d39fc87.title: Moon Round: Spring Rhyme
poetry_yuan_1d39fc87.summary: Lamenting lost youth, the poet reflects on past dreams amidst seasonal changes. Through delicate nature imagery, he conveys a profound sense of loneliness and resignation toward the passage of time.

poetry_yuan_801b2e09.title: Song: Praising White Jade Plum
poetry_yuan_801b2e09.summary: Using plum blossoms as a metaphor, the poet expresses his noble aspirations and reclusive spirit. Amidst themes of parting and worldly burdens, he reveals a deep longing to retreat into nature and escape the mundane.

poetry_yuan_d1baafa3.title: Xiao Tao Hong: On Huai'an Road
poetry_yuan_d1baafa3.summary: The poem records travel experiences, from spring scenes on the Huai'an road to autumn loneliness. Through sensory details, it expresses a deep longing for distant loved ones while wandering far from home.

poetry_yuan_1d437ff4.title: Tian Jing Sha: Ma Qianzhai Garden
poetry_yuan_1d437ff4.summary: The poet visits gardens, seeking peace amidst flowers and wine. Balancing admiration for nature with sadness over time's passage, he reveals the complex emotional world of a scholar.

poetry_yuan_de00ade3.title: Drunk Peace: Grieving Spring
poetry_yuan_de00ade3.summary: Describing spring melancholy and reclusive life, the poet expresses dissatisfaction with reality and a desire for transcendence. Through wine and poetry, he reveals a broad-minded detachment from the world.

poetry_yuan_5197a050.title: Leaning on Rail: Late Spring
poetry_yuan_5197a050.summary: The poem depicts late spring lakeside scenery and the grace of beauties. Amidst the lingering appreciation of beauty, there is a subtle, melancholic sense of the transience of life and youth.

poetry_yuan_0cb57e2f.title: Half: Autumn Palace Poem
poetry_yuan_0cb57e2f.summary: The poems depict autumn palace scenes and natural beauty through evocative imagery. The recurring focus on 'halves' creates a serene, leisurely, and lingering atmosphere.

poetry_yuan_3a66a2b0.title: Little Liangzhou: Spring Night
poetry_yuan_3a66a2b0.summary: This piece portrays a woman's loneliness on a spring night, where broken flute music and unsendable letters weave a sense of sorrow. The warmth of her quilt highlights her deep longing and helplessness.

poetry_yuan_77bb9059.title: Missing an Old Friend
poetry_yuan_77bb9059.summary: Gazing at clouds, the poet laments the fleeting spring and the pain of separation. The cold pear blossom courtyard mirrors the lady's haggard appearance and her shame before the flowers.

poetry_yuan_a82781ac.title: Evening Melancholy
poetry_yuan_a82781ac.summary: At dusk, geese flying past the dressing tower stir feelings of melancholy. The scene shifts to the suburbs, where lively spring imagery highlights the poet's detachment from the world.

poetry_yuan_9fee8855.title: New Poem, Old Acquaintance
poetry_yuan_9fee8855.summary: The poet expresses admiration through poetry, yet feels melancholy as the peach blossoms remain indifferent. A neighbor's inquiry breaks the reverie, leaving a light, hazy impression.

poetry_yuan_cc9278f1.title: Golden Sutra: Mountain Walk
poetry_yuan_cc9278f1.summary: These pieces record mountain excursions and reclusive life, marking a shift from worldly ambition to nature. They convey a sense of detachment from fame and a joyful acceptance of fate.

poetry_yuan_42e9451a.title: Unbroken: First Floor Gathering
poetry_yuan_42e9451a.summary: Contrasting farewell banquets and melancholic music with ruined palaces, the poems express the wanderer's sorrow. Ancient sites at sunset evoke profound reflections on the impermanence of life.

poetry_yuan_9f8010e0.title: Water Immortal: Meeting Snow
poetry_yuan_9f8010e0.summary: The poems depict snowy scenes in Weiyang and the tranquility of a Taoist temple, blending earthly winter with ethereal charm. The mood shifts from cold to warm, ending in serene detachment.

poetry_yuan_e0b3bbdb.title: Breaking Laurel: Little Jinshan
poetry_yuan_e0b3bbdb.summary: The poems depict scenes from scenic heights to quiet courtyards, shifting from vibrancy to solitude. They ultimately leave a sense of melancholy and lingering longing for the past.

poetry_yuan_3e3671d8.title: Stockade Order: Recalling Farewell
poetry_yuan_3e3671d8.summary: The poem captures a sorrowful farewell under flowers, turning to lament the passage of time and the difficulty of correspondence. It is steeped in parting grief, evoking a profound sense of desolation.

poetry_yuan_4d69abe6.title: Joy Before Hall: Spring Outing
poetry_yuan_4d69abe6.summary: The work records the elegance of spring flower-viewing and night tours on West Lake, shifting to honor recluses like Lin Bu. It leaves a feeling of immersion in natural beauty and detached leisure.

poetry_yuan_a83a5468.title: Clear River: Early Morning
poetry_yuan_a83a5468.summary: The poems depict the serenity of early mornings in the mountains and reclusive life, contrasting worldly fame with retirement. They express a yearning for pastoral life and a detached, broad-minded attitude.

poetry_yuan_e360d744.title: Xiao Tao Hong: Lakeside Rhyme
poetry_yuan_e360d744.summary: The lyrics describe the splendor of West Lake boat tours and banquets, shifting to the atmosphere of evening songs. They capture the joy of lakeside recreation, creating a relaxed and intoxicated mood.

poetry_yuan_2dba0a20.title: Wine and Peace Song
poetry_yuan_2dba0a20.summary: The author reflects on the ups and downs of officialdom and historical lessons, turning to the carefree life of Wuliu Village. It expresses weariness with fame and a firm, liberated desire for seclusion.

poetry_yuan_c90a4477.title: Hu Eighteen
poetry_yuan_c90a4477.summary: The poem laments the fleeting nature of time and life, urging readers to enjoy the moment and seek seclusion. Contrasting social gatherings with retirement, it reveals a rejection of fame and a longing for freedom.

poetry_yuan_cf797b36.title: Celebrating Eastern Plain
poetry_yuan_cf797b36.summary: The work reflects on the illusions of officialdom and the perils of fame, turning to nature and farming among the clouds. It ultimately conveys a disillusionment with empty glory and a transcendent, reclusive spirit.

poetry_yuan_fe454f72.title: Celebrating Xuanhe
poetry_yuan_fe454f72.summary: The poet laments the toil of official life, turning instead to the beauty of the Qinghe River and Mount Huaque. This retreat into nature brings him profound joy and contentment.

poetry_yuan_e42a17f0.title: Highest Song: Praising Hairpin
poetry_yuan_e42a17f0.summary: Using the jade hairpin flower as a symbol of purity, the poet contrasts official vanity with natural leisure. He finds that embracing the landscape is far superior to life in a powerful minister's mansion.

poetry_yuan_595295ad.title: Wild Goose and Clear River
poetry_yuan_595295ad.summary: Weary of urban clamor, the poet resolutely retires from office. He settles in a pavilion deep within the misty mountains, living a secluded and peaceful life far from worldly concerns.

poetry_yuan_5dd316b6.title: Joy Before Hall: Chrysanthemum Lament
poetry_yuan_5dd316b6.summary: The poet reflects on his life through the withering chrysanthemums, finding solace in the lotus breeze and mountain scenery. He chooses seclusion, guarding his inner peace amidst the gentle rain.

poetry_yuan_4734845d.title: Plum Blossom Song
poetry_yuan_4734845d.summary: The poet depicts a tranquil life in the mountains, observing the cranes and apes. He concludes that this freedom from the dusty world is far more valuable than the fame of ancient statesmen.

poetry_yuan_2c8d188e.title: Victory Song: Rain on April 1st
poetry_yuan_2c8d188e.summary: After a long drought, the timely rain restores vitality to all things. The poet joins the farmers in celebrating this life-giving downpour, filled with joy for nature's grace.

poetry_yuan_e3a02d79.title: Drunken East Wind
poetry_yuan_e3a02d79.summary: Listing the tragedies of historical figures, the poet expresses his weariness with fame and fortune. He chooses a life with books and music in a humble cottage, seeking a peaceful existence.

poetry_yuan_4e2fb897.title: Breaking Laurel
poetry_yuan_4e2fb897.summary: Reflecting on the futility of official ambition, the poet decides to abandon his pursuit of rank. He finds true liberation and freedom in a small boat, immersed in wine and poetry.

poetry_yuan_222b73ec.title: Border Wild Goose in Autumn
poetry_yuan_222b73ec.summary: The poet depicts elegant seasonal gatherings at Zhuoran Pavilion. Amidst the changing scenery, he laments the lack of a kindred spirit, leaving a sense of solitude.

poetry_yuan_d15f01d7.title: Tian Jing Sha
poetry_yuan_d15f01d7.summary: Time passes, and the poet laments the cruelty of aging and life's changes. Seeking solace in wine, he eventually dismisses fame to find peace in a drunken stupor.

poetry_yuan_4779e77f.title: Western Sutra
poetry_yuan_4779e77f.summary: Despite repeated summons, the poet yearns for the mountains and tires of officialdom. He resolves to retire, seeking freedom and tranquility in the misty autumn rain.

poetry_yuan_e8790d37.title: Red Embroidered Shoes: Gift
poetry_yuan_e8790d37.summary: The poem vividly praises a courtesan's beauty and charm, captivating scholars. The lines are filled with admiration and infatuation for the lady.

poetry_yuan_62ff42f4.title: New Water: Resigning Office
poetry_yuan_62ff42f4.summary: The poet chooses to retire at the height of his career, weary of the noisy pursuit of fame. He celebrates returning to nature to enjoy a reclusive life.

poetry_yuan_04a06e39.title: Song: Daily Laughter
poetry_yuan_04a06e39.summary: The poet claims to be more carefree than Tao Yuanming, escaping the trap of fame. He lives happily among bamboo and pines, laughing and drinking in nature.

poetry_yuan_66d8caf6.title: Song: Half-Century Old
poetry_yuan_66d8caf6.summary: Past fifty, the poet laments the fleeting time and lost ambitions. He decides to abandon fruitless struggles, preferring to chat with neighbors and enjoy his remaining years.

poetry_yuan_661908a2.title: Song: Far from Harm
poetry_yuan_661908a2.summary: The poet distances himself from power struggles to avoid worldly gossip. By cutting ties with fame, he finds joy in a simple, reclusive life beyond the mundane world.

poetry_yuan_3194e326.title: Song: Rain for Harvest
poetry_yuan_3194e326.summary: The poet prays for rain to save the people, yet despite the relief, he remains burdened by the plight of refugees. The poem blends joy with deep compassion and national concern.

poetry_yuan_b1e809ae.title: Song: Transforming the World
poetry_yuan_b1e809ae.summary: The poet wishes to turn stones into grain to save the starving, but his inability to act leaves him aged and weary. It reflects a profound sense of helplessness regarding the suffering of the people.

poetry_yuan_574d8c42.title: Song: Remembering Ganlu
poetry_yuan_574d8c42.summary: The poet visits historical sites, lamenting that while the landscape remains, the people are gone. The imagery of sunset and flowing water evokes a deep sense of transience and historical sorrow.

poetry_yuan_75814468.title: Song: Red Brocade Robe
poetry_yuan_75814468.summary: The poet recounts historical figures who retreated from public life to express his own weariness with fame. He ultimately chooses to return to nature, seeking complete spiritual liberation in the countryside.

poetry_yuan_6b2510b7.title: Song: Half Drunk
poetry_yuan_6b2510b7.summary: The poet uses wine and flowers to process his sorrow, reflecting on the helplessness of parting. The intertwining of indulgence and separation leaves behind a lingering sense of melancholy.

poetry_yuan_dfa814ee.title: Song: West Lake
poetry_yuan_dfa814ee.summary: The poet depicts the beauty of West Lake and the hardships of travel, showing both attachment to scenery and detachment from the world. The contrast between movement and stillness reveals a sense of leisure and insight.

poetry_yuan_c849e299.title: Song: To a Singer
poetry_yuan_c849e299.summary: The poet praises the singer's talent and grace, creating a joyful atmosphere of revelry. The verses overflow with appreciation for art and a carefree attitude toward enjoying the moment.

poetry_yuan_c4b98632.title: Song: Snow
poetry_yuan_c4b98632.summary: The poet captures the crystalline beauty of snow, creating an ethereal and transcendent atmosphere. Amidst the tranquil nature, he seeks inner peace and the joys of a reclusive life.

poetry_yuan_b7ceafc7.title: Song: Mooring at Huangting
poetry_yuan_b7ceafc7.summary: This collection depicts the sentiments of travelers, lonely wives, and spring longing. Through delicate imagery, it captures the sorrow of separation and deep-seated solitude, leaving a lingering resonance.

poetry_yuan_bd6492b0.title: Song: Floral Hairpin
poetry_yuan_bd6492b0.summary: The poem describes floral hair ornaments blooming in the spring breeze. Through the imagery of jade dew and intertwined branches, it creates a refined and vibrant sense of spring beauty.

poetry_yuan_d7b96d1d.title: Song: Seeking Plum Blossoms
poetry_yuan_d7b96d1d.summary: Through scenes of seeking plum blossoms, viewing snow, and mooring at night, the poet reflects on the passage of time. Intertwining wine and poetry, it reveals a sense of worldly detachment and solitude.

poetry_yuan_9a68a940.title: Song: Painting Bamboo
poetry_yuan_9a68a940.summary: This piece praises the artistic spirit of painting bamboo, blending spring scenery with the mood of wine. Through the depiction of emerald shadows, it conveys a scholar's refined tranquility.

poetry_yuan_7e40dcf6.title: Song: West Lake Tune
poetry_yuan_7e40dcf6.summary: Revisiting West Lake, the poet reflects on changing scenery and past events, lamenting the vanity of fame. Amidst praise for the landscape, he contemplates the impermanence of life.

poetry_yuan_c1f9b394.title: Song: Tiaoxi River
poetry_yuan_c1f9b394.summary: The poem depicts the serene landscape of Tiaoxi River and the quiet atmosphere of a spring night. Through natural imagery and intimate whispers, it creates a poetic, reclusive life.

poetry_yuan_755c91a4.title: Song: Plum Shadow
poetry_yuan_755c91a4.summary: Centered on plum shadows and spring sorrow, the work reveals a woman's delicate emotions in her boudoir. Set against pear blossoms and moonlight, it evokes a subtle sense of melancholy and longing.

poetry_yuan_c1b54937.title: Song: Fishing Terrace
poetry_yuan_c1b54937.summary: Through descriptions of the Fishing Terrace and reclusive life, the poem expresses a desire for retirement. Accompanied by moonlight and breeze, it reveals a spirit indifferent to worldly fame.

poetry_yuan_f54072a9.title: Song: Flower Seller's Song
poetry_yuan_f54072a9.summary: The poet wanders through picturesque landscapes while intoxicated, yet feels profound loneliness due to long separation. The poem shifts from joy to deep longing, leaving a lingering melancholy.

poetry_qing_3df2afea.title: Crimson Lips: Wind Orchid
poetry_qing_3df2afea.summary: The wind-blown orchid blooms alone in autumn rain, appearing cold and noble. The poet uses the flower to express an irrepressible sense of desolation.

poetry_qing_c70fdcb2.title: Qin'e Song: Long Wanderings
poetry_qing_c70fdcb2.summary: Wandering far from home, the poet laments his haggard reflection and the mismatch between talent and fate. The poem turns into a sigh over his own misfortune.

poetry_qing_e9fa3146.title: Wine Spring: Farewell Jasmine
poetry_qing_e9fa3146.summary: As jasmine fades under moonlight, the poet remains sleepless. The dying lamp and lone wild goose evoke a heavy sense of sorrow.

poetry_qing_38cf449a.title: Bodhisattva: Why Lightly Part?
poetry_qing_38cf449a.summary: Spring passes quickly, and the pain of parting surges like a cold tide. The poet questions the reason for separation, filled with longing and regret for reunion.

poetry_qing_51a18001.title: Searching: East Wind Unknowing
poetry_qing_51a18001.summary: The east wind is indifferent as the poet stands alone in the night, feeling the chill amidst incense smoke. The poem captures a moment of solitude and faint sorrow.

poetry_qing_8120c80e.title: Silk Washing: Country Excursion
poetry_qing_8120c80e.summary: Friends go on a spring excursion, lamenting the rarity of gathering. The poem shifts from enjoying spring to philosophical reflections on life's partings, leaving a profound impression.

poetry_qing_47c01023.title: Searching: Short Flame Burns
poetry_qing_47c01023.summary: Late at night, the poet wakes from a dream to find the path ahead uncertain. The illusion of the dream and the cold reality weave together a sense of powerlessness.

poetry_qing_069f564d.title: Searching: Sad Clouds Fly
poetry_qing_069f564d.summary: The poet stands by the acacia tree, mourning a lost love in the cold rain. This silent parting transforms into an endless, lingering sorrow.

poetry_qing_2f6651b3.title: Silk Washing: New Year's Eve
poetry_qing_2f6651b3.summary: On New Year's Eve, the poet recalls past splendor amidst the current coldness. The flickering lights evoke a sense of impermanence and fading time.

poetry_qing_cae0b38d.title: River City: On History
poetry_qing_cae0b38d.summary: Gazing at mist-covered peaks, the poet drifts into illusion. He realizes life is but a dream, finding solace only within that dream.

poetry_qing_5c937619.title: Crimson Lips: A Beauty
poetry_qing_5c937619.summary: In a quiet room, shadows of bamboo reflect the poet's fear of aging. As dawn breaks, the solitude deepens within the silent tower.

poetry_qing_6e08be53.title: Blue Robe: Mourning
poetry_qing_6e08be53.summary: Mourning his late wife, the poet weeps by the window. A flickering lamp sparks a fleeting illusion of her return, highlighting his deep, desolate longing.

poetry_qing_edf9fc71.title: Broken Silk Washing: Buried Flowers
poetry_qing_edf9fc71.summary: Amidst wild moss, the poet laments the falling of a beautiful flower. His life drifts like duckweed, leaving only a broken soul wandering the world.

poetry_qing_7ab912ee.title: Crimson Lips: Five Nights Cold
poetry_qing_7ab912ee.summary: In the snowy cold, the poet sighs while wrapped in his robes. Watching the morning stars and geese, he feels a profound, lonely uncertainty.

poetry_qing_fdb31e2f.title: Silk Washing: Plum's Thinness
poetry_qing_fdb31e2f.summary: Seeing the thin plum blossoms, the poet identifies with their fragility and shuts his door. He remains in the cold dusk, clinging to lingering scents and memories.
