poetry_qing_b0a7d47b.title: Silk Washing: Empty Powder Pond
poetry_qing_b0a7d47b.summary: The pond is overgrown and swallows flit by. The poet laments passing time, leaving a lingering sense of melancholy.

poetry_qing_77d57d08.title: Dream of Jiangnan: Crows Gone
poetry_qing_77d57d08.summary: As crows vanish in twilight, cold fills the room. Plum blossoms sway in the wind, leaving the poet in lonely, ash-like despair.

poetry_qing_0ba91d8d.title: Red Date: Startled by Dawn
poetry_qing_0ba91d8d.summary: Dawn’s toll breaks a spring dream, leaving the poet in self-pity. He wishes the breeze would bring joy to his quiet window.

poetry_qing_c6d3c079.title: Silk Washing: Lingering Snow
poetry_qing_c6d3c079.summary: Snow reflects on screens, and a flute wails. The poet calls himself a wanderer of sorrow, recalling his life through heartbreak.

poetry_qing_a485b223.title: Remembering Wang Sun: West Wind
poetry_qing_a485b223.summary: Autumn winds destroy banana leaves, and the poet turns to wine. Reading 'Li Sao,' his sorrow surges like the Xiang River tide.

poetry_qing_06684c03.title: A Life-Chart Song: Scattering Books
poetry_qing_06684c03.summary: Books are scattered amidst tea fragrance. The poet dwells on memories, refusing to wake from his deep, longing dreams.

poetry_qing_07f4fa35.title: Washing Stream Sands: Fading Sunset
poetry_qing_07f4fa35.summary: Sunset hits the tower as a woman rides by. Her shy glance creates a fleeting, beautiful impression that stirs the poet's heart.

poetry_qing_66b2012f.title: Washing Stream Sands: Sleepy Awakening
poetry_qing_66b2012f.summary: Waking up weary, the poet is filled with worry. With no letters and missed trysts, he is left in endless, troubled contemplation.

poetry_qing_70d49df4.title: Washing Stream Sands: Abandoned Hairpin
poetry_qing_70d49df4.summary: Autumn grass and cold moonlight frame a memory of broken vows. Regret permeates the poet's reflection on the fleeting nature of love.

poetry_qing_d1f70cb7.title: As in a Dream: Well and Pulley
poetry_qing_d1f70cb7.summary: Fallen flowers by the well stir memories of a sudden, unsettling encounter. The poet is left to dwell in lonely shadows.

poetry_qing_9413d31d.title: As in a Dream: Faint Moon
poetry_qing_9413d31d.summary: In the twilight garden, old sorrows and new joys collide. Tears on a pillow reveal a hidden, aching loneliness.

poetry_qing_45c7f72e.title: Mulberry Picker: Fading Messages
poetry_qing_45c7f72e.summary: Messages cease and the night grows cold in solitude. The poet counts the autumn days, mourning another missed reunion.

poetry_qing_3f922a2c.title: Nearing Good Things: Way Home
poetry_qing_3f922a2c.summary: Wandering through desolate landscapes, the poet laments the passing spring. He fears that time has withered his beloved's beauty.

poetry_qing_4500a127.title: Qin'e Song: Shallow Spring
poetry_qing_4500a127.summary: Spring waters and misty fields evoke the passage of time. The poet reflects on fading beauty and the inevitable decay of all things.

poetry_qing_f2c91729.title: Qin'e Song: Layered Mountains
poetry_qing_f2c91729.summary: Rugged cliffs and broken steles reveal a landscape haunted by history. Amidst the desolate ruins, only the moon remains constant.

poetry_qing_b6f64632.title: Eye's Charm: Ode to Plum
poetry_qing_b6f64632.summary: The plum blossom is pure yet destined for solitude. Its shadows against the window mirror a noble but lonely spirit.

poetry_qing_a6c16937.title: Eye's Charm: Re-seeing Nymph
poetry_qing_a6c16937.summary: The poet reunites with his beloved on a beautiful spring night. The moonlight and peach blossoms create a serene and joyful atmosphere.

poetry_qing_da944897.title: Eye's Charm: Leaning by Door
poetry_qing_da944897.summary: Leaning alone by the door, the poet laments the spring chill and lost dreams. Flickering candles highlight his deep regret and lingering loneliness.

poetry_qing_fe05d834.title: Broken Washing Stream Sands: Unspoken Dream
poetry_qing_fe05d834.summary: Waking from a dream, the poet regrets his past carelessness. Melting candles mirror his inconsolable longing and profound sorrow.

poetry_qing_d1d78f66.title: Broken Washing Stream Sands: Drunk by Lamp
poetry_qing_d1d78f66.summary: Drunk by the lamp, the poet is haunted by rain and parting sorrow. The partridge's cry underscores his disillusionment and inner desolation.

poetry_qing_5992ed04.title: Great Harmony Prelude: Self-Portrait
poetry_qing_5992ed04.summary: Facing the autumn wind and vast landscape, the poet reflects on the past. He seeks to awaken heroic dreams with music, yet remains cold.

poetry_qing_fed54a81.title: A Life-Chart Song: Whip's Shadow
poetry_qing_fed54a81.summary: Spring scenes and charming glances evoke a vibrant mood. The shift to melting wax and returning swallows leaves a sense of fading grace.

poetry_qing_568d9ee7.title: Washing Stream Sands: Ten Thousand Miles
poetry_qing_568d9ee7.summary: Stationed far away, the poet reflects on his aging appearance. Gazing at a portrait, he expresses deep pity and longing for his beloved.

poetry_qing_50c187e9.title: Washing Stream Sands: Jiangnv Temple
poetry_qing_50c187e9.summary: Visiting the temple by the cold sea, the poet reflects on ancient history. The transience of empires leaves him with profound melancholy.

poetry_qing_71974a40.title: Reduced Magnolia: Silent Meeting
poetry_qing_71974a40.summary: A woman stands silently in autumn rain, her shyness preventing the poet from speaking his heart. The poem captures a delicate, restrained longing.

poetry_qing_4ff5292c.title: Mulberry Picker: Past Mistakes
poetry_qing_4ff5292c.summary: Reflecting on past mistakes, the poet laments that everything has changed. The poem conveys a deep sense of irreversible loss and sorrow.

poetry_qing_228f3e61.title: Mulberry Picker: A Dream
poetry_qing_228f3e61.summary: The moonlit courtyard evokes memories of a long-lost dream. The cool air after rain leaves the poet lingering in melancholy reflection.

poetry_qing_ccf84f87.title: Mulberry Picker: Writing by Lamp
poetry_qing_ccf84f87.summary: Writing by lamp at night fails to ease the poet's loneliness, as dreams remain distant. The sound of rain on bamboo heightens his isolation.

poetry_qing_09cd35dc.title: Washing Stream Sands: Candlelight Leak
poetry_qing_09cd35dc.summary: By flickering candlelight, the poet laments the arrival of spring without his beloved. He expresses a profound, restless longing for a reunion.

poetry_qing_537e8e6e.title: Washing Stream Sands: To Yan Sunyou
poetry_qing_537e8e6e.summary: The poet describes a leisurely life of seclusion with grace. Amidst flowers and tranquil scenery, he finds a sense of peaceful contentment.

poetry_han_c317cf9e.title: Crossing the Pass
poetry_han_c317cf9e.summary: The poet discusses governance, advocating for frugality and virtuous leadership. He contrasts ancient ideals with later corruption to reflect on society.

poetry_han_dae78ddd.title: Short Song, Part Two
poetry_han_dae78ddd.summary: Recounting the virtues of ancient rulers like King Wen and Duke Huan, the poet praises their wisdom. The text reflects his admiration for great leadership.

poetry_han_d4572987.title: To Wine
poetry_han_d4572987.summary: This poem depicts an ideal peaceful era of prosperity and social harmony. It reflects the poet's longing for benevolent governance and a tranquil society.

poetry_han_21d32200.title: Though the Tortoise Lives Long
poetry_han_21d32200.summary: Starting with the mortality of mythical creatures, the poem shifts to the poet's indomitable spirit in old age. It conveys a proactive life philosophy and inspiring strength.

poetry_han_9bea8007.title: Ballad of Haoli
poetry_han_9bea8007.summary: The poem records the devastation of war, shifting to lament the suffering caused by warlord conflicts. It expresses the poet's deep sorrow for the ruined lives.

poetry_han_b1d8964d.title: Essence and Arrangement
poetry_han_b1d8964d.summary: The poem explores the inevitable end of all things, then advises the noble to remain untroubled. It reveals the poet's broad-minded and detached attitude toward life.

poetry_han_f7745dcb.title: Bitter Cold Journey
poetry_han_f7745dcb.summary: The poem describes the perilous journey through the Taihang Mountains, shifting to the poet's melancholy longing for home. The bleak scenery and loneliness evoke deep empathy.

poetry_han_363f299c.title: Sound of Exhalation, Part One
poetry_han_363f299c.summary: The poem depicts a joyous banquet in the celestial Huayin Mountains, celebrating the pleasure of divine company. It overflows with romantic imagination and a quest for immortality.

poetry_han_e711a558.title: Sound of Exhalation, Part Two
poetry_han_e711a558.summary: The poem narrates a fantastical journey across the seas, shifting to the importance of spiritual cultivation for longevity. It is steeped in myth, expressing a desire for transcendence.

poetry_han_8aa59e4a.title: Sound of Exhalation, Part Three
poetry_han_8aa59e4a.summary: The poem depicts a celestial feast at the Queen Mother's pavilion, shifting to blessings for the host's eternal life. Its ornate style leaves a sense of peace and auspiciousness.

poetry_han_aab962cb.title: Leaving East and West Gates
poetry_han_aab962cb.summary: The poet uses migrating geese and drifting weeds to lament the soldier's long service. The ending reflects a deep longing for home and a desire for stability.

poetry_han_f581ef49.title: On the Embankment
poetry_han_f581ef49.summary: The poem uses discarded objects to symbolize a woman cast aside by slander. It shifts toward seeking transcendence, finding solace and longevity amidst sorrow.

poetry_han_70f31b36.title: Dew on the Scallion
poetry_han_70f31b36.summary: The poem depicts the corruption of the late Han court and the nation's collapse. It concludes with mourning for Luoyang, revealing profound anxiety and indignation.

poetry_han_70ce4005.title: On the Mulberry Fields
poetry_han_70ce4005.summary: The poet describes a magnificent, fantastical journey to immortality. It concludes by pursuing eternal life, showcasing a desire to transcend the mortal realm.

poetry_han_1297413e.title: Ballad of Qiu Hu, Part One
poetry_han_1297413e.summary: The poet meets an immortal while climbing Sanguan Mountain, lamenting life's hardships. The ending reflects melancholy and helplessness as the immortal vanishes.

poetry_han_f133adb7.title: Autumn Hu Song II
poetry_han_f133adb7.summary: The poet explores the philosophy of eternal nature versus fleeting human life. It concludes by advocating for acceptance of fate and pursuing vitality within limited time.

poetry_han_5decf9eb.title: Goodness Song I
poetry_han_5decf9eb.summary: The poem lists the rise and fall of ancient sages and hegemons. It concludes by reflecting on history to contemplate the principles of governance and virtue.

poetry_han_8acad0be.title: Goodness Song II
poetry_han_8acad0be.summary: The poet recounts the sorrow of a humble background and unrecognized talent. The ending expresses deep loneliness and helplessness in the face of unfulfilled loyalty.

poetry_han_905b5b89.title: Goodness Song III
poetry_han_905b5b89.summary: The poem shifts from festive feasting to reflections on life's transience. It concludes with a desire for detachment from worldly glory.

poetry_han_6914463a.title: Xia Men Marching Song: Beauty
poetry_han_6914463a.summary: The poet wanders through vast landscapes, feeling lost in contemplation. Reaching the sea, he is overcome by a sense of melancholy.

poetry_han_8fa6291c.title: Xia Men Marching Song: October
poetry_han_8fa6291c.summary: The poem depicts the stillness of early winter as nature prepares for dormancy. It reflects the poet's ambition amidst the seasonal cycle.

poetry_han_2ca0d206.title: Xia Men Marching Song: Different Lands
poetry_han_2ca0d206.summary: The harsh, frozen landscape of the north highlights the struggles of the virtuous and the brave. It leaves a tone of sorrow.

poetry_han_ce587f17.title: Folk Song
poetry_han_ce587f17.summary: The poet laments his poverty when a friend asks for a loan. It captures the raw frustration of being unable to help.

poetry_han_2782be3e.title: Dong Tao Song
poetry_han_2782be3e.summary: Virtue cannot prevent sudden tragedy, as shown by the deaths of scholars. The poem leaves a somber feeling of life's fragility.

poetry_five_dynasties_40414f4f.title: Night Crow Cry: Last Night
poetry_five_dynasties_40414f4f.summary: Autumn rain triggers reflections on the dream-like nature of life. The poet seeks solace in intoxication to escape his reality.

poetry_five_dynasties_77aee215.title: One Peck of Pearls: Dawn Makeup
poetry_five_dynasties_77aee215.summary: The poem captures a woman's morning routine and playful demeanor. It leaves a vivid, charming image of intimacy and joy.

poetry_five_dynasties_05918cb5.title: Midnight Song: Life's Sorrows
poetry_five_dynasties_05918cb5.summary: The poet wakes from a dream of his lost kingdom to find himself alone in tears. Past glories have vanished like a dream, leaving only profound sorrow.

poetry_five_dynasties_baae0e00.title: Riverside Immortal: Cherry Blossoms
poetry_five_dynasties_baae0e00.summary: As late spring cherry blossoms fall, the poet feels lonely amidst the evening mist. Holding a silk belt, he looks back with lingering, painful regret.

poetry_five_dynasties_90bdaf9a.title: Southern Land Song: How Many Tears
poetry_five_dynasties_90bdaf9a.summary: Tears flow continuously as the poet resolves to keep his inner pain unspoken. His heart is broken, leaving only a sense of inescapable grief.

poetry_five_dynasties_7e06d0cb.title: Southern Land Song: How Much Hate
poetry_five_dynasties_7e06d0cb.summary: A dream recreates the past splendor of the royal gardens and bustling crowds. Waking to reality, the poet is overwhelmed by a deep, unspoken hatred.

poetry_five_dynasties_e39f6b1a.title: Clear Peace Music: Half a Spring
poetry_five_dynasties_e39f6b1a.summary: Mid-spring blossoms fall, triggering a deep sense of separation. Like endless spring grass, the poet's longing grows the further he travels.

poetry_five_dynasties_ac3ab990.title: Mulberry Picker: Spring in Courtyard
poetry_five_dynasties_ac3ab990.summary: Spring fades in the courtyard, and the poet remains melancholy under a light drizzle. In the quiet room, he seeks solace only in dreams.

poetry_five_dynasties_123f64a1.title: Joyful Oriole: Fading Moon
poetry_five_dynasties_123f64a1.summary: The poet wakes to a fading moon and a lonely hall. He leaves the fallen petals unswept, waiting for someone who will never return.

poetry_five_dynasties_0a763351.title: Butterflies Love Flowers: Wandering
poetry_five_dynasties_0a763351.summary: Wandering on a rainy spring night, the poet hears laughter from a swing. This joy highlights his own isolation, leaving his heart nowhere to rest.

poetry_five_dynasties_22a24521.title: Meeting with Joy: Fallen Flowers
poetry_five_dynasties_22a24521.summary: Spring flowers wither, reflecting the fleeting nature of life and endless regret. It leaves a deep sense of sorrow over lost time.

poetry_five_dynasties_48543b37.title: Everlasting Longing: Cloud Swirl
poetry_five_dynasties_48543b37.summary: A beauty stands alone amidst autumn rain and wind. The long night evokes a poignant sense of loneliness and helplessness.

poetry_five_dynasties_1b5d4d64.title: Beating Silk Tune: Deep Courtyard
poetry_five_dynasties_1b5d4d64.summary: The sound of silk-beating in a quiet courtyard keeps the speaker awake. It leaves a lingering feeling of nocturnal melancholy.

poetry_five_dynasties_1e715dc1.title: Washing Stream Sands: Red Sun
poetry_five_dynasties_1e715dc1.summary: The palace is filled with music and dancing beauties. The scene captures an atmosphere of indulgence and fleeting luxury.

poetry_five_dynasties_cf91eff2.title: River Plum View: Distant Dream
poetry_five_dynasties_cf91eff2.summary: Dreams traverse the spring and autumn of the south. The contrast between past beauty and present solitude evokes deep nostalgia.

poetry_five_dynasties_28644ffb.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian: Mist Covered
poetry_five_dynasties_28644ffb.summary: A woman steals away to meet her lover under the moonlight. It captures a moment of intense, secret passion and longing.

poetry_five_dynasties_835a856c.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian: Penglai Palace
poetry_five_dynasties_835a856c.summary: A woman wakes from a nap to find her lover, sharing a tender gaze. The scene is filled with intimate, romantic affection.

poetry_five_dynasties_59048802.title: Bodhisattva Barbarian: Bronze Reeds
poetry_five_dynasties_59048802.summary: Secret glances are exchanged during a banquet, but the end brings only emptiness. It leaves a sense of fading, dreamlike desire.

poetry_five_dynasties_4254d9c8.title: Ruan Lang Returns: To Prince Zheng
poetry_five_dynasties_4254d9c8.summary: Spring dusk blends fallen flowers with fading music. The poet leans alone on the railing, lamenting the sorrow of fleeting time.

poetry_five_dynasties_a60ad62c.title: Wave Washing Sand: Past Sorrows
poetry_five_dynasties_a60ad62c.summary: Autumn winds bring desolation to the courtyard, where past memories remain unreachable. The moon shines over the Qinhuang River, leaving endless grief.

poetry_five_dynasties_5178cb33.title: Mulberry Picker: Well in Autumn
poetry_five_dynasties_5178cb33.summary: Autumn rain on paulownia trees stirs sorrow, and waking from dreams brings longing for the distance. Cold waves block all messages, leaving only despair.

poetry_five_dynasties_fff18e32.title: Beautiful Lady Yu: Wind Returns
poetry_five_dynasties_fff18e32.summary: Spring returns, yet the poet is changed, trapped in a deep, candlelit chamber. With graying hair, he struggles with the pain of contrast.

poetry_five_dynasties_38430cbd.title: Jade Tower Spring: Evening Makeup
poetry_five_dynasties_38430cbd.summary: Palace music and dance fill the air with luxury. The poet revels in the spring night, anticipating a romantic ride under the moon.

poetry_five_dynasties_0517fca1.title: Midnight Song: Early Spring Search
poetry_five_dynasties_0517fca1.summary: Spring fades quickly, so the poet urges timely enjoyment of flowers. He drinks and writes poetry with friends, savoring a brief, joyful moment.

poetry_five_dynasties_7ebcb9bb.title: Thanks New Grace: Qin Tower Unseen
poetry_five_dynasties_7ebcb9bb.summary: Spring breezes stir flowers, awakening memories of the past. Waking to see the willows, the poet is left with a dreamlike, lingering melancholy.

poetry_five_dynasties_a5a13d8e.title: Thanks New Grace: Cherry Blossoms Fade
poetry_five_dynasties_a5a13d8e.summary: Cherry blossoms fall as the poet leans alone by the window. Memories return, and the bitterness of longing intensifies within his drunken dreams.

poetry_five_dynasties_9d0ae301.title: Thanks New Grace: Empty Courtyard
poetry_five_dynasties_9d0ae301.summary: The courtyard is empty under the crescent moon, stirring deep sorrow. A sudden flute melody breaks the drunken dream, leaving only endless regret.

poetry_five_dynasties_80a40888.title: Thanks New Grace: Spring Weary
poetry_five_dynasties_80a40888.summary: Cherry blossoms fall as spring fades away. The speaker waits by the window all night, yet the lover remains absent.

poetry_five_dynasties_56a1ecbb.title: Thanks New Grace: Autumn Light Fleeting
poetry_five_dynasties_56a1ecbb.summary: Autumn light fades with red leaves covering the steps. Climbing high, the poet hears geese crying, evoking long-standing, recurring grief.

poetry_five_dynasties_f58c114a.title: Breaking Formation: Forty Years
poetry_five_dynasties_f58c114a.summary: Past imperial glory is lost to the status of a captive. Recalling the panicked departure, only tears accompany the songs of farewell.

poetry_five_dynasties_a8841799.title: Washing Stream Sands: Wind Presses Clouds
poetry_five_dynasties_a8841799.summary: In the spring garden, the frail poet feels weary. With no news from afar, only the falling flowers understand his deep melancholy.

poetry_five_dynasties_1046aa51.title: Everlasting Longing: A Mountain Layer
poetry_five_dynasties_1046aa51.summary: Layered mountains and cold mist separate the lovers. As geese fly away, the lonely poet is left with only the wind and moon.

poetry_five_dynasties_38845c75.title: Willow Branch: Fading Charm
poetry_five_dynasties_38845c75.summary: Spring fades and youth wanes. The willow branches brush against the head like an old friend, stirring memories of the past.

poetry_five_dynasties_057b000d.title: Rear Courtyard Flower: Jade Trees
poetry_five_dynasties_057b000d.summary: The jade trees and flowers remain as beautiful as ever. The poet prays for time to pause, preserving youth and eternal joy.

poetry_five_dynasties_70213bfe.title: Three Platforms: Sleepless Night
poetry_five_dynasties_70213bfe.summary: The poet wanders out on a sleepless, chilly autumn night. The cold moonlight and whistling wind evoke a profound sense of loneliness.

poetry_five_dynasties_77d4189c.title: Pounding Laundry: Disheveled Hair
poetry_five_dynasties_77d4189c.summary: A woman with disheveled hair leans against the railing, weeping in longing. Her furrowed brow reveals an inescapable, lingering sorrow.

poetry_five_dynasties_771c1d1b.title: Washing Stream Sands: Fleeting Dream
poetry_five_dynasties_771c1d1b.summary: Dreaming of his lost kingdom, the poet finds only emptiness and change. As time flows away like water, he is left in tears.

poetry_five_dynasties_9fda2ca2.title: Fisherman: Thousand-Mile Snow
poetry_five_dynasties_9fda2ca2.summary: Drifting on the river amidst spring blossoms and wine, the poet finds joy. This escape into nature reveals a sense of ultimate freedom.

poetry_tang_622981cb.title: Drum Song: Up to the Clouds
poetry_tang_622981cb.summary: The emperor indulges in extravagant palace life and endless feasts. Yet, the neglected beauties highlight the underlying emptiness of such luxury.

poetry_tang_749a55aa.title: Drum Song: Battle South City
poetry_tang_749a55aa.summary: The poem depicts the brutality and endless slaughter of frontier wars. Through images of bleached bones, it reflects deeply on war's cruelty.

poetry_tang_7fff6c3b.title: Drum Song: My Yellow Steed
poetry_tang_7fff6c3b.summary: Two friends ride through Luoyang, celebrating their spirited bond. The poet reflects that true friendship is proven only in times of adversity.

poetry_tang_59e61943.title: Drum Song: What I Ponder
poetry_tang_59e61943.summary: Longing for an immortal across the vast, stormy sea, the poet feels blocked by nature. He entrusts his hope to a bird, feeling deep melancholy.

poetry_tang_25ee5fa1.title: Drum Song: Pheasant Son Class
poetry_tang_25ee5fa1.summary: The poet uses the pheasant's refusal of a golden cage to express a yearning for freedom and integrity. This spirit ultimately transcends into a sense of harmony with the universe.

poetry_tang_f5573ce1.title: Flute Song: Breaking Willows
poetry_tang_f5573ce1.summary: Amidst the vibrant spring willows, a beauty breaks a branch to send to her distant lover, revealing deep sorrow. The contrast weaves together the beauty of spring and the melancholy of longing.

poetry_tang_9b876dac.title: Flute Song: Frontier Two
poetry_tang_9b876dac.summary: Standing at the desolate frontier, the poet gazes toward the capital, feeling lonely before the endless Yellow River. This longing for home sparks deep reflection on the journey and the unknown.

poetry_tang_b53042a6.title: Matching Song: Long Song
poetry_tang_b53042a6.summary: Facing the desolation of ancient tombs, the poet laments the brevity of life and the impermanence of the world. This sorrow over history eventually transforms into an acceptance of living in the moment.

poetry_tang_7af4173a.title: Matching Song: Marching Army
poetry_tang_7af4173a.summary: The harsh frontier life and years of war lead the poet to regret trading his pen for a sword. This frustration with reality reveals a deep longing for a peaceful life.

poetry_tang_cad3f864.title: Matching Song: Marching Army II
poetry_tang_cad3f864.summary: The flute music from the watchtower echoes in the autumn wind, stirring the soldiers' longing for their loved ones. Under the desolate moon, the poem is filled with unresolvable sorrow.

poetry_tang_02079656.title: Matching Song: Marching Army III
poetry_tang_02079656.summary: Amidst the frontier music, the pipa plays new tunes that evoke old partings. Under the autumn moon at the Great Wall, the sorrow of the border lingers endlessly.

poetry_tang_092be8d7.title: Matching Song: Marching Army IV
poetry_tang_092be8d7.summary: The lonely fortress and snowy mountains by Qinghai Lake depict the vast, desolate frontier. The soldiers' resolve to fight until victory is achieved stirs a sense of heroic determination.

poetry_tang_bfd12830.title: Matching Song: Free Song
poetry_tang_bfd12830.summary: The poet depicts the prosperity of Luoyang, revealing his conflict between serving the state and living in seclusion. He ultimately chooses to abandon worldly ambition for inner peace.

poetry_tang_6db7181a.title: Matching Song: Changxin Lament I
poetry_tang_6db7181a.summary: In the cold autumn night, a neglected concubine sits alone amidst falling leaves. The rhythmic sound of the water clock highlights her deep sorrow and loneliness.

poetry_tang_34724847.title: Matching Song: Lotus Picking I
poetry_tang_34724847.summary: Southern girls play among lotus flowers in their boats. As they return under the moonlight, the scene is filled with joy and poetic beauty.

poetry_tang_18e7387e.title: Matching Song: Lotus Picking II
poetry_tang_18e7387e.summary: The lotus pickers' skirts blend perfectly with the leaves, making them invisible. Only when their singing drifts over does one realize they are hidden in the pond.

poetry_tang_264429fe.title: Matching Song: Lotus Picking III
poetry_tang_264429fe.summary: A girl rows her boat to pick lotus flowers, cautioning to spare the leaves. This reflects a delicate appreciation and care for the beauty of nature.

poetry_tang_c8ffd9cf.title: Misc. Song: Youth Travel I
poetry_tang_c8ffd9cf.summary: A young knight sees off a friend, only to hear of a border crisis. He ignores personal safety to rush into battle, displaying heroic spirit.

poetry_tang_7b391c89.title: Misc. Song: Youth Travel II
poetry_tang_7b391c89.summary: Young friends drink and bond in the western tower. They cherish their camaraderie, determined not to waste their youth.

poetry_tang_aa5ca841.title: Misc. Song: Hard Road Changed
poetry_tang_aa5ca841.summary: With war clouds gathering at the border, soldiers march to the front. To win glory, they cast aside thoughts of home and commit to the fight.

poetry_tang_ab285155.title: Hard Road Changed
poetry_tang_ab285155.summary: Soldiers prepare for battle at the Yin Mountains, eager for glory. The harsh frontier scene conveys their resolute sacrifice of home for military honor.

poetry_tang_444a3db7.title: Frontier Song III
poetry_tang_444a3db7.summary: Massive conscription leads to widespread death and suffering. The poet urges the court to redirect resources to the frontier, reflecting deep concern for war's toll.

poetry_tang_b7b1c339.title: Frontier Song IV
poetry_tang_b7b1c339.summary: After a great general dies, his troops mourn while others are purged. The bleak frontier setting highlights the tragic fate of loyal, discarded heroes.

poetry_tang_79735e5d.title: Frontier Song
poetry_tang_79735e5d.summary: Soldiers fight bravely in the autumn wind only to face imprisonment. The poem captures the bitterness of loyal troops betrayed by their own government.

poetry_tang_75466796.title: Marching Army II
poetry_tang_75466796.summary: Intense frontier battles leave soldiers shivering in the cold. Post-battle desolation and longing for home culminate in a profound sense of sorrow.

poetry_tang_9434c0d7.title: Youth Travel I
poetry_tang_9434c0d7.summary: A young knight rides swiftly toward the battlefield with high spirits. The poem celebrates the heroic, fearless nature of youth answering the nation's call.

poetry_tang_7edfa76b.title: Youth Travel II
poetry_tang_7edfa76b.summary: Young men drink together, valuing friendship above all else. The poem conveys a spirit of living in the moment and cherishing deep bonds.

poetry_tang_fea7f3ac.title: Long Song
poetry_tang_fea7f3ac.summary: Contemplating ancient ruins and the transience of life, the poet feels the weight of history. He finds solace in wine and song amidst uncertainty.

poetry_tang_165119ed.title: Sorrowful Song
poetry_tang_165119ed.summary: Facing the shifting Taihang Mountains, the poet reflects on life's brevity and nature's vitality. He embraces the hermit's path, leaving a transcendent feeling.

poetry_tang_49d250cf.title: Ancient Intent
poetry_tang_49d250cf.summary: Peach blossoms and orioles contrast with a lonely mirror stand at dusk. Zither music under moonlight and spring wind evokes deep sorrow.

poetry_tang_7e2ccd3d.title: Free Song
poetry_tang_7e2ccd3d.summary: Responding to a summons, the poet rejects courtly pursuits for freedom. His spirited song reveals detachment from worldly fame and hidden helplessness.

poetry_tang_906f4004.title: Yue Maiden
poetry_tang_906f4004.summary: A maiden rows on a misty lake gathering lotuses, playfully asking her husband about her beauty. The poem brims with vibrant rural charm.

poetry_tang_a38826e7.title: To Feng and Yuan
poetry_tang_a38826e7.summary: Friends converse late in Zheng County, lamenting unfulfilled talents and official hardships. Accompanied by cool winds, it leaves an open yet resigned mood.

poetry_tang_c925b78d.title: Listening to Wind Into Pines
poetry_tang_c925b78d.summary: Night zither music mirrors serene pine winds and dewy bamboos, understood only by a soulmate. It leaves a chilled, profound resonance of reclusion.

poetry_tang_0f0167c7.title: To Shen Xingzong
poetry_tang_0f0167c7.summary: Friends feast by a serene stream, forgetting worldly cares amidst nature. Their future pact to meet leaves a yearning for transcendent reclusion.

poetry_tang_a942dbf8.title: For Zhang Gui to Yan
poetry_tang_a942dbf8.summary: Using the tale of Bian He offering jade, the poet laments being misunderstood and slandered. Despite appreciation, he fears malice, leaving a bitter sigh.

poetry_tang_520fd44c.title: To Shi Zhao
poetry_tang_520fd44c.summary: Under the moonlit autumn sky, the poet watches geese fly south and feels deep longing. The sound of water amplifies his sorrow, leaving him with the melancholy of separation.

poetry_tang_6dd73f71.title: Autumn Mountains to Chen
poetry_tang_6dd73f71.summary: As autumn frost descends, the poet lies awake missing his friend. Watching the geese fly south, he is overcome by the profound loneliness of being separated from his companion.

poetry_tang_0aed7463.title: From Chen to Zhang Eleven
poetry_tang_0aed7463.summary: Living in seclusion, the poet reflects on nature and human destiny amidst the pain of separation. Watching a lone goose vanish into the night, he finds a sense of detachment.

poetry_tang_940f42a2.title: Stay at Ba on Yi
poetry_tang_940f42a2.summary: Drinking alone at Ba, the poet reflects on border wars and political stagnation. His gaze at the moon reveals deep concern for the state and his own unfulfilled ambitions.

poetry_tang_3fbc4eae.title: Reply to Chen Zanfu
poetry_tang_3fbc4eae.summary: Gazing toward the distant mountains and rivers, the poet laments his separation from a friend. Dreams of past joy fade into a lingering, persistent longing for the capital.

poetry_tang_cc8a0d90.title: Reply for Fufeng Host
poetry_tang_cc8a0d90.summary: A veteran recounts the horrors of war, prompting a somber reflection on past suffering. The poem ends with a poignant appreciation for the current era of peace.

poetry_tang_1b1d8b1f.title: Reply to Pei from Honglu
poetry_tang_1b1d8b1f.summary: After the rain, the poet climbs a tower to reflect on history with a friend. The serene atmosphere inspires a desire to transcend worldly concerns and pursue his aspirations.

poetry_tang_5ec79a4e.title: Farewell to Ren Wu
poetry_tang_5ec79a4e.summary: As a friend departs for Guilin, the poet watches the boat vanish under the mountain moon. The cold autumn scene highlights their shared commitment to integrity despite exile.

poetry_tang_23bbf8e7.title: Mountain Farewell
poetry_tang_23bbf8e7.summary: The poet retreats to a moonlit mountain path to embrace solitude. This scene evokes a sense of pure, detached integrity.

poetry_tang_948702c3.title: Farewell to Zhang and Guo
poetry_tang_948702c3.summary: Friends share a final drink by the river before parting ways. The sorrow of farewell is tempered by mutual trust and noble resolve.

poetry_tang_04745b15.title: Farewell to Wei
poetry_tang_04745b15.summary: Bound by duty, the poet watches his friend sail away. The scene reflects a poignant mix of professional frustration and longing for freedom.

poetry_tang_660b06ef.title: Night at Baima Temple
poetry_tang_660b06ef.summary: Friends gather at Baima Temple under a cool summer moon. The serene atmosphere leaves a feeling of detachment and peaceful reflection.

poetry_tang_3c4c69db.title: Farewell
poetry_tang_3c4c69db.summary: Willow branches line the river, yet frequent partings make them symbols of sorrow. The poem captures the inevitable pain of saying goodbye.

poetry_tang_db802664.title: Liangzhou Song Two
poetry_tang_db802664.summary: The solemn border altar highlights the emperor's martial strength and resolve. It leaves the reader with a sense of national pride.

poetry_tang_58b6cbc9.title: Banquet Song
poetry_tang_58b6cbc9.summary: As spring waters flow, the poet urges his friend to delay the departure. The plea reveals a deep attachment to the fleeting moment.

poetry_tang_87953638.title: Ninth Day Farewell
poetry_tang_87953638.summary: On the Double Ninth Festival, friends share chrysanthemum wine before parting. The impending separation leaves a lingering sense of melancholy.

poetry_tang_47bf0567.title: New Bride Song Three
poetry_tang_47bf0567.summary: A new bride prepares soup, cautiously asking her sister-in-law to taste it first. The scene is intimate, capturing a bride's careful, shy devotion.

poetry_tang_b2f0b4d4.title: Old Palace
poetry_tang_b2f0b4d4.summary: In a desolate palace, aging maids reminisce about the emperor amidst lonely flowers. The contrast between past glory and present decay evokes deep melancholy.

poetry_tang_c1efa52c.title: Flute Song: Longtou Water
poetry_tang_c1efa52c.summary: The wailing waters of the border stir deep longing in the weary soldier. The harsh landscape and the sound of the river evoke a profound sense of isolation.

poetry_tang_dab1e434.title: Flute Song: Watching Travelers
poetry_tang_dab1e434.summary: A woman waits daily for her traveler, finding him only in dreams. Her graying hair in the mirror reflects the bitterness of an endless, lonely wait.

poetry_tang_9d77b52a.title: Border Pass Moon Tune
poetry_tang_9d77b52a.summary: Moonlight reveals piles of bones on the frozen border as icy winds bite. The harsh imagery highlights the cold, brutal reality of war.

poetry_tang_a0f72b87.title: Chorus Song: Don't Cross River
poetry_tang_a0f72b87.summary: A wife begs her husband not to cross the treacherous river, but he dies before her eyes. The tragic ending leaves behind only regret and sorrow.

poetry_tang_435a1991.title: Chorus Song: Picking Mulberries
poetry_tang_435a1991.summary: A girl picks mulberry leaves while her heart dwells on her lover in the tower. The pastoral scene is filled with the warmth of youthful longing.

poetry_tang_e4fdcf94.title: Chorus Song: Short Song
poetry_tang_e4fdcf94.summary: Life is as brief as a sunrise, passing in the blink of an eye. The poem urges us to cherish the present, lamenting the inevitable passage of time.

poetry_tang_c8408543.title: Chorus Song: Army March
poetry_tang_c8408543.summary: Soldiers endure harsh frontier life, looking back only to find sorrow. The poem captures the cruelty of war and the pain of separation.

poetry_tang_d9777828.title: Chorus Song: Watering Horses
poetry_tang_d9777828.summary: The Great Wall is littered with bones, yet soldiers die without reward. This bleak scene reveals the futility of war and the soldiers' despair.

poetry_tang_40b08150.title: Chorus Song: Night Crow
poetry_tang_40b08150.summary: A crow cries at midnight, refusing to leave despite being chased away. It symbolizes an inescapable sorrow and a fated, persistent haunting.

poetry_tang_b75fc3c0.title: Chorus Song: Crow Perching
poetry_tang_b75fc3c0.summary: Palace maids gaze at the moon in the cold night air. The poem is filled with the loneliness of the palace and the passage of time.

poetry_tang_48a91f8b.title: Dance Song: Dulu Song
poetry_tang_48a91f8b.summary: The world is in chaos, where the weak are preyed upon. The imagery expresses deep frustration with social injustice and human malice.

poetry_tang_fcff1bf1.title: Dance Song: White Ramie One
poetry_tang_fcff1bf1.summary: Dancers in white ramie perform amidst a lavish, moonlit night. The scene conveys a sense of decadent indulgence behind the beauty.

poetry_tang_16dc5ea1.title: Dance Song: White Ramie Two
poetry_tang_16dc5ea1.summary: Palace festivities last all night as beauties dance in drunken grace. Beneath the splendor lies a humble plea for the emperor's lasting favor.

poetry_tang_8a14ed57.title: Dance Song: Rainbow Skirt One
poetry_tang_8a14ed57.summary: A musician crafts the Rainbow Skirt dance, seeking the emperor's presence. It reflects an intense devotion to art and reverence for the throne.

poetry_tang_80905fad.title: Dance Song: Rainbow Skirt Two
poetry_tang_80905fad.summary: Music drifts through curtains, sounding like celestial chanting. It creates an ethereal and transcendent auditory atmosphere.

poetry_tang_cdc94fba.title: Dance Song: Rainbow Skirt Three
poetry_tang_cdc94fba.summary: Dancers perform all night and receive imperial robes. This highlights the immense prestige of palace performances.

poetry_tang_8d778f69.title: Dance Song: Rainbow Skirt Four
poetry_tang_8d778f69.summary: The new score is restricted and exclusively gifted to officials. This emphasizes the music's exclusivity and mystery.

poetry_tang_316a2985.title: Dance Song: Rainbow Skirt Five
poetry_tang_316a2985.summary: The Consort accompanies the dance, mastering every beat. It showcases her profound expertise in the music.

poetry_tang_cb324e58.title: Dance Song: Rainbow Skirt Six
poetry_tang_cb324e58.summary: The music echoes through the mountains, echoing the Emperor bidding farewell to the Queen Mother. It depicts a mythical grandeur.

poetry_tang_5fbd5b3a.title: Dance Song: Rainbow Skirt Seven
poetry_tang_5fbd5b3a.summary: Palace maids dance under the stars after bathing. It presents a beautiful and lively night at the palace.

poetry_tang_3d87bc74.title: Dance Song: Rainbow Skirt Eight
poetry_tang_3d87bc74.summary: The troupe rehearses while the Consort watches from above. It reveals the splendor and order of court life.

poetry_tang_a321b1ac.title: Dance Song: Rainbow Skirt Nine
poetry_tang_a321b1ac.summary: Amidst autumn wind and dew, maids dance in shifts under the moon. It evokes a cold and profound palace atmosphere.

poetry_tang_78e2172f.title: Dance Song: Rainbow Skirt Ten
poetry_tang_78e2172f.summary: The poem depicts the past glory of Huaqing Palace, shifting to lament the Rainbow Skirt dance as a song of parting. It leaves a lingering sense of nostalgia for a lost era.

poetry_tang_1ff87312.title: Zither Song: Farewell Crane
poetry_tang_1ff87312.summary: Describing the loneliness of cranes after their master leaves, the poem shifts to wonder about their fate in the snow. The bleak imagery conveys sorrow over loyalty and separation.

poetry_tang_121570f2.title: Misc Song: Imperial Guards
poetry_tang_121570f2.summary: The poem exposes the crimes of Chang'an thugs, shifting to mock the imperial pardons that grant them impunity. It is filled with indignation toward corruption and social injustice.

poetry_tang_422ea4d9.title: Misc Song: Empty City Sparrow
poetry_tang_422ea4d9.summary: Through the sparrow's struggle in an empty city, the poem shifts to advise it to hide for safety. It reveals deep sympathy for the precarious existence of the weak.

poetry_tang_dfc4896a.title: Misc Song: Palace Terrace One
poetry_tang_dfc4896a.summary: The poem depicts leisurely palace amusements, shifting focus to the emperor's attire and presence. It creates an atmosphere of opulent and tranquil court life.

poetry_tang_bbc706e6.title: Misc Song: Palace Terrace Two
poetry_tang_bbc706e6.summary: Describing the lush flowers and grass around the palace, the poem shifts to wish the emperor eternal life. It expresses a hopeful vision of enduring imperial power.

poetry_tang_6574247f.title: Miscellaneous Qu Songs: Three Stages of Jiangnan, Part 1
poetry_tang_6574247f.summary: The poem depicts separated lovers in Yangzhou and Changgan, shifting to their shared prayers for news. It captures the profound anxiety and helplessness caused by separation.

poetry_tang_966d4568.title: Miscellaneous Songs and Ballads, Jiangnan Santai, Part 2
poetry_tang_966d4568.summary: The poem sketches the desolate landscapes of Jiangnan, shifting to the traveler's arduous journey through wind and rain. It evokes a sense of loneliness and hardship.

poetry_tang_a8fdde9a.title: Miscellaneous Songs Of Jiangnan, Third Of Four
poetry_tang_a8fdde9a.summary: Flowers bloom and fall as people pass by, highlighting the fleeting nature of time. Faced with inevitable aging, one reflects on the brevity of life.

poetry_tang_74d10ae5.title: Miscellaneous Qu Songs: Three Stages of Jiangnan, No. 4
poetry_tang_74d10ae5.summary: The poet urges enjoying life while healthy, as aging is irreversible. He laments how quickly a lifetime passes, leaving a sense of futility.

poetry_tang_286f549e.title: Autumn Night Song Part 1
poetry_tang_286f549e.summary: On a cold autumn night, a woman pines for her distant husband. The desolate scene and her sorrowful longing create a profound sense of loneliness.

poetry_tang_418d3eeb.title: Autumn Night Song Part 2
poetry_tang_418d3eeb.summary: By a dim autumn lamp, a woman waits for her husband. The slow passage of time and the indifferent stars emphasize her lonely vigil.

poetry_tang_a169a2f9.title: Liaodong Journey Song
poetry_tang_a169a2f9.summary: The harsh Liaodong frontier brings soldiers only cold and death. The poem condemns war's cruelty and expresses a deep longing for home.

poetry_tang_91600b3e.title: Crossing Liao River Song
poetry_tang_91600b3e.summary: Crossing the Liao River feels like a final farewell to life. Gazing toward home, the soldiers are filled with despair at never returning.

poetry_tang_e9f047fa.title: Palace Playful Tune 1
poetry_tang_e9f047fa.summary: An ailing beauty hides her face behind a fan in the palace. As music fades, she is left in forgotten, melancholy isolation.

poetry_tang_883c4d1d.title: Palace Playful Tune 2
poetry_tang_883c4d1d.summary: Butterflies dance amidst spring blossoms in a joyful scene. Yet, as evening falls and birds cry, the fleeting beauty turns into subtle sorrow.

poetry_tang_319a31ed.title: Palace Playful Tune 3
poetry_tang_319a31ed.summary: A palace maid dresses in a jade tower, yet her heart is filled with sorrow over wasted time. As spring breezes blow, she reflects on a life spent in vain.

poetry_tang_e20dfa11.title: Palace Playful Tune 4
poetry_tang_e20dfa11.summary: Twilight falls over the white sand ferry, where vast waters mirror the traveler's sorrow. The cry of a lone partridge deepens the feeling of heartbreak.

poetry_tang_30aa9f83.title: Cock Crowing Ballad
poetry_tang_30aa9f83.summary: At the first cock's crow, officials and noblewomen begin their busy day. The scene captures the orderly, rhythmic life of the palace at dawn.

poetry_tang_756cfd78.title: Farewell to Someone
poetry_tang_756cfd78.summary: The poet urges his friend to cast aside sorrow and boldly pursue his future. He argues that life is inherently transient, requiring one to sever attachments to move forward.

poetry_tang_abf97c01.title: My Host's Old Pavilion
poetry_tang_abf97c01.summary: Visiting a friend's abandoned pavilion, the poet reflects on the decay of past glory. He laments the transience of life, leaving him with a lingering sense of melancholy.

poetry_tang_265eb678.title: Ancient Military Poem
poetry_tang_265eb678.summary: Soldiers endure the hardships of war and physical wounds in the desolate frontier. Looking back, they find home unreachable, leaving only the sound of weeping women behind.

poetry_tang_02a5088a.title: Handan Host
poetry_tang_02a5088a.summary: A traveler in Handan receives a quilt from a tavern girl, symbolizing a deep, fleeting connection. As he departs, he cherishes the hope of eternal loyalty.

poetry_tang_835b4f65.title: Floating Water Tune
poetry_tang_835b4f65.summary: Friends drift on a boat, drinking and singing amidst the beauty of autumn. They cherish this fleeting joy, knowing such perfect moments are rare and irreplaceable.

poetry_tang_ab4ad463.title: Jiangnan Style Part 1
poetry_tang_ab4ad463.summary: Autumn winds blow by the river amidst falling osmanthus. Returning to a place of parting, the poet is filled with melancholy by insect sounds.

poetry_tang_808a5583.title: Jiangnan Style Part 2
poetry_tang_808a5583.summary: Spring grass covers Jiangnan while the traveler wanders in Xiaoxiang. Homesickness stirs with the geese, leaving only the scent of orchids in the empty hills.

poetry_tang_8fefd81c.title: Jiangnan Melody
poetry_tang_8fefd81c.summary: A couple rows boats on the river, dressed with care. Longing grows, and they seek to express their deep affection through song.

poetry_tang_eab7995a.title: Wang Zhaojun Melody
poetry_tang_eab7995a.summary: A greedy painter betrays Zhaojun, who is sent to the frontier. Her lute carries endless sorrow, leaving the Han palace forever devoid of spring.

poetry_tang_392b1347.title: No Sorrow, Yet Sorrow Song
poetry_tang_392b1347.summary: The poem uses surreal imagery to depict the impermanence of life. After splendor fades, only desolation and traces of blood remain.

poetry_tang_c1b25eec.title: Willow Branch Song 1
poetry_tang_c1b25eec.summary: Drinking to ease sorrow, the poet urges against sadness. Since parting is life's greatest pain, even the spring breeze cannot hold the willow branches.

poetry_tang_32d5894f.title: Willow Branch Song 2
poetry_tang_32d5894f.summary: Willows sway in the mist under the setting sun. The poet asks travelers not to break the branches, keeping half for parting and half for return.

poetry_tang_ab1e995d.title: Lady Li Ballad 1
poetry_tang_ab1e995d.summary: The poem depicts a woman's grooming with delicate grace. As the moon sets and stars emerge, a subtle sense of longing and sorrow lingers.

poetry_tang_9a76b919.title: Lady Li Ballad 2
poetry_tang_9a76b919.summary: The poet depicts gathering lotus and dogwood, lamenting that beauty cannot be captured. It conveys a sense of helpless melancholy over fleeting moments.

poetry_tang_42a001cf.title: Lady Li Ballad 3
poetry_tang_42a001cf.summary: The poem layers ornate palace imagery before turning to mourn Lady Li's early death. Bleak autumn scenes and the Yellow River evoke a profound sense of tragedy.

poetry_tang_7f454cf3.title: Revisiting Saintess Shrine
poetry_tang_7f454cf3.summary: Revisiting the shrine, the poet reflects on the elusive nature of the immortal. Memories of the past leave a lingering sense of solitude and unfulfilled longing.

poetry_tang_091e17b1.title: To Luo Shaoxing
poetry_tang_091e17b1.summary: Amidst flowers and wine, the poet depicts a leisurely gathering with friends. It reveals a yearning for reclusive life and nostalgia for old companions.

poetry_tang_3004ef47.title: Gift to Linghu for Moon Viewing
poetry_tang_3004ef47.summary: Describing the cold beauty of the moonlit palace, the poet praises his friend's talent. The poem creates an elegant yet slightly detached atmosphere.

poetry_tang_93c086d4.title: Hermit Cui
poetry_tang_93c086d4.summary: The poet praises Hermit Cui’s indifference to fame and his filial piety. By highlighting his noble character, he expresses deep respect for such a reclusive life.

poetry_tang_4539144a.title: Self-Content
poetry_tang_4539144a.summary: The poet depicts the simple, natural joys of his humble home, revealing inner peace. This self-contentment reflects a spirit detached from worldly concerns.

poetry_tang_b49a4348.title: Poem on Monk's Wall
poetry_tang_b49a4348.summary: Reflecting on Buddhist truth, the poet explores the cycles of life and attachment. Through deep contemplation of religious imagery, he conveys a sense of Zen detachment.

poetry_tang_d31484be.title: Frosted Moon
poetry_tang_d31484be.summary: Autumn frost and moonlight illuminate a high tower, evoking a cold scene of goddesses competing in beauty. The poem leaves a sense of detached, elegant solitude.

poetry_tang_2bd39a3c.title: Strange Customs 1
poetry_tang_2bd39a3c.summary: The poet depicts a harsh, strange land filled with disease and superstition. It conveys deep anxiety and disdain for the oppressive environment.

poetry_tang_21cf0855.title: Strange Customs 2
poetry_tang_21cf0855.summary: This poem satirizes rampant superstition and corruption in a foreign land. It reflects the poet's frustration and critique of a chaotic society.

poetry_tang_43b3f637.title: Returning to Villa
poetry_tang_43b3f637.summary: The poet returns home to familiar sights, feeling joy and comfort. The pastoral scenery evokes a peaceful longing for his study.

poetry_tang_97426232.title: Shangyu
poetry_tang_97426232.summary: Traveling through Shangyu in autumn, the poet reflects on historical shifts. The desolate scenery reveals a complex longing for retirement and home.

poetry_tang_57b7a128.title: Reply to Peacock Song
poetry_tang_57b7a128.summary: The poet uses the peacock to depict beauty and the suffering of exile. Beneath the ornate language lies sorrow for a wandering life.

poetry_tang_435d9306.title: Human Desire
poetry_tang_435d9306.summary: Questioning heaven's impartiality, the poet highlights the ruler's ignorance of the people's suffering. The sharp tone reveals deep resentment toward political corruption.

poetry_tang_fbc5725e.title: Hua Mountain Temple
poetry_tang_fbc5725e.summary: Praying at the Hua Mountain temple, the poet uses mythology to express a desire for escapism. The ethereal scene reflects a weary detachment from worldly changes.

poetry_tang_96bae472.title: Huaqing Palace
poetry_tang_96bae472.summary: This poem critiques Emperor Xuanzong's obsession with Yang Guifei, which led to political ruin. It leaves a heavy sense of historical decline caused by imperial indulgence.

poetry_tang_4de07c4d.title: Chu Marsh
poetry_tang_4de07c4d.summary: The twilight frost scene evokes the poet's frustration and sense of displacement. The imagery of autumn travel leaves a lingering feeling of melancholy and solitude.

poetry_tang_d5b21cdf.title: Riverside Farewell Stroll
poetry_tang_d5b21cdf.summary: After a riverside farewell, the poet expresses anxiety over aging and unappreciated talent. It leaves a poignant sense of helplessness regarding the passage of time.

poetry_tang_ecbf3747.title: Tanzhou
poetry_tang_ecbf3747.summary: Gazing from a tower in Tanzhou, the poet reflects on historical sorrow and personal isolation. The inability to return home leaves a profound sense of desolation.

poetry_tang_36fb47d6.title: To Official Liu
poetry_tang_36fb47d6.summary: Reuniting with a friend by the river, the poet balances joy with lamentations over political misfortune. The meeting leaves a deep sense of sorrow and uncertainty.

poetry_tang_3a971793.title: Song: Youthful Journey
poetry_tang_3a971793.summary: The poem depicts the extravagant and hedonistic lifestyle of wealthy youths. It shifts to lament the fleeting nature of youth, leaving a sense of emptiness.

poetry_tang_556aacce.title: Song: Ancient Farewell
poetry_tang_556aacce.summary: The weeping willows and spring scenery heighten the sorrow of parting. This imagery leaves a lingering feeling of heartache and longing for the distant south.

poetry_tang_4a2570c9.title: Outside Yanxing Gate
poetry_tang_4a2570c9.summary: The scene captures the vibrant spring activity of noble carriages and travelers. The fatigue of the returning traveler leaves a subtle melancholy about the day's end.

poetry_tang_2809f574.title: Liu Deren's Tomb
poetry_tang_2809f574.summary: The poet mourns the talented but wronged Liu Deren. The desolate tomb, surrounded by sighing pines, evokes deep sorrow for his unfulfilled life.

poetry_tang_c08c0d1d.title: Failed Exam: Qinglong Temple
poetry_tang_c08c0d1d.summary: After failing the exam, the poet stays at a temple, contrasting worldly success with his own frustration. He turns to wine, expressing profound melancholy and uncertainty.

poetry_tang_014a27f0.title: Guozhou: Eastbrook Village
poetry_tang_014a27f0.summary: The poet depicts serene rural scenery and simple village life. Observing the fields and local interactions, he finds a sense of inner peace and contentment.

poetry_tang_37c76399.title: Farewell to Monk Jinglong
poetry_tang_37c76399.summary: The poet bids farewell to a Japanese monk returning home. The poem offers warm wishes, envisioning the traveler sailing away under the moon and wind.

poetry_tang_2d48d0c7.title: To Wine
poetry_tang_2d48d0c7.summary: The poet argues that drinking is better than reclusive life. He jokingly suggests that if Liu Ling were immortal, he would still be drunk today.

poetry_tang_000cb2ad.title: Yin Xi's Home
poetry_tang_000cb2ad.summary: Visiting Yin Xi's former home, the poet finds only desolation and autumn winds. The inability to trace the immortal leaves him reflecting on fleeting time.

poetry_tang_062b4b7b.title: Rainy Journey, Homesick
poetry_tang_062b4b7b.summary: A rainy journey stirs the poet's homesickness, with every sight deepening his sorrow. Envying the fisherman returning home, he expresses a longing for rest.

poetry_tang_bc8a5618.title: Ancient Farewell
poetry_tang_bc8a5618.summary: Amidst weeping willows, the poet struggles with parting and wine-induced sorrow. He points toward the south, anchoring his heartbreak in the distant spring.

poetry_tang_65cafb53.title: Willow Valley: Reply Poem
poetry_tang_65cafb53.summary: The poet rides through a valley of falling leaves, heavy with the sorrow of departure. He laments the lack of a kindred spirit, leaving a sense of profound loneliness.

poetry_tang_74cbe72a.title: Baliang Road Journey
poetry_tang_74cbe72a.summary: The spring scenery at Baliang Road is picturesque, yet it cannot mask the eternal sorrow of parting. The tolling of the sunset bell evokes a deep, lingering melancholy.

poetry_tang_cfeffb6a.title: Autumn Morning Travel
poetry_tang_cfeffb6a.summary: In the cool autumn morning, the poet travels past palace walls and wild landscapes. Despite the long, lonely journey, his inner passion remains undimmed.

poetry_tang_7f0cdf46.title: Lamenting Falling Flowers
poetry_tang_7f0cdf46.summary: As flowers wither in the wind, the poet laments the fleeting nature of youth. The sight of fallen petals leaves him filled with sorrow for the passage of time.

poetry_tang_f3bc81a5.title: Palace Grievance
poetry_tang_f3bc81a5.summary: A palace woman keeps a lonely vigil in the cold night, voicing her forgotten grievances. The chilly autumn sounds and fireflies highlight her endless sorrow.

poetry_tang_a1e55ed7.title: Passes and Rivers Journey
poetry_tang_a1e55ed7.summary: From an inn, the poet reflects on the reunions and partings of a decade. Frustrated in his ambitions, he contemplates retiring to a life of seclusion.

poetry_tang_5f3281aa.title: Pan'dou Inn Pavilion
poetry_tang_5f3281aa.summary: From the water pavilion, the poet gazes at the vast, clear landscape. He stands for a long time, filled with deep longing and affection for the distant scenery.

poetry_tang_172a29cc.title: Liang Family Water Study
poetry_tang_172a29cc.summary: The poet enjoys a leisurely life at the water study, immersed in music and nature. On a stormy night, a single lamp beyond the pines brings a sense of tranquil comfort.

poetry_tang_c89fc848.title: Curved Pond
poetry_tang_c89fc848.summary: The poet wanders by the pond, finding solace in poetry and wine. Amidst the idle spring, he reflects on his simple, solitary life.

poetry_tang_b3471209.title: Jiahui Lane Idle
poetry_tang_b3471209.summary: A secluded home hidden within the bustling city, surrounded by lush greenery. It offers a tranquil escape, evoking a sense of quiet detachment.

poetry_tang_50c1fb50.title: Summer Night
poetry_tang_50c1fb50.summary: Enjoying the cool summer night, the poet observes the stars and nature's rhythms. His recitation captures a subtle, contemplative transition toward autumn.

poetry_tang_a2b57da1.title: Early Departure
poetry_tang_a2b57da1.summary: Setting out through dense morning mist, the poet travels under the lingering moon. The journey is marked by the solitude of an early departure.

poetry_tang_6b44bcf2.title: Allegory
poetry_tang_6b44bcf2.summary: Time passes like melting gold, and all things eventually return to stillness. The poem reflects on the relentless flow of time and life's transience.

poetry_tang_48642324.title: Snow for Counselor Xue
poetry_tang_48642324.summary: Heavy snow blankets the landscape, and the cold light feels sharp as a sword. The poet captures the biting winter, preferring quiet contemplation.

poetry_tang_c1f21b7d.title: Pei's Suburban Home
poetry_tang_c1f21b7d.summary: Praising the elegance of Pei's suburban home, the poet expresses a longing for seclusion. He cherishes the freedom of nature over official life.

poetry_tang_406f7f39.title: Viewing Rain from Xianyang
poetry_tang_406f7f39.summary: Watching the rain from the tower, turbulent clouds sweep over the river. As geese fly through the mist, the scene leaves a sense of vast melancholy.

poetry_tang_f19e0870.title: Noble Young Man
poetry_tang_f19e0870.summary: The poem depicts a noble's luxurious life. It ends with a drunken jest about the emperor, leaving a sense of hollow vanity.

poetry_tang_7dbd08db.title: Listening to Zhao Play
poetry_tang_7dbd08db.summary: The poet praises the musician's skill through vivid descriptions of the music's natural imagery. It leaves the reader feeling refreshed and serene.

poetry_tang_91fdb155.title: Watching the Hunt
poetry_tang_91fdb155.summary: The poem captures the spectacle of a noble hunt. As the prey is caught, it concludes with the triumphant return of the hunters.

poetry_tang_26255451.title: Sandang East Lake
poetry_tang_26255451.summary: The poet depicts the serene beauty of the lake in autumn. The sound of frogs in the evening mist adds poetic depth.

poetry_tang_fa6afeb6.title: Exam Results Day
poetry_tang_fa6afeb6.summary: The poem celebrates scholars passing the imperial exam. It is filled with the joy of transformation and rising to a new life.

poetry_tang_7cc1e654.title: To Senior Xue
poetry_tang_7cc1e654.summary: The poet praises the senior's talent and noble character. It leaves a sense of profound respect and high expectations for his future.

poetry_tang_1aaaf55e.title: Visit to Monk: Unmet
poetry_tang_1aaaf55e.summary: The poet fails to meet the monk in a quiet temple. The disappointment of the visit turns into a longing for reclusive life.

poetry_tang_db1a9e7d.title: To My Cousin Zun
poetry_tang_db1a9e7d.summary: The poet reflects on his brother and their political aspirations. Amidst autumn winds, it conveys a steady resolve to pursue one's ideals.

poetry_tang_c2f8d958.title: Fisherman's Pond
poetry_tang_c2f8d958.summary: The poet depicts a secluded pond, contrasting its natural beauty with the difficulty of leaving worldly life. It leaves a feeling of longing for transcendence mixed with lingering worldly attachment.

poetry_tang_f89516a4.title: Winter Thoughts in Chang'an
poetry_tang_f89516a4.summary: Reflecting on his stagnant career in Chang'an, the poet expresses frustration and longing for a simpler life. The poem conveys a deep sense of melancholy and existential weariness.

poetry_tang_ce6d1148.title: Reply to Xue's Autumn Thoughts
poetry_tang_ce6d1148.summary: As autumn begins, the poet’s observations of nature trigger thoughts of a friend and the passage of time. It leaves a poignant sense of seasonal transition and personal reflection.

poetry_tang_acdf20a6.title: Same Rhyme Scheme
poetry_tang_acdf20a6.summary: Using the same rhyme, the poet vents his frustration over unfulfilled ambitions amidst autumn scenery. It evokes a feeling of noble solitude and persistent, yet weary, aspiration.

poetry_tang_6e4b405d.title: Three Uses of Rhyme
poetry_tang_6e4b405d.summary: Autumn winds prompt reflections on the fleeting nature of time and the instability of political life. The poem leaves a mood of quiet resignation and a desire for simple contentment.

poetry_tang_12b5b572.title: Startled by Autumn
poetry_tang_12b5b572.summary: Reflecting on his years in Chang'an, the poet laments wasting his life in pursuit of fame. It leaves a sharp, concise feeling of regret and retrospective sorrow.

poetry_tang_bd72e81c.title: Viewing Han Gao Temple
poetry_tang_bd72e81c.summary: The poet views the ancient temple against a lush spring landscape, finding peace in the scenery. It leaves a serene, expansive feeling of detachment from the world.

poetry_tang_4069a82e.title: Leiyang Floating Mountain Temple
poetry_tang_4069a82e.summary: Praising the temple's sanctity and the enduring nature of its surroundings, the poet prays for agricultural prosperity. It leaves a sense of reverence and hope for communal well-being.

poetry_tang_f16add6b.title: Sorrow
poetry_tang_f16add6b.summary: The poet struggles with inescapable sorrow that turns his hair white. Seeking refuge in intoxication, he expresses the profound weariness of a traveler.

poetry_tang_01d205de.title: Village Affairs
poetry_tang_01d205de.summary: The poem depicts a tranquil village life amidst nature. As spring fades and apricot blossoms thin, a subtle sense of melancholy emerges.

poetry_tang_80e4bc42.title: Early Spring at Three Halls
poetry_tang_80e4bc42.summary: Gazing from a high tower, the poet observes the vibrant early spring. He praises the host's youthful spirit, capturing a mood of joy.

poetry_tang_7d5a9574.title: Recalling Chu River I
poetry_tang_7d5a9574.summary: A chilling autumn night by the Chu River evokes historical longing. With no divine presence, the poet remains alone, deeply saddened by autumn.

poetry_tang_d9db3fc6.title: Autumn Stay at Bashang
poetry_tang_d9db3fc6.summary: Autumn rain clears at Bashang, where falling leaves stir homesickness. Sitting alone by a lamp, the poet reflects on his wandering life.

poetry_tang_2ce53f86.title: Out of the Frontier
poetry_tang_2ce53f86.summary: Soldiers brave the snow to raid enemy camps in a fierce battle. Despite damaged blades, the poem highlights the soldiers' heroic bravery.

poetry_tang_29285f0a.title: Border Pass Song I
poetry_tang_29285f0a.summary: Constant border warfare leaves soldiers wounded and worn. Facing harsh conditions and endless fighting, the poem conveys the grim reality of war.

poetry_tang_c8f6788f.title: Border Pass Song II
poetry_tang_c8f6788f.summary: Beacons ignite as isolated troops face a critical situation. With the Emperor demanding further conquest, the shadow of war looms over the frontier.

poetry_tang_d768ff61.title: Sparrow Terrace Lament
poetry_tang_d768ff61.summary: Once a place of song and dance, the Sparrow Terrace is now desolate under rain. The poet laments the passage of time, leaving only emptiness and historical sorrow.

poetry_tang_a969dde2.title: Hunting Song
poetry_tang_a969dde2.summary: The King of Chu hunts with grand ambitions of conquest. Yet, his glory fades, suggesting that wise governance is the true path to security.

poetry_tang_841c3f45.title: Southern Folks
poetry_tang_841c3f45.summary: The poem depicts the leisurely life of southern folk amidst exotic landscapes. It evokes a sense of transience and the mystery of aging.

poetry_tang_0884a134.title: Spring Thoughts
poetry_tang_0884a134.summary: Amidst spring willows, a woman longs for her distant lover from a jade tower. The lush grass highlights her isolation and deep, unfulfilled yearning.

poetry_tang_844b2965.title: Farewell to Uncle for Nanhai
poetry_tang_844b2965.summary: As autumn arrives, an uncle departs for the dangerous southern frontier. The long, perilous journey evokes deep sadness and concern for his safety.

poetry_tang_03450cb9.title: Farewell on the River
poetry_tang_03450cb9.summary: Amidst the bleak autumn river scenery, the poet faces a lonely departure. He feels adrift, contemplating a life of seclusion in distant lands.

poetry_tang_97054fb5.title: Parting Gift to a Friend
poetry_tang_97054fb5.summary: A farewell drink is shared amidst the chill of autumn. The frost and rain stir deep homesickness, making it impossible to hold back tears.

poetry_tang_456db3d8.title: Traveler's Journey
poetry_tang_456db3d8.summary: The endless journey brings only traveler's sorrow. Watching fishermen in the sunset, the poet yearns for their simple, carefree life.

poetry_tang_3b07d4b5.title: Visiting Old Man's Dwelling
poetry_tang_3b07d4b5.summary: The poet depicts a hermit's leisurely life of farming and reading amidst the clouds. This tranquil, detached atmosphere inspires a sense of longing.

poetry_tang_a778cc48.title: Reply to Prefect Wang
poetry_tang_a778cc48.summary: Receiving a letter from Prefect Wang, the poet laments his inability to repay the gesture. His words reveal a humble sense of frustration at his unfulfilled potential.

poetry_tang_3e36ff3d.title: After Failing Exam, Revisited
poetry_tang_3e36ff3d.summary: After failing the exam, the poet visits an old friend, finding brief peace in a secluded home. This fleeting comfort eases his wandering sorrow.

poetry_tang_ac59c787.title: Evening at Huai River Mouth
poetry_tang_ac59c787.summary: On an autumn night at the Huai River, the traveler feels profound loneliness under the cold moon. The desolate scenery evokes deep longing for his homeland.

poetry_tang_f9281354.title: Sunset Melancholy
poetry_tang_f9281354.summary: In the sunset, the poet laments his delayed return and aging face. The bleak autumn landscape triggers sorrow over the passage of time.

poetry_tang_7b860437.title: Early Departure from Homeland
poetry_tang_7b860437.summary: Leaving his homeland at dawn, the poet travels through deep valleys and hidden paths. The mountain's serenity creates an ethereal sense of detachment.

poetry_tang_99aeafdb.title: Parting with Gao Fu
poetry_tang_99aeafdb.summary: Parting with a friend after failing the exam, the poet laments his professional struggles. The sorrow of farewell is mixed with a desire for retirement.

poetry_tang_4f4e37fd.title: To Zen Master Zhenkong
poetry_tang_4f4e37fd.summary: The poet imagines the Zen master's pure life in a mountain temple. Contrasting the master's detachment, he laments his own inability to escape worldly burdens.

poetry_tang_75979567.title: To Jia Dao in Chang'an
poetry_tang_75979567.summary: Aging and frustrated in his career, the poet laments his unfulfilled ambitions. He yearns to abandon worldly pursuits and live in seclusion among the mountains.

poetry_tang_cbdc39e2.title: Autumn Suburban Evening View
poetry_tang_cbdc39e2.summary: The fading autumn twilight and withering nature evoke deep melancholy. Facing the relentless passage of time, the poet drinks alone, unable to find joy.

poetry_tang_4123bbe2.title: To a Yue Visitor
poetry_tang_4123bbe2.summary: Separated by water, the poet recalls past travels with a visitor from afar. His longing spans the distance, resting upon a fishing boat on the shore.

poetry_tang_3374fcd0.title: Farewell to Gu Feixiong
poetry_tang_3374fcd0.summary: As a friend returns home after failing the exams, the poet depicts the desolate scenery of his journey. The parting sorrow blends into the spring landscape.

poetry_tang_9a8515f6.title: Exhorting Old Friend at Qian
poetry_tang_9a8515f6.summary: Amidst the autumn winds of the frontier, friends share wine and song. Confronted by cold currents and graying hair, the poet sighs at the desolation of military life.

poetry_tang_791049ba.title: Farewell to Di Canjun
poetry_tang_791049ba.summary: As a friend departs for a post in Hangzhou, the poet describes the beautiful scenery along his route. The poem conveys sincere blessings for his promising future.

poetry_tang_1a0c0485.title: Visiting Friend's New Home
poetry_tang_1a0c0485.summary: Visiting a friend's new home, the poet enjoys the beauty of the autumn moon. The tranquil setting encourages them to linger, reflecting their deep bond.

poetry_tang_4c84533d.title: Setting Sun
poetry_tang_4c84533d.summary: The setting sun casts its glow over mountains and rivers, painting a serene autumn scene. Amidst shifting light and shadow, the poet finds harmony in nature.

poetry_tang_60e92d3b.title: Stay at Cui Shao's Villa
poetry_tang_60e92d3b.summary: Twilight blankets the wild fields as the poet reflects on his life amidst the cold river. A sense of displacement lingers, leaving him feeling lost.

poetry_tang_78b90b2b.title: Memory of Chu River II
poetry_tang_78b90b2b.summary: In the cold autumn mist, the poet waits alone for the moon to rise. The desolate scene mirrors his inner loneliness and detachment.

poetry_tang_074c5f68.title: Memory of Chu River III
poetry_tang_074c5f68.summary: Wind and rain evoke memories of ancient poets, leading the speaker to seek solace in the past. A profound sense of futility remains.

poetry_tang_e2928ab7.title: Distant Water
poetry_tang_e2928ab7.summary: Autumn waters merge with the sky in a vast, ethereal landscape. Against the backdrop of eternal mist, human existence feels insignificant.

poetry_tang_51dae4ce.title: Evening in Binning, to Cousin
poetry_tang_51dae4ce.summary: Traveling alone after a farewell, the poet yearns for his homeland. Sleeplessness through the night reveals his weariness with a wandering life.

poetry_tang_9c46393c.title: Farewell to a Northern Guest
poetry_tang_9c46393c.summary: A bold farewell to a guest cannot mask the poet's sorrow as he watches his friend depart like a bird. Pride gives way to emptiness.

poetry_tang_4b9cc355.title: Night Travel in Xiang
poetry_tang_4b9cc355.summary: Sailing the Dongting at night, the poet feels isolated amidst the cold mountains and moonlit waters. The journey leaves him feeling adrift.

poetry_tang_0133530a.title: Seeing Off Magistrate Lü
poetry_tang_0133530a.summary: Seeing a friend off to his new post, the poet observes the vast coastal scenery. His farewell is filled with respect and high hopes.

poetry_tang_2c5badf7.title: Mountain Journey Improvisation
poetry_tang_2c5badf7.summary: The poet finds lodging in the mountains at dusk. The serene scenery evokes a longing for seclusion, leaving a contemplative mood.

poetry_tang_71b5a818.title: Night Apes of Ba River
poetry_tang_71b5a818.summary: A traveler hears the mournful cries of apes by the river at night. The haunting sounds prevent sleep, filling the night with sorrow.

poetry_tang_b5b40fcc.title: Seeing Off Governor Tian
poetry_tang_b5b40fcc.summary: Seeing off a friend to a new post, the poet gazes at the distant landscape. He hopes his friend finds peace like a wandering crane.

poetry_tang_6a4ca776.title: Early Departure from Homeland
poetry_tang_6a4ca776.summary: Departing home at night, the traveler is met with a cold, desolate dawn. The bleak scenery deepens his sense of loneliness and sorrow.

poetry_tang_9cd3cd67.title: Farewell to a River Guest
poetry_tang_9cd3cd67.summary: Seeing a guest off on the Xiang River, the poet observes falling leaves. The scene inspires a longing for a simple, drifting life.

poetry_tang_1bde972b.title: Staying at Cuiwei Temple
poetry_tang_1bde972b.summary: Staying at a temple, the poet enjoys the quiet, bird-filled woods. The peaceful atmosphere evokes memories of his distant home.

poetry_tang_102bc508.title: After the Rain, Sent to the Monk of Baige
poetry_tang_102bc508.summary: After rain, the poet observes a monk living in solitary, cold seclusion. He admires this ascetic life and wishes to join him.

poetry_tang_f7d56772.title: Seeing Monk Off to Jinshan
poetry_tang_f7d56772.summary: Seeing a monk off to Jinshan, the poet watches him vanish into the sunset. The distant temple bell leaves a lingering, spiritual peace.

poetry_tang_fbfbb7ee.title: New Autumn Rain, to Hermit Wang
poetry_tang_fbfbb7ee.summary: After autumn rain, the poet shares tea and conversation with a hermit. The serene night fosters a deep, lingering sense of spiritual connection.

poetry_tang_b728ca2a.title: Frontier Mountain Song I
poetry_tang_b728ca2a.summary: The poem depicts soldiers fighting fiercely at the frontier. Despite their wounds, they are sent back to battle, evoking a tragic, somber mood.

poetry_tang_4243d457.title: Frontier Mountain Song II
poetry_tang_4243d457.summary: Beacons ignite in the north, forcing the army into a tense, isolated standoff. The scene conveys a chilling atmosphere of impending war.

poetry_tang_29bd2293.title: Frontier Fortress Song I
poetry_tang_29bd2293.summary: Amidst frontier snow, soldiers age through relentless combat. Reflecting on the vanity of military glory, the poet leaves a sense of desolation.

poetry_tang_6a18841e.title: Frontier Fortress Song II
poetry_tang_6a18841e.summary: Across the desolate desert, soldiers hunt enemies through bitter winds and sand. The harsh environment and brutal conflict create a bleak tone.

poetry_tang_ccf32809.title: Dispelling Sadness I
poetry_tang_ccf32809.summary: The poet recalls his late wife's devotion during their impoverished youth. Now wealthy, he mourns her absence, leaving a profound sense of grief.

poetry_tang_4b8d6ba3.title: Dispelling Sadness II
poetry_tang_4b8d6ba3.summary: Seeing her belongings, the poet is overwhelmed by memories of their shared life. The realization of their lost bond brings deep, piercing sorrow.

poetry_tang_3d79e4f8.title: Dispelling Sadness III
poetry_tang_3d79e4f8.summary: Reflecting on the finality of death, the poet vows to remember his wife through sleepless nights. His unfulfilled devotion leaves a haunting sadness.

poetry_tang_a21dc0f7.title: The Palace
poetry_tang_a21dc0f7.summary: In a desolate palace, white-haired maids reminisce about the past. The scene evokes a lingering sorrow over the transience of glory.

poetry_tang_e3896b8b.title: Blowing Song: Fragrant Tree
poetry_tang_e3896b8b.summary: Fragrant blossoms endure despite pests and harsh elements. The poem celebrates the resilience of life through the imagery of persistent flowers.

poetry_tang_875fb170.title: Ballad: Dong Tao's Journey
poetry_tang_875fb170.summary: Dong Zhuo’s tyranny leads to his downfall and subsequent political chaos. The poem reflects on the instability of power and the tragedy of civil strife.

poetry_tang_3c3549bc.title: Ballad: Future Calamity
poetry_tang_3c3549bc.summary: The path ahead is blocked by treacherous terrain and mechanical failure. The poet uses this journey to express the futility of struggling against inevitable obstacles.

poetry_tang_638ba7d2.title: Ballad: Severance I
poetry_tang_638ba7d2.summary: A woman rejects a fleeting love, yet suffers when her partner abandons her. The poem captures the deep bitterness of a broken heart.

poetry_tang_4c79e262.title: Ballad: Severance II
poetry_tang_4c79e262.summary: Longing feels like an eternity, yet love proves fragile and easily lost. The imagery of a broken mirror reflects the pain of separation.

poetry_tang_0fd1d1b1.title: Ballad: Severance III
poetry_tang_0fd1d1b1.summary: The brief reunion of the celestial lovers only deepens the agony of parting. The poem contrasts the longing for connection with the despair of separation.

poetry_tang_32c19e65.title: Ballad: Merchant's Joy
poetry_tang_32c19e65.summary: A merchant travels far to amass wealth, losing his roots in the process. The poem depicts the hollow success and moral decay of the mercantile life.

poetry_tang_ffa1e984.title: Dance Song: Winter White Ramie
poetry_tang_ffa1e984.summary: Wu palace enjoys endless night dances; the king indulges Xishi. It leaves a hollow feeling.

poetry_tang_8b8df86e.title: Miscellaneous Song: Leaving Home
poetry_tang_8b8df86e.summary: Two brothers seek fortune; one is mutilated, the other dies for theft. It leaves sorrow.

poetry_tang_39d8c3f7.title: Miscellaneous Song: Knight-errant
poetry_tang_39d8c3f7.summary: Knights fear failure more than death, killing by day with whale-like fury. It leaves awe.

poetry_tang_cf3d7ac6.title: Miscellaneous Song: Wall Building
poetry_tang_cf3d7ac6.summary: Laborers build walls yearly against invasions, yet fail to stop foes. It leaves sighs.

poetry_tang_e3ae549b.title: Joy of Returning Home
poetry_tang_e3ae549b.summary: Exiled poet finds peace in fate, embracing life and death calmly. It leaves tranquility.

poetry_tang_07d050ec.title: Spring Dove
poetry_tang_07d050ec.summary: Spring birds chatter together in the breeze, spared from noisy summer cicadas. It leaves freshness.

poetry_tang_e5a01d6e.title: Spring Cicada
poetry_tang_e5a01d6e.summary: The poet hates spring noises, wishing rain would wash away worldly chaos. It leaves restlessness.

poetry_tang_e6090cf4.title: Dodder Plant
poetry_tang_e6090cf4.summary: Dodder relies on thorns and perishes; true greatness stands alone. It leaves a warning.

poetry_tang_f6e06fe0.title: Ancient Shrine
poetry_tang_f6e06fe0.summary: The ancient shrine falls into ruin, becoming a den for foxes until the owner clears the land. The poem uses this exorcism to express a hope for the people's peaceful prosperity.

poetry_tang_0de756cc.title: Pine Tree
poetry_tang_0de756cc.summary: The solitary pine stands tall on the mountain, refusing to mingle with common trees in the dust. The poet praises the pine to express his commitment to integrity.

poetry_tang_51b4d992.title: Flowering Tree
poetry_tang_51b4d992.summary: Though the tree fades, its lone flower remains precious, and the poet refuses to destroy it. Reflecting on nature, the poem conveys compassion for all living things.

poetry_tang_c3ee013a.title: Paulownia Blossom
poetry_tang_c3ee013a.summary: The paulownia blossom is humble but noble, inspiring the poet to craft a zither to advise the king. He uses this metaphor to express his desire to rectify governance.

poetry_tang_39cf20f5.title: Pheasant Decoy
poetry_tang_39cf20f5.summary: The decoy pheasant, maimed and blinded, is forced to lure its own kind before meeting a tragic end. The poem highlights the tragedy of the exploited with deep sympathy.

poetry_tang_a170155b.title: Arrowhead
poetry_tang_a170155b.summary: The arrowhead must be sharpened to strike down evil, persisting despite royal rebuke. The poet uses the arrow as a metaphor for his resolve to eliminate wickedness.

poetry_tang_7b1a1461.title: Sacrificing to Gods
poetry_tang_7b1a1461.summary: Villagers worship false gods, but the poet argues that inner corruption must be purged to stop misfortune. He critiques superstition, emphasizing that virtue is the true foundation of peace.

poetry_tang_2044577b.title: Large-Beaked Crow
poetry_tang_2044577b.summary: The greedy crow deceives its owner, bringing chaos to the household before its inevitable downfall. Through this allegory, the poet warns against being misled by deceitful flatterers.

poetry_tang_1594e90e.title: Watershed Ridge
