poetry_tang_1594e90e.summary: The poem depicts streams diverging at the watershed, using the image of deep-well water to symbolize the poet's commitment to maintaining his integrity and original intent, regardless of external changes or pressures.

poetry_tang_8de4eda9.title: Four Sages Temple
poetry_tang_8de4eda9.summary: Reflecting on the Four Sages' retreat and eventual service, the poet criticizes their decision to abandon greater principles for minor political gains. The poem serves as a critical reflection on the ethics of withdrawal versus public service.

poetry_tang_04ccc0e4.title: Qingyun Posthouse
poetry_tang_04ccc0e4.summary: Contrasting the expectations of the 'Blue Cloud' post with its bleak reality, the poet rejects worldly ambition. The poem turns from disillusioned aspiration to a realization that true peace is found in moral steadfastness rather than status.

poetry_tang_cce906bc.title: Yangcheng Posthouse
poetry_tang_cce906bc.summary: Recounting the life of the upright official Yang Cheng, the poet laments his exile and the suppression of virtue. The poem expresses deep indignation at the marginalization of the righteous and the poet's own sense of isolation.

poetry_tang_253723bc.title: Bitter Rain
poetry_tang_253723bc.summary: Trapped by the oppressive, gloomy climate, the poet yearns to sweep away the darkness with a sword of light. The poem shifts from frustration with his environment to a hopeful desire for clarity and restoration.

poetry_tang_ac9d8110.title: Planting Bamboo
poetry_tang_ac9d8110.summary: Through the act of planting bamboo, the poet laments its withered state after being transplanted, using it as a metaphor for his own life. The poem moves from sympathy for the plant to a poignant sense of personal displacement.

poetry_tang_38747579.title: Reply to Bai Juyi
poetry_tang_38747579.summary: Responding to Bai Juyi on the role of historians, the poet argues that history should reflect moral truth rather than personal bias. He concludes that true purpose lies in serving the people rather than seeking fame.

poetry_tang_0e709f8b.title: Responding to Bai Juyi's Crane
poetry_tang_0e709f8b.summary: Inspired by Bai Juyi’s poem about a crane, the poet reflects on whether his own integrity has been compromised by worldly entanglements. It is a cautionary meditation on the importance of preserving one's inner purity.

poetry_tang_714a83ee.title: Admonishing Bao (1)
poetry_tang_714a83ee.summary: Jade sinks into the mud, its brilliance hidden from the world. The poet laments his unrecognized talent, yearning to break free like a dragon to reveal his true worth.

poetry_tang_c911c159.title: Admonishing Bao (2)
poetry_tang_c911c159.summary: Listing treasures left to decay without a worthy master, the poet laments the waste of heroic potential. He concludes that great talents only fulfill their purpose when serving a wise ruler.

poetry_tang_a1c693bf.title: On Swords
poetry_tang_a1c693bf.summary: Praising the sword's sharpness and mystical nature, the poet reaffirms his own noble ambitions. He urges his friend to use such power only against true evil, not for petty grievances.

poetry_tang_cd444cdb.title: Strange Writings
poetry_tang_cd444cdb.summary: Unseasonal winter thunder prompts the poet's anxiety over cosmic disorder. He uses this omen to critique political corruption, hoping for a return to clarity and justice.

poetry_tang_57d73211.title: To Bai Juyi on a Broken Sword
poetry_tang_57d73211.summary: Upon hearing of a friend's broken sword, the poet compares his spirit to an iron dragon. He asserts that true ambition transcends physical tools, residing in an inner power that shakes mountains.

poetry_tang_9c64f9dc.title: Pine and Crane
poetry_tang_9c64f9dc.summary: The pine and crane amidst snow evoke a sense of lofty detachment. The poet uses this imagery to express his weariness with worldly strife, longing for a pure, transcendent existence.

poetry_tang_5af78ad1.title: Dragon Boat Race
poetry_tang_5af78ad1.summary: Reflecting on boat races, the poet contemplates the struggles of history and nature. He dismisses petty conflicts, arguing that true greatness lies in rising like a dragon to benefit the world.

poetry_tang_4436b4a7.title: New Monastery Bamboo
poetry_tang_4436b4a7.summary: New bamboo grows tall in a monastery but remains confined by fences. The poet laments that such noble beauty goes unappreciated, waiting for a discerning soul to recognize its integrity.

poetry_tang_229335ff.title: Farewell to Zhi Yong
poetry_tang_229335ff.summary: The poet reunites with a friend, reflecting on their shared hardships and deep bond. Though both feel trapped like caged birds, their mutual integrity leaves a poignant, enduring impression.

poetry_tang_0c94e5f5.title: Bamboo Section
poetry_tang_0c94e5f5.summary: The poem depicts the grueling labor of bamboo cutters who struggle to survive, contrasting their plight with the poet's own comfort. It concludes with a sense of guilt and profound empathy for the suffering poor.

poetry_tang_a94fbc8b.title: Boat Race
poetry_tang_a94fbc8b.summary: The poet describes how local boat racing disrupts farming, leading him to restrict the practice to restore order. He aims to improve governance and ensure the people's livelihood.

poetry_tang_a4bf6139.title: Thatched Cottage
poetry_tang_a4bf6139.summary: Observing the cycle of fire-prone thatched cottages and their reconstruction, the poet reflects on the necessity of practical governance. He advocates for sensible planning to ensure the people's safety and well-being.

poetry_tang_b4870c2f.title: Rear Lake
poetry_tang_b4870c2f.summary: The poem celebrates the transformation of a stagnant lake into a prosperous area through collective labor under Zheng Gong's leadership. It conveys the poet's aspiration to achieve similar public good.

poetry_tang_0c84281e.title: Eight Steeds Painting
poetry_tang_0c84281e.summary: The poet vividly describes the majestic, swift Eight Steeds of King Mu. The reflection that no one can tame such creatures leaves a sense of awe for their untamable, transcendent spirit.

poetry_tang_61960277.title: Painted Pines
poetry_tang_61960277.summary: The poet critiques imitations of Zhang Zao’s pine paintings, finding them lacking in spirit. Concluding that worldly minds cannot capture the essence of nature, he resolves to seek the true pines in the mountains.

poetry_tang_e3e3a041.title: Miscellaneous Poem (3)
poetry_tang_e3e3a041.summary: Contrasting the harsh frontier life with a wife's longing at home, the poem highlights the sorrow caused by war. It concludes with a yearning for peace and an end to conflict.

poetry_tang_a2c94697.title: Ancient Intent to Qiao Zhizhi
poetry_tang_a2c94697.summary: A young wife longs for her distant husband amidst autumn chill. The moonlight on her loom highlights her profound, solitary sorrow.

poetry_tang_9ea726c7.title: Miscellaneous Song: Never Seen
poetry_tang_9ea726c7.summary: A wife misses her husband serving in Liaoyang, feeling the endless autumn night. The moonlight illuminating her loom emphasizes her lonely grief.

poetry_tang_3519318e.title: Temple Music: Dragon Pond Joy (3)
poetry_tang_3519318e.summary: The Dragon Pond reflects imperial majesty and divine power. All waters flowing toward this site celebrate the emperor's glorious reign.

poetry_tang_1c6e5344.title: Drum & Flute Song: Wushan High (1)
poetry_tang_1c6e5344.summary: Wushan’s peaks rise majestically into the clouds. The sudden cry of an ape at night evokes the legendary dream of King Huai.

poetry_tang_b86d27c6.title: Drum & Flute Song: Wushan High (2)
poetry_tang_b86d27c6.summary: The goddess lingers in the sunset, sharing a mystical encounter with the King. The storm fades, leaving behind a vast, desolate landscape.

poetry_tang_92d40d1d.title: Drum & Flute Song: Fragrant Tree
poetry_tang_92d40d1d.summary: Flowers bloom brightly before the palace, full of life. Yet, the scattering petals evoke a sense of abandonment and fading beauty.

poetry_tang_e2dbab69.title: Drum & Flute Song: Thoughts
poetry_tang_e2dbab69.summary: A woman waits for her traveling love from summer into autumn. The passage of time deepens her longing for the distant man.

poetry_tang_8d47bb3d.title: Drum & Flute Song: Fishing Rod
poetry_tang_8d47bb3d.summary: An angler enjoys the serene river, finding peace in nature. The poem concludes with a warning that greed leads to inevitable loss.

poetry_tang_c1394f46.title: Out of the Frontier
poetry_tang_c1394f46.summary: The poem depicts the desolate and arduous scene of frontier military life. Through bleak imagery, it expresses deep sympathy for soldiers suffering in war.

poetry_tang_64472465.title: Military Flute Song: Breaking Willow
poetry_tang_64472465.summary: The poem contrasts a bright spring boudoir with a woman's inner sorrow. Her act of breaking a willow branch hides a profound grief unknown to others.

poetry_tang_412218f3.title: Border Pass Moon Tune
poetry_tang_412218f3.summary: The border moon illuminates a distant battlefield, stirring homesickness in soldiers. The morning bugle and the horse's desire to return home reveal the weariness of war.

poetry_tang_3517e92a.title: Marching Song: Chang'an Road
poetry_tang_3517e92a.summary: The poem portrays the bustling urban scene and traffic of Chang'an. Beneath the lively surface, it reflects on the fleeting and superficial nature of city life.

poetry_tang_519d0703.title: Marching Song: Plum Blossoms Fall
poetry_tang_519d0703.summary: Falling plum blossoms trigger longing for a distant soldier. As spring approaches, the woman's boudoir resentment lingers, tinged with the melancholy of waiting for news.

poetry_tang_6ed7618a.title: Ballad: Wang Zhaojun
poetry_tang_6ed7618a.summary: Wang Zhaojun laments her tragic fate and the painter's betrayal upon being sent to the frontier. The poem conveys her helplessness and deep longing for home.

poetry_tang_0349b01b.title: Ballad: Bronze Sparrow Dancer
poetry_tang_0349b01b.summary: The former glory of the Bronze Sparrow Terrace vanished with Cao Cao's death. A dancer gazes at the empty tomb, lamenting that past favor has flowed away like water.

poetry_tang_e907cde8.title: Ballad: Eternal Regret
poetry_tang_e907cde8.summary: On a chilly autumn night in the Changmen Palace, a woman waits in solitude. The vast stars mirror her unbearable grief and the loneliness of being forgotten.

poetry_tang_5e0b7308.title: Ballad: Phoenix Flute Tune
poetry_tang_5e0b7308.summary: The poet recalls the immortal Prince Jin, contrasting his celestial flight with earthly attachments. It balances a longing for eternity with worldly desire, leaving a sense of transcendent melancholy.

poetry_tang_e9dc9e9a.title: Lute Song: Thunderclap Prelude
poetry_tang_e9dc9e9a.summary: The music mimics the power of thunder, evoking images of martial strength and battle. The shift from intense sound to deep reflection stirs a heroic spirit of duty.

poetry_tang_eaf60399.title: Miscellaneous Song: Ancient Parting
poetry_tang_eaf60399.summary: The eastward flowing river symbolizes the finality of parting. Through images of a cold, empty chamber, the poet expresses a deep and enduring longing for a distant traveler.

poetry_tang_197c0cc2.title: Miscellaneous Song: Ancient Song
poetry_tang_197c0cc2.summary: An autumn night in a lonely chamber highlights the fading of past glory. The mournful song underscores the profound sorrow and solitude left by the king's absence.

poetry_tang_9fdb99a0.title: Beautiful Trees
poetry_tang_9fdb99a0.summary: Flowers bloom in the palace, yet remain unseen. As the spring breeze scatters the petals, a sense of neglect and the sorrow of a fading beauty emerge.

poetry_tang_b59bac7c.title: Chang'an Road
poetry_tang_b59bac7c.summary: The bustling streets of Chang'an display the vitality of the capital. Amidst the lively scene, the poet reflects on the fleeting nature of such worldly splendor.

poetry_tang_505e9bbe.title: My Thoughts
poetry_tang_505e9bbe.summary: A woman waits through the long summer for her traveling husband as seasons change. The sight of the autumn moon brings a sense of deep isolation and longing.

poetry_tang_8020c581.title: On High Terrace
poetry_tang_8020c581.summary: Standing on a high terrace, the busy traffic triggers nostalgia for home. As birds return at dusk, the poet is struck by the sorrow of passing time.

poetry_tang_2ffd679c.title: Phoenix Flute Tune
poetry_tang_2ffd679c.summary: The poet recalls the legend of Prince Jin ascending on a phoenix flute, reflecting on the transience of worldly fame. It leaves a sense of detachment and a longing for eternal transcendence.

poetry_tang_9ec2babd.title: Mimicking Ancient Parting
poetry_tang_9ec2babd.summary: Using the eastward-flowing river to symbolize permanent separation, the poet laments the passing of time and long-term absence. It leaves a lingering feeling of deep sorrow and longing.

poetry_tang_2d1c48fc.title: Year Xin Chou, October, Following Emperor to Western Peak
poetry_tang_2d1c48fc.summary: The poet describes the majestic Western Peak while accompanying the Emperor. The turn shifts toward a longing for the immortal realm, ending with a desire for a reclusive life.

poetry_tang_440d8b45.title: Responding to Du Lintai's Spring Feelings
poetry_tang_440d8b45.summary: Amidst the lush spring garden, the poet feels melancholy due to longing. As spring fades and beauty wanes, the poem leaves a sense of deep, quiet sorrow.

poetry_tang_248a70d2.title: Farewell to Censor Yan Ning
poetry_tang_248a70d2.summary: The poet bids farewell to Censor Yan, advising him on local governance. It conveys earnest hopes for the friend to rule with integrity and protect the virtuous.

poetry_tang_ee53ec7d.title: Farewell to Qiao Shizhou Kan
poetry_tang_ee53ec7d.summary: Reflecting on a thirty-year friendship, the poet expresses deep sorrow at parting. The turn transforms this grief into a gesture of mutual respect and sincere blessings.

poetry_tang_d95a7fd3.title: Farewell to Friend Going to Guazhou
poetry_tang_d95a7fd3.summary: Bidding farewell to a friend in spring, the poet laments the fleeting nature of time. Facing the eastward river, the sorrow of separation intensifies with the wine.

poetry_tang_ba2dae93.title: Farewell to a Traveler
poetry_tang_ba2dae93.summary: The poet hosts a farewell banquet for a friend departing in autumn. Against the backdrop of a crisp, clear landscape, the weight of parting grows in the twilight.

poetry_tang_25f86f3b.title: Visiting Sima Ziwei with Li Shilang
poetry_tang_25f86f3b.summary: The poet visits a Daoist to discuss immortality. He laments worldly burdens and longs to transcend the mundane for spiritual clarity.

poetry_tang_0c4b6299.title: From Changle to Chenzhou via Baishi Ridge
poetry_tang_0c4b6299.summary: The poet travels upstream, depicting rugged landscapes. Despite the arduous journey, he finds a detached state of mind amidst the scenery.

poetry_tang_22d5e694.title: Passing Dragon Gate of Shu
poetry_tang_22d5e694.summary: The Dragon Gate is a natural marvel with surging waters. Witnessing this, the poet contemplates retiring from public life to practice alchemy.

poetry_tang_8aafa99a.title: Entering Wei
poetry_tang_8aafa99a.summary: The beautiful scenery of the Qi River evokes memories of a virtuous friend. Facing the vast spring landscape, the poet feels deep longing.

poetry_tang_96c8534a.title: Night Mooring in Yuezhou, Meeting Northern Envoy
poetry_tang_96c8534a.summary: Meeting a northern envoy while in exile brings mixed emotions. They share their sorrow, lamenting their uncertain fate and distant home.

poetry_tang_fc1e6a64.title: Shaolong Temple
poetry_tang_fc1e6a64.summary: The poet practices Zen at Shaolong Temple, contemplating Buddhist truths. Within the tranquil temple, he finds inner peace.

poetry_tang_abafbed1.title: Southward Exile
poetry_tang_abafbed1.summary: Exiled to the south, the poet gazes at the immortal Su Dan's mountain. He feels melancholic contrasting the immortal's transcendence with his own plight.

poetry_tang_a799661a.title: First Arrival in Huanzhou
poetry_tang_a799661a.summary: Exiled to distant Huanzhou, the poet suffers from hunger and illness. Gazing at the North Star, he yearns for the day of his pardon.

poetry_tang_36a1a11b.title: Impeached
poetry_tang_36a1a11b.summary: The poet is unjustly imprisoned and suffers brutal treatment. He longs for a breeze to clear the clouds and reveal his innocence.

poetry_tang_8dfad660.title: Unjustly Imprisoned I
poetry_tang_8dfad660.summary: Citing historical figures slandered by rulers, the poet expresses his indignation. The poem is filled with sorrow over being separated from his kin.

poetry_tang_ffafef99.title: Unjustly Imprisoned II
poetry_tang_ffafef99.summary: Comparing himself to the innocent Gongye Chang, the poet maintains his purity. He laments the lack of wise men to clear his name, feeling deeply isolated.

poetry_tang_cbae035c.title: Yellow Crane
poetry_tang_cbae035c.summary: The poet uses the yellow crane to symbolize his own unused talent. Despite his desire to repay kindness, he is left wandering the heavens alone.

poetry_tang_c8d66bf5.title: Mourning Scholar Wang
poetry_tang_c8d66bf5.summary: Learning of a friend's death, the poet is overcome with grief. Trapped in prison, he can only offer this poem as a final tribute.

poetry_tang_a9917bc0.title: Ancient Mirror
poetry_tang_a9917bc0.summary: Though covered in moss, the ancient mirror remains clear. The poet uses it as a metaphor for his own integrity, hoping for recognition.

poetry_tang_e782efc5.title: Phoenix Flute Tune
poetry_tang_e782efc5.summary: The poem depicts the loneliness of court women and the transience of glory. It concludes with the legend of the phoenix flute, yearning for freedom.

poetry_tang_da612690.title: Ancient Song
poetry_tang_da612690.summary: On a cold autumn night, a palace lady waits in vain for the emperor. Her song expresses deep longing and sorrow, leaving a lingering sense of desolation.

poetry_tang_21cb3fc5.title: Seventh Night: Airing Clothes
poetry_tang_21cb3fc5.summary: Palace maids air luxurious clothes on the Seventh Night. The poem turns to criticize imperial extravagance, leaving a sense of moral warning.

poetry_tang_759d3cec.title: Marching Song: Longtou Chant
poetry_tang_759d3cec.summary: A lonely flute melody moves a veteran soldier to tears. The poem shifts to historical reflection, evoking a deep sense of patriotic sorrow.

poetry_tang_acbddf3a.title: Out of the Frontier
poetry_tang_acbddf3a.summary: The poem depicts a bold frontier hunt. It turns to praise the generals' valor, conveying the majestic spirit of the Han army.

poetry_tang_b3b71fd8.title: Ballad: Marching to War
poetry_tang_b3b71fd8.summary: Soldiers rush to cross the river amidst war horns. The scene shifts to intense battlefield combat, ending with a vision of victory.

poetry_tang_933cfa59.title: Song of Longxi
poetry_tang_933cfa59.summary: Rapid hoofbeats signal urgent military news. The poem shifts to the siege of Jiuquan, leaving a tense, isolated atmosphere.

poetry_tang_a29961af.title: Song of Ban Jieyu I
poetry_tang_a29961af.summary: Fireflies drift past a silent window on an autumn night. The focus turns to a flickering lamp, highlighting the lady's deep loneliness.

poetry_tang_94b35f5a.title: Song of Ban Jieyu II
poetry_tang_94b35f5a.summary: Autumn grass grows as imperial favor fades. The poem turns to the sound of passing carriages, capturing the bitterness of abandonment.

poetry_tang_870aa563.title: Song of Ban Jieyu III
poetry_tang_870aa563.summary: The lady remains in her closed chambers while the Emperor passes by. The scene shifts to laughter in the gardens, emphasizing her neglect.

poetry_tang_735b7ead.title: Song: Welcoming the Goddess
poetry_tang_735b7ead.summary: Shamans drum and play flutes at Yushan to welcome the goddess. Her absence amidst wind and rain leaves the speaker in deep, lingering distress.

poetry_tang_d405fffe.title: Song: Bidding Goddess Farewell
poetry_tang_d405fffe.summary: The goddess departs as evening rain shrouds the mountains. When the skies clear, the serene landscape contrasts with the speaker's lingering melancholy.

poetry_tang_52a2cfc4.title: Ballad: Suffering from Heat
poetry_tang_52a2cfc4.summary: Scorching heat plagues the earth, causing the speaker great discomfort. He turns to spiritual transcendence, finding ultimate relief in Buddhist serenity.

poetry_tang_b9d48720.title: Ballad: Young Travelers I
poetry_tang_b9d48720.summary: Gallant youths in Xianyang drink fine wine under willow trees. The poem captures the spirited, carefree lifestyle of these bold travelers.

poetry_tang_5bbca9fe.title: Ballad: Young Travelers II
poetry_tang_5bbca9fe.summary: The emperor honors his generals with titles after a grand banquet. It depicts the glory of military success and imperial favor.

poetry_tang_c607ebb6.title: Ballad: Young Travelers III
poetry_tang_c607ebb6.summary: A young soldier joins the imperial guard and fights at the frontier. Despite the hardships, his heroic spirit leaves an enduring legacy.

poetry_tang_55021462.title: Ballad: Young Travelers IV
poetry_tang_55021462.summary: A skilled young warrior faces thousands of enemies with ease. His precise archery and fearless demeanor highlight his martial prowess.

poetry_tang_6084fa32.title: Replying to Gentlemen's Visit
poetry_tang_6084fa32.summary: The poet lives a simple farming life and hosts visiting friends. Once they depart, the sudden silence deepens his sense of solitude.

poetry_tang_20ead6f8.title: Upon the Imperial Ascent
poetry_tang_20ead6f8.summary: This poem depicts the Emperor ascending a height with his ministers. It celebrates the prosperity of the era and the Emperor's virtue, leaving a sense of awe.

poetry_tang_0b99422a.title: Imperial Poem: Spring Brightness Tower
poetry_tang_0b99422a.summary: The poem describes the grandeur of the Spring Brightness Tower and the imperial procession. It shifts to praise the Emperor's appreciation for talent, reflecting deep respect.

poetry_tang_855ff2d8.title: Imperial Poem: Seeing Off Protector
poetry_tang_855ff2d8.summary: The poem captures the solemnity of seeing off a protector to the western frontier. It shifts to the tranquility of the borders, evoking a sense of universal peace.

poetry_tang_2e10161c.title: Funan Song I
poetry_tang_2e10161c.summary: This poem depicts a palace lady lingering in sleep during spring. The arrival of an imperial messenger highlights her delicate shyness and hidden melancholy.

poetry_tang_bdfffe90.title: Funan Song II
poetry_tang_bdfffe90.summary: The poem presents a lavish scene of courtly music and dance. Amidst the public admiration, it subtly conveys a sense of loneliness and longing for intimacy.

poetry_tang_8ef8c4e6.title: Funan Song III
poetry_tang_8ef8c4e6.summary: It captures the lingering fragrance and beauty of palace performances. Ending with the return to the palace, it leaves a sense of fading, ornate splendor.

poetry_tang_f4e5afec.title: Funan Song IV
poetry_tang_f4e5afec.summary: The poem records palace maids preparing for their morning duties. The sound of jade ornaments creates a cold, disciplined atmosphere of court life.

poetry_tang_63034651.title: Mountain Rocks
poetry_tang_63034651.summary: The poet recounts staying in a mountain temple and wandering through nature. He shifts to praising the joy of seclusion, expressing a desire to escape worldly constraints.

poetry_tang_cafb621b.title: To Zhang Gongcao
poetry_tang_cafb621b.summary: The poet and his exiled friend share their hardships by the desolate Dongting Lake, lamenting their difficult careers. The poem yearns for imperial amnesty, ultimately reflecting on the unpredictable nature of fate.

poetry_tang_196e4a8b.title: Visiting Hengshan Temple
poetry_tang_196e4a8b.summary: Visiting Hengshan Temple, the poet prays for divine protection and finds awe in the clearing skies. Spending a cold night in a temple, he realizes that despite his career struggles, he must remain steadfast in his solitude.

poetry_tang_0aa6867a.title: Ode to Stone Drums
poetry_tang_0aa6867a.summary: Describing the ancient Stone Drums, the poet laments their neglect and decay. He urges the court to preserve this heritage, expressing deep anxiety over cultural decline and his own unfulfilled political ambitions.

poetry_tang_a46af1ad.title: Song: Fierce Tiger
poetry_tang_a46af1ad.summary: The fierce tiger, due to its cruelty, is abandoned and eventually destroyed by its rivals. The poet uses this to warn that those who betray trust and alienate others will face a tragic end, regardless of their strength.

poetry_tang_ec25cfae.title: Gu You Melody
poetry_tang_ec25cfae.summary: This piece depicts the despair of a prisoner losing his senses in total darkness. The poet uses a somber tone to express his unwavering loyalty to the emperor despite his helpless imprisonment.

poetry_tang_bc2cff31.title: Yueshang Melody
poetry_tang_bc2cff31.summary: The poet praises the diligence and governance of the Zhou ancestors, depicting a prosperous era of national unity. The poem reflects deep reverence for the past and a yearning for order and harmony.

poetry_tang_39e7b408.title: Qin Melody
poetry_tang_39e7b408.summary: Reflecting on his ancestors' migration to avoid war, the poet expresses compassion for the people and the helplessness of conflict. It conveys anxiety over national security and the loneliness of surviving in chaotic times.

poetry_tang_29c6a39b.title: Lushuang Melody
poetry_tang_29c6a39b.summary: From the perspective of an abandoned child, this piece recounts the biting cold and hunger of his plight. By depicting the absence of maternal love, the poet reveals the tragic fate of being cast aside.

poetry_tang_170f8623.title: Pheasants Morning Flight
poetry_tang_170f8623.summary: Pheasants fly and feed together in the morning sun. The poet laments his own solitary life at seventy, feeling inferior to the paired birds.

poetry_tang_c2e3657c.title: Yi Lan Melody
poetry_tang_c2e3657c.summary: Fragrant orchids bloom unpicked, reflecting the poet's resolve. He uses this imagery to express a gentleman's commitment to integrity despite being ignored.

poetry_tang_f480f061.title: Returning Melody
poetry_tang_f480f061.summary: Facing the treacherous autumn waters, the poet feels trapped and regretful. He decides to retreat, choosing to avoid further struggle with life's obstacles.

poetry_tang_55a2dc49.title: Guishan Melody
poetry_tang_55a2dc49.summary: The turtle is large but useless, unable to perform great tasks. The poet identifies with this insignificance, mourning his lack of purpose and seeking guidance.

poetry_tang_85cd1513.title: Disabled Form Melody
poetry_tang_85cd1513.summary: The poet dreams of a headless beast and wakes in deep anxiety. He ponders the omen's meaning, lamenting that no sage remains to interpret such mysteries.

poetry_tang_4387dd35.title: Farewell Swan Melody
poetry_tang_4387dd35.summary: Swans build a nest but separate because they cannot bear young. The poet reflects on the necessity of parting when companionship is no longer possible.

poetry_tang_5e095b8b.title: Ballad: Crying Geese
poetry_tang_5e095b8b.summary: Geese migrate through harsh winds, struggling in their lonely journey. The poet uses their plight to mirror his own sense of displacement and sorrow.

poetry_tang_ca2ab413.title: Poem on Yuanhe Virtue
poetry_tang_ca2ab413.summary: This poem celebrates the Emperor's suppression of a rebellion and his benevolent rule. It praises the restoration of order and prays for eternal peace.

poetry_tang_ce58e5db.title: Ten Qin Melodies
poetry_tang_ce58e5db.summary: The poem depicts the hardship and regret of wading through treacherous waters. The turn comes with the realization of the dilemma, choosing to return. It leaves a solitary and philosophical sentiment.

poetry_tang_6c94e401.title: Mount Nan Poem
poetry_tang_6c94e401.summary: The poet ascends to view the myriad shapes of the mountains crafted by nature. It turns to his difficult exploration during exile and strange encounters. It leaves a grand yet wistful breadth of mind.

poetry_tang_df650626.title: Poem for Xie Ziran
poetry_tang_df650626.summary: It describes the bizarre disappearance of Xie Ziran, a woman deluded by Taoist immortality. The turn fiercely criticizes societal delusion and violation of human norms. It leaves a sobering, cautionary sigh.

poetry_tang_939c14d2.title: Autumn Thoughts I
poetry_tang_939c14d2.summary: Autumn winds and a lonely lamp evoke the poet's baseless sorrow and lament on mortality. The turn realizes life inevitably ends in death, urging timely joy. It leaves a relieved and broad-minded feeling.

poetry_tang_20c207dd.title: Autumn Thoughts II
poetry_tang_20c207dd.summary: White dew falls as orchids wither while weeds flourish, accompanied by cicadas and crickets. The turn reflects that all things have their season without favoring pines. It leaves a tranquil acceptance of nature.

poetry_tang_39153de2.title: Autumn Thoughts III
poetry_tang_39153de2.summary: Past haste contrasts with present leisure, leading the poet to immerse in vast books. The turn upholds lofty ambitions without yielding to vulgar complaints. It leaves an upright and proud scholarly integrity.

poetry_tang_013899bb.title: Autumn Thoughts IV
poetry_tang_013899bb.summary: In desolate autumn, the poet reads at dawn and gazes at Mount Nan's deep pool. The turn brings helpless regret over unfulfilled ambitions. It leaves a lonely sense of unfulfilled potential in twilight years.

poetry_tang_7c01d8fe.title: Autumn Thoughts V
poetry_tang_7c01d8fe.summary: Chew dew and insect cries create a sorrowful nocturnal atmosphere. The turn retracts youthful boldness to seek peace in ancient texts and simplicity. It leaves a serene, unpretentious tranquility.

poetry_tang_4f857b42.title: Autumn Thoughts VI
poetry_tang_4f857b42.summary: The poet wakes to a quiet, insect-filled room under the moon. Feeling lost in his aimless life, he resolves to focus on his official duties.

poetry_tang_676553df.title: Autumn Thoughts VII
poetry_tang_676553df.summary: As autumn nights drag on, the poet laments his lack of ambition. He chooses to bury himself in books, seeking simple sustenance rather than glory.

poetry_tang_9fe0c9c4.title: Autumn Thoughts VIII
poetry_tang_9fe0c9c4.summary: Watching leaves dance in the wind, the poet reads ancient poems in silence. Their resonance stirs his spirit, reminding him that true ambition transcends time.

poetry_tang_4d95a9a4.title: Autumn Thoughts IX
poetry_tang_4d95a9a4.summary: Frosty winds strip the trees, prompting the poet to mourn the rapid passage of time. Struck by the brevity of life, he shakes off his melancholy to move forward.

poetry_tang_3dd2763b.title: Autumn Thoughts X
poetry_tang_3dd2763b.summary: In the stillness of night, the poet reflects on worldly troubles. Through deep introspection, he finds a sense of inner peace and self-sufficiency.

poetry_tang_d5550386.title: Autumn Thoughts XI
poetry_tang_d5550386.summary: Chrysanthemums and butterflies meet in the late frost, clinging to each other despite the season. The poet reflects on fate, accepting that all things eventually fade.

poetry_tang_7c3d30f9.title: To Academicians on Journey
poetry_tang_7c3d30f9.summary: The poet recounts his exile and hardships, lamenting the cruelty of his career. Despite his loyalty, he longs for retirement and misses his distant friends.

poetry_tang_7f4d8fc2.title: Evening Walk by River
poetry_tang_7f4d8fc2.summary: Walking alone at dusk, the poet feels the weight of an uncertain future. He tosses and turns in his boat, filled with sorrow over his stalled life.

poetry_tang_d47cfb05.title: Night Song
poetry_tang_d47cfb05.summary: In the quiet night, the poet sits alone, content and free from regret. This sense of inner peace leaves a feeling of serene self-sufficiency.

poetry_tang_a2cdd59b.title: To Li Guan on Illness
poetry_tang_a2cdd59b.summary: Clouds obscure the sun, prompting concern for a friend's illness and the world's state. The poem turns to moral steadfastness, leaving a message of resilience.

poetry_tang_5b3078ac.title: Jianghan, Reply to Meng Jiao
poetry_tang_5b3078ac.summary: Crossing the vast river is easy, serving as a metaphor for maintaining integrity in exile. It emphasizes loyalty between friends, leaving a sense of steadfast bond.

poetry_tang_60abbba7.title: Chang'an Friends to Meng Jiao
poetry_tang_60abbba7.summary: Friends in Chang'an differ in wealth and lifestyle, from simple studies to lavish music. The poem observes these social contrasts with a detached, reflective tone.

poetry_tang_8632323b.title: Below Qishan I
poetry_tang_8632323b.summary: At the foot of Qishan, the poet listens for the legendary phoenix at dusk. The scene captures a longing for peace, leaving a lingering sense of solitude.

poetry_tang_1b727f47.title: Below Qishan II
poetry_tang_1b727f47.summary: The phoenix has been absent since the decline of the Zhou dynasty. The poet invokes this myth to express hope for a virtuous, orderly reign.

poetry_tang_11fdd1e5.title: To Li Guan, North Star
poetry_tang_11fdd1e5.summary: Separated by distance, two kindred spirits find an instant, profound connection. The poem celebrates this enduring friendship, leaving a feeling of noble loyalty.

poetry_tang_db9043d7.title: This Day is Precious
poetry_tang_db9043d7.summary: Reflecting on shared intellectual pursuits and subsequent hardships, the poet laments the fragility of life. It concludes with a poignant sense of urgency and longing.

poetry_tang_fdcb5c93.title: Hidden Feelings
poetry_tang_fdcb5c93.summary: The poet walks by a spring river, observing festive crowds with melancholy. The turn reflects on the fleeting nature of time, leaving a sense of existential unease.

poetry_tang_26f617be.title: Gentleman Follows Heaven's Way
poetry_tang_26f617be.summary: The poet contrasts the gentleman's alignment with nature against the petty man's aimlessness. The turn questions the possibility of maintaining inner clarity amidst life's uncertainties.

poetry_tang_cd9430e6.title: Falling Leaves, Farewell to Chen
poetry_tang_cd9430e6.summary: Falling leaves and drifting weeds symbolize parting, as two friends meet under a cold moon. The turn highlights the weight of youthful sorrow, leaving a lingering sense of grief.

poetry_tang_0d9c8c6b.title: Return to Pengcheng
poetry_tang_0d9c8c6b.summary: The poet laments his inability to serve a war-torn nation, feeling isolated and powerless. The turn reflects his disillusionment with politics, leaving a mood of frustration and resignation.

poetry_tang_ae3b8f7d.title: After Drinking
poetry_tang_ae3b8f7d.summary: Guests at a banquet exhibit various drunken states, blending noise with quietude. The turn reflects on the brevity of life, leaving a sense of desperate hedonism.

poetry_tang_b18e4484.title: Drunken Gift to Secretary Zhang
poetry_tang_b18e4484.summary: The poet drinks with literary friends, celebrating their creative spirit. The turn dismisses the vulgarity of the wealthy, leaving an image of refined intellectual camaraderie.

poetry_tang_8f63dd6d.title: Tongguan Gorge
poetry_tang_8f63dd6d.summary: Confined in a gorge, the poet finds his mood stirred by morning birds. The turn contrasts his restricted state with a longing for freedom, ending in stoic acceptance.

poetry_tang_2c1b2161.title: Farewell to Monk Hui
poetry_tang_2c1b2161.summary: The poet recounts the monk Hui's wandering life and spiritual pursuits. The turn acknowledges their differing paths yet mutual respect, leaving a sense of detached farewell.

poetry_tang_5e450237.title: Farewell to Monk Ling
poetry_tang_5e450237.summary: Han Yu bids farewell to talented monk Ling, recounting his perils and wanderings. It leaves a feeling of deep regret for wasted talent and sorrow at parting.

poetry_tang_fbed7906.title: Spring Palace Lament
poetry_tang_fbed7906.summary: A neglected palace lady laments her fading youth amid blooming spring. It leaves a feeling of profound loneliness and helplessness.

poetry_tang_bedf0597.title: Failed to Meet Daoist
poetry_tang_bedf0597.summary: The poet misses a Daoist recluse amid serene nature. It leaves a lingering sense of gentle longing for a pure, transcendental life.

poetry_tang_803eea24.title: Farewell to a Traveler
poetry_tang_803eea24.summary: The poet sees off a friend to watery Suzhou, depicting vibrant riverside scenes. It leaves a poignant feeling of homesickness.

poetry_tang_ac7f2d81.title: Farewell to Chen Chun
poetry_tang_ac7f2d81.summary: A friend returns home through picturesque, clear rivers and mountains. It leaves a warm feeling of scenic beauty and deep affection.

poetry_tang_8f43861a.title: Emerging from Mountains
poetry_tang_8f43861a.summary: An elderly scholar finally leaves the mountains for the imperial exam. It leaves a feeling of hard-earned hope and perseverance.

poetry_tang_d4b8645d.title: Meeting Poet in Zhejiang
poetry_tang_d4b8645d.summary: The poet joyfully meets a kindred spirit amid snowy Zhejiang. It leaves a heartwarming feeling of rare friendship and shared passion.

poetry_tang_97a4b800.title: Farewell to Friend, Wu-Yue
poetry_tang_97a4b800.summary: A friend travels through the scenic water towns of Wu and Yue. It leaves an admiring yet wistful feeling of traveler's longing.

poetry_tang_646b1e42.title: On Returning from Changshan
poetry_tang_646b1e42.summary: The poet feels deep sorrow while leaving Changshan. His tears reveal a vulnerability that contrasts with his masculine pride.

poetry_tang_cc5e181e.title: Passing Deserted House
poetry_tang_cc5e181e.summary: Passing a deserted house, the poet reflects on the transience of wealth. The ruins evoke a somber meditation on life's inevitable decay.

poetry_tang_b7bbd56d.title: Ascending Tiantai Temple
poetry_tang_b7bbd56d.summary: Ascending the temple, the poet finds tranquility amidst the grand scenery. This shift from busyness to leisure brings a sense of peace.

poetry_tang_4a82d357.title: Spring on the Road
poetry_tang_4a82d357.summary: Traveling in spring, the poet weeps over his wasted youth and lack of recognition. His incurable sorrow leaves him feeling lost and cynical.

poetry_tang_05523989.title: Return to Liyang Road
poetry_tang_05523989.summary: Pursuing fame, the poet misses his brother amidst autumn rain. He mocks his abandonment of a free life for the burdens of ambition.

poetry_tang_2f0dc312.title: To Magistrate Ouyang
poetry_tang_2f0dc312.summary: The poet praises the magistrate's virtuous rule and the peaceful town. His lingering regret after leaving reveals a longing for such stillness.

poetry_tang_bc280eed.title: To Abbot Lin
poetry_tang_bc280eed.summary: The poet discusses Zen enlightenment, urging a move beyond dogma. He argues that only a clear mind can grasp the dreamlike nature of life.

poetry_tang_c1bea886.title: At Zhan Island Monastery
poetry_tang_c1bea886.summary: Visiting a monk on an island, the poet observes a life of detachment. This secluded existence prompts him to ponder the ultimate human destination.

poetry_tang_6821125d.title: Farewell to Hengzhou Governor
poetry_tang_6821125d.summary: The poet leaves the governor for a lonely riverside village, feeling uncertain of his future. The cry of autumn apes under the cold moon leaves him heartbroken.

poetry_tang_7dcf4e5e.title: Seeing Off to Jiangnan
poetry_tang_7dcf4e5e.summary: The poet toasts his departing friend, lamenting how quickly life passes. Despite the beautiful spring scenery, he struggles to hold back tears of sorrow.

poetry_tang_24a77b73.title: Journey to Mount Mao
poetry_tang_24a77b73.summary: The poet wanders into the secluded Mount Mao, discovering a pristine, ethereal landscape. The scene of a Taoist praying under the stars evokes deep tranquility.

poetry_tang_2598044e.title: Reading a Friend's Poems
poetry_tang_2598044e.summary: Deep into the night, the poet is captivated by his friend's brilliant verses. He is so moved by the exquisite craftsmanship that he finds them unparalleled.

poetry_tang_5e3b6f3c.title: To My Uncle
poetry_tang_5e3b6f3c.summary: The poet laments his lifelong poverty and missed opportunities despite his literary talent. Sitting alone at night, he feels the heavy burden of unfulfilled ambition.

poetry_tang_e5301069.title: To Li Pu
poetry_tang_e5301069.summary: The poet encourages his friend to embrace late success and ignore mockery. By holding onto their original ideals, they find purpose beyond mere worldly status.

poetry_tang_ea93d20f.title: Suburban Living, To Li
poetry_tang_ea93d20f.summary: Living in poverty as a poet, the author feels like the world's most destitute soul. He laments that even his acquaintances fail to offer him support.

poetry_tang_8dc4c13e.title: To a Poet Friend
poetry_tang_8dc4c13e.summary: The poet misses his kindred spirit as years pass by. He finds solace in the flowing stream, which washes away the dust of his weary travels.

poetry_tang_1c3b103b.title: At Old Man Tian's Home
poetry_tang_1c3b103b.summary: An old man enjoys a carefree life in his village, free from taxes and surrounded by family. The poem depicts his simple contentment and evokes a longing for such peace.

poetry_tang_9e8d54d7.title: Chang'an Winter Day
poetry_tang_9e8d54d7.summary: In a cold Chang'an winter, a scholar struggles with his unfulfilled ambitions. Despite his bleak surroundings, he holds onto hope and refuses to retreat into seclusion.

poetry_tang_eb6fb1f8.title: After Rain at Tangxing Temple
poetry_tang_eb6fb1f8.summary: After rain, the poet visits an old temple and feels a sudden pang of homesickness. He laments his inability to find the stillness that the monks possess.

poetry_tang_cd4aa43c.title: From Mountains to Friend
poetry_tang_cd4aa43c.summary: Living in the mountains, the poet is too absorbed in poetry to farm, resulting in poverty. He mocks his own lack of success, revealing a bittersweet resignation.

poetry_tang_39c9ab3c.title: Self-Description
poetry_tang_39c9ab3c.summary: The poet laments his lack of recognition, noting that his honest words often offend others. With no other path, he turns to poetry as his sole outlet.

poetry_tang_16b23af4.title: At Jiangshan Temple
poetry_tang_16b23af4.summary: At Jiangshan Temple, the poet is captivated by the scenery and the monks. Though writing is a laborious task, completing the poem brings him great satisfaction.

poetry_tang_9159a289.title: Autumn Illness at Inn
poetry_tang_9159a289.summary: Ill and confined to an inn during autumn, the poet reflects on his fading youth and failed ambitions. He feels deep sorrow over his isolation and lack of recognition.

poetry_tang_390221a6.title: Autumn Night at Mountain Lodge
poetry_tang_390221a6.summary: On a long autumn night, the cold wind and falling leaves mirror the poet's melancholy. He reaffirms that a man's purpose transcends mere survival, focusing on higher ideals.

poetry_tang_09f16b1e.title: To an Old Monk
poetry_tang_09f16b1e.summary: The poet depicts an old monk's ascetic travels and Zen heart. While praising his detachment, he reveals regret for his own lack of enlightenment.

poetry_tang_d9afa132.title: Farewell to My Younger Brother
poetry_tang_d9afa132.summary: Parting in autumn, the poet wipes tears and avoids looking back. The uncertainty of his journey evokes a sense of melancholy regarding his unfulfilled ambitions.

poetry_tang_4d4f3ea9.title: Farewell in Snow to Friend
poetry_tang_4d4f3ea9.summary: Drinking with a friend amidst snow, the poet struggles to mask his sorrow. He laments the difficulty of his career, feeling anxious in the bleak twilight.

poetry_tang_9b71bfcc.title: At Yuelu Temple
poetry_tang_9b71bfcc.summary: The serene scenery of Yuelu Temple captivates the poet. Through the landscape, he reflects on his unsettled mind and lingering worldly attachments.

poetry_tang_262c0aa3.title: Remembering Lushan Study
poetry_tang_262c0aa3.summary: Recalling his recluse life in Lushan, the poet cherishes the simple, peaceful days. He laments how the pursuit of fame has pulled him away from nature.

poetry_tang_e4d7a7bb.title: Tangxing Temple Small Pine
poetry_tang_e4d7a7bb.summary: The small pine shows early signs of nobility, waiting to endure frost. The poet identifies with the tree, expressing his desire to mature through hardship.

poetry_tang_2c0fb21d.title: Parting Talk with Friend
poetry_tang_2c0fb21d.summary: Traveling as a guest, the poet laments the fleeting nature of time and frequent partings. The hardship of his wandering life leaves him feeling helpless.

poetry_tang_b6585e59.title: To Lushan Hermit
poetry_tang_b6585e59.summary: The hermit lives a peaceful life in a mountain cave. The poet admires his detachment from the world, revealing a longing for such reclusive freedom.

poetry_tang_4968ad7c.title: Remembering Zige Hermit
poetry_tang_4968ad7c.summary: The poet depicts the hermit's serene life in the mountains. The cold stars and moon at the end evoke a sense of longing for seclusion and lingering solitude.

poetry_tang_f1fea5c3.title: At Abbot Hui's Courtyard
poetry_tang_f1fea5c3.summary: The poet praises the monk for maintaining inner peace amidst the bustling city. This state of hidden enlightenment leaves the poet feeling transcendent and full of admiration.

poetry_tang_98534257.title: Seeing Off Huang Nankui
poetry_tang_98534257.summary: The poet consoles an exiled official, affirming his integrity and the public's support. The lines convey deep sympathy and respect for the righteous man.

poetry_tang_8fb7424e.title: Seeing Off Graduated Envoy
poetry_tang_8fb7424e.summary: The poet bids farewell to a foreign scholar returning home after success. Despite the long distance, the poem is filled with warm wishes for the traveler's journey.

poetry_tang_c435b264.title: Before Exam, To My Patron
poetry_tang_c435b264.summary: The poet laments his late success and expresses loyalty to his patron. The poem reveals a mix of anxiety over unfulfilled potential and steadfast devotion.

poetry_tang_237ece80.title: Seeing Friend to Jiangzhou
poetry_tang_237ece80.summary: The poet encourages a friend heading to Jiangzhou, hoping he will benefit the people. The tone is calm, reflecting confidence in the friend's future governance.

poetry_tang_4a3a306f.title: Bidding Farewell to Minister
poetry_tang_4a3a306f.summary: The poet bids farewell to his mentor, expressing deep gratitude and sadness. The final image of tears highlights the profound bond and sorrow of parting.

poetry_tang_d3f2a23f.title: Farewell to My Uncle
poetry_tang_d3f2a23f.summary: The poet parts with his uncle, lamenting the hardships of the world and travel. The poem leaves a feeling of homesickness and the melancholy of a wanderer.

poetry_tang_87cbb664.title: Seeing Off to the South
poetry_tang_87cbb664.summary: The poet bids farewell to a friend heading south, lamenting the arduous journey and uncertain future. The poem conveys deep empathy and resignation regarding the traveler's wandering life.

poetry_tang_2822c23c.title: Passing Jia Dao's Tomb
poetry_tang_2822c23c.summary: Visiting Jia Dao's tomb, the poet reflects on the poet's tragic life and lonely end. The verses are filled with indignation and sorrow for a talent unrecognized by fate.

poetry_tang_1ba62466.title: Autumn Night Mooring
poetry_tang_1ba62466.summary: Mooring on an autumn night, the poet gazes at the scenery and misses home under the full moon. The solitary fisherman accompanies him, evoking a sense of lonely wanderlust.

poetry_tang_ad41f147.title: Before Exam, To Zhang Ji
poetry_tang_ad41f147.summary: Using a bride as a metaphor, the poet subtly asks the examiner to judge his work. The tone is restrained, capturing pre-exam anxiety and anticipation.

poetry_tang_e426f3b1.title: Palace Poem
poetry_tang_e426f3b1.summary: Palace maids hesitate to speak, fearing the parrot might overhear. The poem depicts the suffocating atmosphere of court life and the women's inner fear.

poetry_tang_f4efee4f.title: Boating on the Stream
poetry_tang_f4efee4f.summary: The poet drifts along a stream, fully immersed in natural beauty. The serene scenery and leisurely boating create a sense of detachment from the world.

poetry_tang_f96ffe00.title: Lodging at Hermit Chen's Study
poetry_tang_f96ffe00.summary: Lodging at a hermit's study, the poet enjoys tea and poetry with his host. The elegant surroundings and congenial conversation leave him too inspired to sleep.

poetry_tang_36b0eb15.title: To Prefect Shen of Xuanzhou
poetry_tang_36b0eb15.summary: The poet praises Prefect Shen's achievements and reputation, expressing deep admiration. The ornate language conveys respect and high expectations for the virtuous official.

poetry_tang_3b148dc8.title: Farewell to Xiao Bao, Hangzhou
poetry_tang_3b148dc8.summary: The poet parts with his friend amidst green hills and white waves. A lingering sense of sorrow remains.

poetry_tang_f8337ad2.title: Farewell to Grand Historian Sheng
poetry_tang_f8337ad2.summary: The friend departs for a bright future amid bleak autumn scenery. The poem blends farewell with encouragement.

poetry_tang_4d1b5495.title: Lodging at Daoist Temple
poetry_tang_4d1b5495.summary: Lodging in a Daoist temple at night, the poet listens to sacred chants under the moon. A serene, otherworldly peace lingers.

poetry_tang_88ffe1e5.title: Prefect Han's Feast, Huzhou
poetry_tang_88ffe1e5.summary: Ill and joyless at the feast, the poet is granted quiet time to gaze at mountains. A sense of detached leisure remains.

poetry_tang_cc31438c.title: Inscription at Xianyou Temple
poetry_tang_cc31438c.summary: The ancient temple features mossy stones, waterfalls, and immortal legends. A deep, mysterious ambiance lingers.

poetry_tang_af308653.title: Young Nobleman's Song
poetry_tang_af308653.summary: The young noble revels in pleasure, snapping willow twigs with his whip. It captures wild, carefree youth.

poetry_tang_4e9d28db.title: Farewell to Chen Biao
poetry_tang_4e9d28db.summary: The poet instructs the servant to guard his master and avoid danger in spring. Warm care and anticipation linger.

poetry_tang_6cc85aef.title: Visiting an Old Temple
poetry_tang_6cc85aef.summary: Seeking an old temple, the poet follows a white deer deep into the mountains. A magical, secluded journey concludes.

poetry_tang_0c954803.title: Southern Ridge Road
poetry_tang_0c954803.summary: The poet travels south, where coral trees bloom instead of snow. The scene evokes a warm, refreshing atmosphere.

poetry_tang_be260a40.title: Chongyang Feast with Prefect Li
poetry_tang_be260a40.summary: On the Double Ninth Festival, friends feast at a pavilion. Gazing at green islands while intoxicated, the poet feels serene.

poetry_tang_2529cebc.title: To Secretary Zhang
poetry_tang_2529cebc.summary: The poet reflects on years of mentorship from Secretary Zhang. Overwhelmed by gratitude, he finds words insufficient to express his loyalty.

poetry_tang_2e06bbf9.title: Cooling at Fenghuang Pool
poetry_tang_2e06bbf9.summary: By a cool, deep pool, butterflies and fish create a tranquil scene. The poet enjoys a peaceful day of leisure with his friend.

poetry_tang_daa60a61.title: To Chancellor Linghu of Bianzhou
poetry_tang_daa60a61.summary: Chancellor Linghu remains influential after leaving office, known for both governance and poetry. The poet expresses deep respect for him.

poetry_tang_d0a39014.title: Farewell to Yu, Envoy to Tibet
poetry_tang_d0a39014.summary: Envoy Yu departs for a distant, desolate frontier. The poet captures the vast landscape while hoping for his friend's safe return.

poetry_tang_db29c6b6.title: Farewell to Magistrate Ding
poetry_tang_db29c6b6.summary: Magistrate Ding is beloved even before reaching his post. Amidst the rain and rice fields, the poet envisions his future scholarly life.

poetry_tang_6d9cace3.title: Farewell to Wei, Aide to Lingzhou
poetry_tang_6d9cace3.summary: Wei departs for a frontier post, leaving friends behind with heavy hearts. The poet expresses confidence in his wisdom and future success.

poetry_tang_7c668f82.title: To Prefect Li of Jiangzhou
poetry_tang_7c668f82.summary: The poet praises Prefect Li's reputation and his peaceful governance. The poem concludes with a sense of admiration and relief at the prosperity of the region.

poetry_tang_d4f4fd52.title: Missing Secretary Tian on the Road
poetry_tang_d4f4fd52.summary: The poet recalls time spent with Secretary Tian, lamenting their separation and the fleeting nature of dreams. It conveys deep friendship and lingering sorrow.

poetry_tang_75f20c31.title: Snowy Night with Monk Zhen
poetry_tang_75f20c31.summary: On a snowy night, the poet lodges with a monk, finding clarity in their conversation. This transcendent gathering leaves the poet reflecting on noble character.

poetry_tang_e4f544a3.title: Lodging at Yao's with Friends
poetry_tang_e4f544a3.summary: Friends gather on a snowy night, cherishing their rare meeting despite poverty. The poem captures the warmth of their bond and the regret of parting.

poetry_tang_00adeb30.title: Thunder as Green Bamboo
poetry_tang_00adeb30.summary: The poet describes the elegance and resilience of green bamboo to symbolize noble character. It leaves the reader with a sense of refreshing purity.

poetry_tang_7303cf30.title: Inscription at Qinglong Temple
poetry_tang_7303cf30.summary: Visiting Qinglong Temple at sunset, the poet finds peace amidst the mountains and red leaves. The serene scene evokes a sense of spiritual tranquility.

poetry_tang_dc96ca7b.title: Farewell to Teng, Retiring to Jiangnan
poetry_tang_dc96ca7b.summary: The poet bids farewell to an official retiring to his hometown, honoring his choice to live in seclusion. It conveys warm wishes for his peaceful life.

poetry_tang_5a5d4ab5.title: Summer Inscription for Clerk Yao
poetry_tang_5a5d4ab5.summary: The poet depicts Clerk Yao's leisurely summer life, free from the burdens of office. It leaves a sense of longing for such a detached, peaceful existence.

poetry_tang_0895a63b.title: Farewell to Zhang Jingxuan, Returning East
poetry_tang_0895a63b.summary: The poet bids farewell to a failed candidate, shifting from sorrow to hope for his future. It leaves a feeling of warm encouragement.

poetry_tang_4192be5e.title: Farewell to Gu Feixiong, Failed Exam
poetry_tang_4192be5e.summary: The poet consoles a friend who failed the exam, praising his poetic fame. The poem ends with a sense of shared, enduring resilience.

poetry_tang_b5bcbe05.title: Farewell to Wei Yao, Aide to Zhejiang
poetry_tang_b5bcbe05.summary: The poet sends off an official to his new post, highlighting his bright prospects. It leaves an impression of pride and hopeful anticipation.

poetry_tang_918d7491.title: Searching for Jia Dao's Residence
poetry_tang_918d7491.summary: The poet visits a recluse, finding peace amidst nature. The scene shifts to a moonlit night, evoking a sense of quiet companionship.

poetry_tang_e91bf25e.title: Inscription at Pilin Monastery
poetry_tang_e91bf25e.summary: The poet visits a serene monastery, finding stillness in the autumn atmosphere. It leaves a lingering feeling of spiritual tranquility.

poetry_tang_d3d7c4d5.title: Farewell to Censor Li, Envoy to Tibet
poetry_tang_d3d7c4d5.summary: The poet bids farewell to an envoy heading to the harsh frontier. The poem conveys a somber tone regarding the dangers ahead.

poetry_tang_693b6a8a.title: Gazing at Xiaoguan Pass
poetry_tang_693b6a8a.summary: The poet observes the harsh, militarized life at the frontier. The grim atmosphere leaves a feeling of solemnity and restraint.

poetry_tang_40120e32.title: Farewell to Han, Aide to Jiangxi
poetry_tang_40120e32.summary: The poet bids farewell to a friend heading to Jiangxi, lamenting the passage of spring. It leaves a sense of melancholy and stagnation.

poetry_tang_da1b5942.title: Inscription for Secretary Wang
poetry_tang_da1b5942.summary: The poet retires and lives in illness amidst simple, secluded woods. This isolation evokes a sense of detached contentment.

poetry_tang_8d3ce862.title: Mountain Dwelling
poetry_tang_8d3ce862.summary: The poet returns to the mountains, living in harmony with nature. Scenes of deer and clouds evoke a serene, reclusive spirit.

poetry_tang_fab5f54e.title: Revisiting Monk Weizhen's Dwelling
poetry_tang_fab5f54e.summary: Revisiting a monk, the poet abandons worldly fame for inner peace. Fallen leaves and sunset hues create a tranquil, aging state of mind.

poetry_tang_0608fa5d.title: Visiting Puzhao Temple with Shi Zhou
poetry_tang_0608fa5d.summary: Visiting a temple with a friend, the poet finds leisure in the quiet woods. Sipping tea amidst temple bells relieves his long-standing weariness.

poetry_tang_fda627bb.title: On Hermit Ren's Dwelling
poetry_tang_fda627bb.summary: The poet visits a hermit's cottage, admiring his simple yet elegant life. Moonlight and flowers highlight a deep respect for his spiritual purity.

poetry_tang_060e8bfb.title: Sending a Monk to Taiyuan
poetry_tang_060e8bfb.summary: The poet bids farewell to a monk traveling through cold forests and snow. The blend of Zen and poetry lends a lofty tone to the parting.

poetry_tang_16766e23.title: Farewell to Secretary Li
poetry_tang_16766e23.summary: The poet parts from a friend to journey toward Chang'an. Despite the cold and lonely road, his resolve to pursue his future remains firm.

poetry_tang_a3c69f0e.title: To Lu Buque
poetry_tang_a3c69f0e.summary: Watching a friend depart, the poet laments the fleeting reunion. His longing for their intellectual discourse reveals a deep attachment to their bond.

poetry_tang_812eaf6e.title: Visiting Monk Xiaozhi's Home
poetry_tang_812eaf6e.summary: The poet visits a monk's tranquil courtyard, admiring its serene beauty. The scene is perfect, yet the absence of flowing water leaves a slight sense of longing.

poetry_tang_c29a7cf5.title: Sending Monk to Jinyun
poetry_tang_c29a7cf5.summary: The poet bids a monk farewell to Jinyun, reflecting that all places offer spiritual connection. The poem captures the quiet solitude of a monk's journey.

poetry_tang_773f4ec6.title: To a Daoist
poetry_tang_773f4ec6.summary: This poem depicts a gaunt, reclusive Daoist master of secret arts. By asking about his dwelling, the poet expresses deep reverence for his transcendent life.

poetry_tang_50a1770c.title: Hangzhou Lu's Mountain Pavilion
poetry_tang_50a1770c.summary: The poet enjoys the serene mountain pavilion amidst his official duties. Watching the tides and falling leaves, he finds peace within the quiet landscape.

poetry_tang_444099db.title: Sending Monk Pin to Qin
poetry_tang_444099db.summary: Sending a monk to Qin, the poet reflects on the long path of spiritual awakening. The poem conveys deep respect for the monk's meditative life.

poetry_tang_f10bd7b3.title: Zither Song: Parting Crane
poetry_tang_f10bd7b3.summary: A solitary crane flies through clouds and moonlight, separated from its flock. Using the crane as a metaphor, the poem expresses profound loneliness and displacement.

poetry_tang_acde8bab.title: Youth Ballad I
poetry_tang_acde8bab.summary: A spirited youth rides with ambition and martial pride. The poem captures the exuberant energy and heroic confidence of a successful young warrior.

poetry_tang_88b10c5c.title: Youth Ballad II
poetry_tang_88b10c5c.summary: A youth gallops through spring rain, dressed in fine, shimmering attire. The scene captures a fleeting, vibrant moment of youthful freedom and elegance.

poetry_tang_309b3e13.title: Reflections
poetry_tang_309b3e13.summary: Reflecting on the rise and fall of the Tang, the poet laments constant warfare and political instability. He expresses his deep concern for the nation, ultimately entrusting his grievances to the spirit of Jia Yi.

poetry_tang_d4a298ef.title: Du Qiuniang's Poem
poetry_tang_d4a298ef.summary: This poem recounts the tragic life of Du Qiuniang, from favored concubine to destitute commoner, highlighting the fickleness of fate. The poet uses her story to reflect on the transience of life and political upheaval.

poetry_tang_7312ad73.title: Drinking Alone in Prefecture
poetry_tang_7312ad73.summary: Drinking alone in his prefecture, the poet reflects on his life and national affairs. He expresses a grand ambition to serve the state, yet feels a sense of absurdity and sorrow amidst his helplessness.

poetry_tang_ccc9069e.title: Zhang Haohao's Poem
poetry_tang_ccc9069e.summary: Reuniting with the former courtesan Zhang Haohao, the poet is moved by her decline into poverty. Through contrasting the past and present, he laments the fleeting nature of beauty and the shifting tides of life.

poetry_tang_db324406.title: Winter Solstice to Nephew
poetry_tang_db324406.summary: On the winter solstice, the poet writes to his young nephew, urging him to study hard and serve the country. It conveys the poet's deep affection and his high hopes for the family's future.

poetry_tang_305e268e.title: Li Gan's Poem
poetry_tang_305e268e.summary: Recounting Li Gan's exile for his outspokenness, the poet expresses deep sympathy for the loyal official. The poem is filled with indignation at the corrupt court and the suffering of virtuous men.

poetry_tang_90ba0542.title: Farewell to Ji in Luoyang
poetry_tang_90ba0542.summary: Bidding farewell to the hermit Ji, the poet admires his detached spirit. Through discussions of history and reality, the poet reveals his complex feelings regarding the brevity of life and the constraints of officialdom.

poetry_tang_8bb8395a.title: Farewell to Shen in Suzhou
poetry_tang_8bb8395a.summary: Sending off Shen to Suzhou to serve under Li, the poet praises his talent and expresses high expectations. The poem conveys a sincere hope that his friend will finally realize his ambitions.

poetry_tang_d561c252.title: Farewell to Friend, Hunan
poetry_tang_d561c252.summary: The poet bids farewell to a friend heading to Hunan, describing the desolate landscape. Despite the parting sorrow, he embraces a relaxed attitude of drinking and sleeping.

poetry_tang_88109c9d.title: Imperial Air
poetry_tang_88109c9d.summary: The poem praises the emperor's virtuous rule, citing historical models of governance. The poet expresses a desire to join the imperial campaign to secure the borders.

poetry_tang_2bea96e6.title: Thoughts in Snow
poetry_tang_2bea96e6.summary: Amidst heavy snow, the poet laments wasted talent and border instability. Though he harbors strategic ambitions, he ultimately turns to wine to find personal peace.

poetry_tang_920a8f55.title: Composed in Rain
poetry_tang_920a8f55.summary: In a remote region, the poet drinks alone amidst autumn rain. He uses intoxication to transcend worldly concerns, revealing a detached and reclusive spirit.

poetry_tang_a509dd77.title: Visiting Shi'ang Temple
poetry_tang_a509dd77.summary: Visiting a temple, the poet finds beauty in nature but feels burdened by worldly affairs. Conversations with a monk prompt reflection on his weary career.

poetry_tang_360fb448.title: Entering Bian River, to Li
poetry_tang_360fb448.summary: Sailing the Bian River, the poet depicts a grand autumn dawn and the hardships of the people. Amidst political turmoil, he trusts his friend to understand his heart.

poetry_tang_7d513782.title: Drinking Alone
poetry_tang_7d513782.summary: Drinking alone at an ancient temple, the poet contemplates the vastness of the universe and human insignificance. Wine becomes his companion, dwarfing all worldly worries.

poetry_tang_b8675fcc.title: Cherishing Spring
poetry_tang_b8675fcc.summary: As spring fades, the poet drinks to cherish the falling blossoms, lamenting the relentless passage of time. He tries to hold onto spring, but can only savor its end.

poetry_tang_bb94dd62.title: On Fuyun Temple Tower
poetry_tang_bb94dd62.summary: The poet recalls a past gathering at Fuyun Temple, lamenting the relentless passage of time. Amidst the drifting willow catkins on the riverbank, he is left with a profound and tangled sense of parting sorrow.

poetry_tang_7f9d1cf8.title: Passing Lishan
poetry_tang_7f9d1cf8.summary: Using the First Emperor's construction of his tomb as a lens, the poet critiques the cruelty of tyrannical rule. Even as the dynasty turns to ash, the historical tragedy leaves a haunting warning about the suffering of the common people.

poetry_tang_834156b1.title: Farewell to Meng Chi
poetry_tang_834156b1.summary: This long poem chronicles the deep friendship and repeated partings between the poet and Meng Chi, reflecting on the frustrations of his career. It concludes with wild drinking and singing to face aging, revealing a transcendent, detached spirit.

poetry_tang_7ffbf7f4.title: A Second Farewell
poetry_tang_7ffbf7f4.summary: The poet encourages his friend to head to the frontier with the vigor of a warrior to achieve merit. Though the court favors literary grace, the poet asserts that the defense of the realm ultimately requires martial strength.

poetry_tang_3f425f96.title: On Naughty Water Pavilion
poetry_tang_3f425f96.summary: The poet depicts the scenic beauty and simple customs around the pavilion, expressing a longing for a reclusive life. Yet, as a traveler in a strange land, he cannot suppress the melancholy of missing his distant home.

poetry_tang_3afc28ec.title: On Kaiyuan Temple
poetry_tang_3afc28ec.summary: Standing atop the Xie Tiao Tower, the poet laments the transience of dynasties and human life. Amidst the serene temple scenery, only a cup of wine and the spring rain remain to accompany his reflections on the past and present.

poetry_tang_79c6894a.title: Great Rain Ballad
poetry_tang_79c6894a.summary: Through a vivid description of a violent rainstorm, the poet contrasts his former youthful vigor with his current aging state. Confronted by the power of nature, he is struck by the sorrowful realization of time's irreversible passage.

poetry_tang_1b280e9e.title: To Pei Tan on Road
poetry_tang_1b280e9e.summary: Revisiting Xuanzhou, the poet laments that while the scenery remains, people have changed, save for the eastward-flowing river. Parting with Pei Tan, he drinks to drown his sorrows, expressing a desire to retire into a life of wandering.

poetry_tang_dfbe3a5b.title: To Hermit Yuan
poetry_tang_dfbe3a5b.summary: A hermit lives a simple, detached life in the countryside. The poet reflects on life's inherent dissatisfaction, leaving a sense of respect for such tranquility.

poetry_tang_40c21c36.title: Village Stroll
poetry_tang_40c21c36.summary: A spring village stroll reveals a peaceful, idyllic scene. The poet’s encounter with local hospitality evokes a deep longing for rustic simplicity.

poetry_tang_cc4b0335.title: General Shi I
poetry_tang_cc4b0335.summary: A once-victorious general is now forgotten in times of peace. The contrast between past glory and present neglect evokes a profound sense of melancholy.

poetry_tang_afc7a69a.title: General Shi II
poetry_tang_afc7a69a.summary: The poet praises the general's strength and hopes for his return to military command. The verses convey a mix of patriotic concern and martial aspiration.

poetry_tang_4cfa8284.title: Huaqing Palace 30 Rhymes
poetry_tang_4cfa8284.summary: The poem traces the rise and fall of Huaqing Palace, lamenting the fleeting nature of prosperity. The desolate ending leaves a heavy sense of historical sorrow.

poetry_tang_d6d216c8.title: Chang'an Miscellaneous Poems 1
poetry_tang_d6d216c8.summary: Chang'an is filled with splendor and ambition. Yet, behind the brilliance, the poet uses the image of a weeping veteran to lament the waste of talent.

poetry_tang_3056118b.title: Chang'an Miscellaneous Poems 2
poetry_tang_3056118b.summary: The elite indulge in the luxuries of a Chang'an spring. The poet’s self-mockery regarding his own scholarly efforts highlights a bitter sense of unfulfilled potential.

poetry_tang_45c1c993.title: Chang'an Miscellaneous Poems 3
poetry_tang_45c1c993.summary: Chang'an is vibrant with spring, and the youth are lost in joy. Amidst the revelry, the poet feels isolated, leaving a sense of resignation toward passing time.

poetry_tang_1ec87cda.title: Chang'an Miscellaneous Poems 4
poetry_tang_1ec87cda.summary: The poet mocks his bureaucratic failure, finding refuge in wine. He concludes by longing for ancient sages, revealing a sense of lonely self-regard.

poetry_tang_e264ca33.title: Chang'an Miscellaneous Poems 5
poetry_tang_e264ca33.summary: The poem depicts the splendor of Chang'an in spring with majestic imagery. This lavish description leaves a feeling of intoxication with imperial prosperity.

poetry_tang_e0442fb6.title: Chang'an Miscellaneous Poems 6
poetry_tang_e0442fb6.summary: It contrasts the luxury of the elite with imperial humility. The ending mocks the pursuit of fame, reflecting a detached and sober perspective.

poetry_tang_0cba1e7f.title: Hehuang
poetry_tang_0cba1e7f.summary: The poet laments the lost frontier and the forgotten loyalists, leaving only songs behind. It evokes a poignant sense of historical sorrow and helplessness.

poetry_tang_bd954d12.title: To Commissioner Xu 10 Rhymes
poetry_tang_bd954d12.summary: The poem praises a friend's retirement in the south amidst serene autumn scenery. It conveys a deep longing for a life free from worldly burdens.

poetry_tang_2360035f.title: To Secretary Li Min 1
poetry_tang_2360035f.summary: It mourns the persecution of upright officials in a corrupted court. The poet identifies with a fisherman, revealing a disillusioned desire to withdraw.

poetry_tang_17eafe31.title: Early Autumn 1
poetry_tang_17eafe31.summary: The chilly autumn wind and fading fireflies stir feelings of sorrow. Seeing a single falling leaf triggers the poet's melancholy over his aging years.

poetry_tang_409c5a7a.title: Autumn Day at Tongguan Pass
poetry_tang_409c5a7a.summary: Amidst the desolate autumn scenery, the poet reflects while traveling to the capital. The vast landscape leaves him yearning for a simple, reclusive life.

poetry_tang_073c5060.title: Boating with Minister Wang
poetry_tang_073c5060.summary: A painted boat drifts through a lotus pond, capturing vibrant life. As the party ends under the full moon, a lingering, tipsy solitude remains.

poetry_tang_71322d5b.title: To Hermit Pei
poetry_tang_71322d5b.summary: A hermit reads amidst falling snow, living a refined, detached life. Facing the clear waters, the poet admires his noble, reclusive spirit.

poetry_tang_716ba9f5.title: Facing the Snow
poetry_tang_716ba9f5.summary: North winds bring snow to a festive hall filled with song. The beauty of the scene carries a chill, yet promises a bountiful harvest.

poetry_tang_ba13abd1.title: Hermit Wang
poetry_tang_ba13abd1.summary: A hermit returns to the mountains for a life of leisure and health. Detached from worldly schemes, he seems ready to transcend into immortality.

poetry_tang_789cad59.title: Early Autumn 2
poetry_tang_789cad59.summary: A falling leaf sparks autumn melancholy and reflections on a stalled career. Gazing at distant clouds, the poet feels the bitterness of unfulfilled ambition.

poetry_tang_f67b6e19.title: Early Autumn 3
poetry_tang_f67b6e19.summary: As autumn fades, the poet turns to wine and verse to soothe his solitude. On a stormy night, he writes poems about his humble endurance.

poetry_tang_decfc727.title: Night Return to Luodong Monastery
poetry_tang_decfc727.summary: A traveler returns home at night, lamenting a life spent wandering. The dim mountain twilight mirrors the uncertainty and loneliness of his path.

poetry_tang_c5a511ec.title: Farewell to Duan Jue
poetry_tang_c5a511ec.summary: A friend returns to his secluded mountain home, where moss and red leaves offer peace. Watching him depart, the poet feels the traveler's heavy heart.

poetry_tang_2e30a313.title: To Monks and Hermits
poetry_tang_2e30a313.summary: The poet writes to distant friends, depicting a scene of clouds and water. He turns to express a desire to transcend worldly fame, leaving a sense of peaceful detachment.

poetry_tang_5516293e.title: To Monk Qiying
poetry_tang_5516293e.summary: Autumn bells and laundry stones create a desolate evening scene. The poet laments his failed ambitions, ending with a feeling of profound loneliness.

poetry_tang_04804f2f.title: Morning Rise 1
poetry_tang_04804f2f.summary: Morning dew and fading lamps create a serene, elegant atmosphere. The poet finds inner peace, leaving a sense of calm, monastic contentment.

poetry_tang_0a5a2fc2.title: Morning Rise 2
poetry_tang_0a5a2fc2.summary: In a bamboo study, nature's sounds highlight a quiet life. The poet reflects on aging, conveying a sense of detachment from worldly affairs.

poetry_tang_574d16a4.title: Dawn Departure from Yinjiang North Crossing to Cui and Han
poetry_tang_574d16a4.summary: A dawn departure amidst frost evokes a sense of parting. Despite the sorrow of travel, the poet finds comfort in enduring bonds of friendship.

poetry_tang_ccbbd979.title: Monk Yingshang
poetry_tang_ccbbd979.summary: By a cold lamp, the poet laments his aging and incomplete spiritual cultivation. He expresses both a longing for enlightenment and inner uncertainty.

poetry_tang_68cfc409.title: On the Way to Guangling
poetry_tang_68cfc409.summary: On the road to Guangling, ancient ruins prompt reflections on historical rise and fall. The poet mourns the past, leaving a somber, melancholic tone.

poetry_tang_bf542a48.title: Staying at Kaiyuan Temple Tower
poetry_tang_bf542a48.summary: Alone in a tower, the cold moonlight and pine scent create a lonely night. At dawn, the thought of his long journey home stirs deep sorrow.

poetry_tang_75e08b98.title: Dongling View Wintergreen
poetry_tang_75e08b98.summary: Wintergreen stands firm against frost, yet its harsh environment evokes a sense of solitude. The poet contrasts it with palace willows, admiring its resilient natural beauty.

poetry_tang_85e63106.title: Farewell to Friend from Jingxiang
poetry_tang_85e63106.summary: A friend departs, and the autumn river scene stirs deep sorrow. The wailing apes and rainy night intensify the feeling of melancholy and longing.

poetry_tang_9a18361a.title: Farewell to Senior Cui
poetry_tang_9a18361a.summary: Autumn winds accompany a friend's departure, where desolate scenery triggers memories of the past. The sense of parting deepens amidst the insects' chirping.

poetry_tang_d37078ac.title: Wild Pheasant
poetry_tang_d37078ac.summary: A caged pheasant yearns for the vast, free world. The poet uses this to express a weariness of confinement and a longing for nature.

poetry_tang_6ece728f.title: Lone Goose
poetry_tang_6ece728f.summary: A lone goose flies apart from its flock across cold frontiers. Contrasted with nesting swallows, it highlights the wanderer's profound desolation.

poetry_tang_f6442d98.title: Expressing Feelings
poetry_tang_f6442d98.summary: A beautiful woman laments the fleeting spring and her fading youth. The poem is filled with sorrow and helplessness regarding the passage of time.

poetry_tang_b12f7c55.title: Touring Luoyang
poetry_tang_b12f7c55.summary: The poet surveys the magnificent scenery of Luoyang from a height. Amidst the clear, expansive view, he expresses a longing to reunite with friends.

poetry_tang_95f0a29c.title: Playful Poem on Governor Guo's Hall
poetry_tang_95f0a29c.summary: The summer hall offers a cool, comfortable retreat for leisure. Through delicate descriptions, the poet creates a serene and pleasant atmosphere.

poetry_tang_43979e16.title: Chang'an Night Journey
poetry_tang_43979e16.summary: A traveler in Chang'an laments the cold autumn night. The distant path home stirs a deep, lingering sorrow.

poetry_tang_d12cf75b.title: Mandarin Ducks
poetry_tang_d12cf75b.summary: A lone mandarin duck shivers in the cold, wind-swept pond. Its solitude stems from high ideals rather than a lack of home.

poetry_tang_e75130f8.title: Dirge for Empress Dowager Yi'an
poetry_tang_e75130f8.summary: Spring blooms by the tomb, yet the Empress Dowager rests in eternal night. The funeral music evokes a profound sense of loss.

poetry_tang_c1af482e.title: To My Brother
poetry_tang_c1af482e.summary: Separated from his brother, the poet suffers from poverty and distance. The autumn wind and a lone goose amplify his loneliness.

poetry_tang_62768f20.title: Farewell to Yang Chushi
poetry_tang_62768f20.summary: A friend retires to Qujiang in his old age to seek peace. Despite the sorrow of parting, the secluded life beckons.

poetry_tang_1cd2d760.title: Departing Lingxi Lodge
poetry_tang_1cd2d760.summary: Departing Lingxi, the poet finds harmony in the mountain scenery. The journey through nature feels like a path toward spiritual enlightenment.

poetry_tang_eed7b81f.title: On Recluse Du
poetry_tang_eed7b81f.summary: A recluse lives in serene detachment amidst the mountain snow. The poet visits and reflects on the emptiness of worldly existence.

poetry_tang_36286bfc.title: Goddess Temple
poetry_tang_36286bfc.summary: The goddess temple stands cold and silent in the mountain mist. The poet warns against chasing the illusions of love and desire.

poetry_tang_5ca06cd4.title: Farewell to Li Dingyan
poetry_tang_5ca06cd4.summary: The poet uses wine to mask the sorrow of parting. Facing an empty city with no old friends left, he feels a lingering sense of desolation.

poetry_tang_4d5ae613.title: Early Departure from Zhongyan Temple
poetry_tang_4d5ae613.summary: Departing the temple at dawn, the poet observes the cold, quiet mountain scenery. Weary from his travels, he finds himself unable to share his burdens with the monk.

poetry_tang_85dba0cf.title: At Tongguan Post Station
poetry_tang_85dba0cf.summary: Looking out from Tongguan, the poet views the vast landscape amid autumn winds. Reflecting on his unfulfilled ambitions, he resignedly rides back into the dust.

poetry_tang_39408318.title: Morning at South Pavilion
poetry_tang_39408318.summary: Waking in the pavilion, the poet finds the autumn air cold and clear. Inspired by Tao Yuanming, he expresses a desire to abandon his official post.

poetry_tang_9a265c2e.title: At Sima's Garden, Badong
poetry_tang_9a265c2e.summary: The poet visits a friend living a simple, scholarly life in a rural garden. He admires this detached lifestyle and longs to join him in seclusion.

poetry_tang_55e7cbae.title: Visiting Xinxing Temple, Wéi Mountain
poetry_tang_55e7cbae.summary: Arriving at the village at dusk, the poet observes local farming life and folk customs. He captures the vibrant mountain night, feeling the charm of rustic life.

poetry_tang_486720a5.title: Farewell to Cousin, Part 1
poetry_tang_486720a5.summary: Bidding farewell to his cousin retiring to the mountains, the poet reflects on his noble but impoverished life. He captures the serenity of nature, wishing his cousin peace.

poetry_tang_692908cd.title: Farewell to Cousin, Part 2
poetry_tang_692908cd.summary: The poet laments his cousin's lonely life, now ending in mountain seclusion. He admires the cousin's choice to find peace in the clouds, away from worldly misunderstanding.

poetry_tang_aeecbbc2.title: Village Cottage
poetry_tang_aeecbbc2.summary: Autumn farm life unfolds in a busy, peaceful village. The poet finds comfort in the simple hospitality of the cottage.

poetry_tang_76fc4062.title: Thoughts of Home
poetry_tang_76fc4062.summary: Gazing toward home triggers deep longing and sorrow. The poet entrusts his desire to return to the flowing water.

poetry_tang_98e2f6b2.title: Evening Mooring, Qili Shoal
poetry_tang_98e2f6b2.summary: Evening mooring at the shoal prompts reflection on the vanity of worldly success. The poet seeks solace in the hermit's detachment.

poetry_tang_e8cb81e2.title: To Hermit Wang of Nanshan
