poetry_tang_e8cb81e2.summary: The poem depicts a serene, rustic life in the southern mountains. Memories of past gatherings evoke a longing for such seclusion.

poetry_tang_eb61f58f.title: Morning Attire
poetry_tang_eb61f58f.summary: The cold, harsh morning journey contrasts with the idle comfort of a drunken traveler. The scene highlights the traveler's weary solitude.

poetry_tang_4f097b01.title: At Hermit Wei's West Study
poetry_tang_4f097b01.summary: The hermit’s study is a quiet, secluded retreat from the world. The poet admires the occupant's simple, detached lifestyle.

poetry_tang_0c2684bd.title: Farewell to Li Ming
poetry_tang_0c2684bd.summary: Farewelling a friend on a cold, arduous journey. The poem captures the sorrow of parting and anxiety for the traveler's path.

poetry_tang_1538fe2c.title: Passing Marshal Ma's Residence
poetry_tang_1538fe2c.summary: Visiting a general's ruined estate, the poet laments the transience of glory. The desolate scene evokes a deep sense of historical loss.

poetry_tang_4104bbc9.title: Chang'an Road Song
poetry_tang_4104bbc9.summary: The poet depicts scenes of indulgence in Chang'an, shifting to lament the fleeting nature of time. It leaves a feeling of profound sorrow over lost youth.

poetry_tang_5e2eb239.title: Elegy Song
poetry_tang_5e2eb239.summary: The poem describes a bleak funeral procession, turning into philosophical reflection on the impermanence of life. It conveys a sense of helplessness and melancholy regarding death.

poetry_tang_183538cd.title: Wang Zhaojun Song, Part 1
poetry_tang_183538cd.summary: The poem depicts Zhaojun's haggard appearance after her exile, contrasting it with her past beauty in portraits. It expresses deep sympathy for her tragic fate.

poetry_tang_185702b8.title: Short Song, Part 1
poetry_tang_185702b8.summary: The poet laments the swift passage of time and youth, urging readers to enjoy the present. The poem is filled with resignation and a sense of life's brevity.

poetry_tang_f13fea08.title: Short Song, Part 2
poetry_tang_f13fea08.summary: The poem recounts the hardships of seeking office and the late success that follows, lamenting that glory and youth rarely coincide. It reveals a sense of regret over life's trade-offs.

poetry_tang_f368ac36.title: Against White Hair Song
poetry_tang_f368ac36.summary: Using fire and ice to represent integrity, the poet advocates rising above resentment. It expresses an aspiration for a noble spirit detached from worldly conflicts.

poetry_tang_ce865442.title: Resentment Poem
poetry_tang_ce865442.summary: The poem depicts the loneliness of a neglected palace lady, turning to question where the emperor's new favor lies. It reveals the resentment and misery of abandonment.

poetry_tang_e2ebfc69.title: Crow's Night Cry Song
poetry_tang_e2ebfc69.summary: The poet contrasts the miserable state of a winter crow with the comfort of a caged parrot. It conveys reflections on the coldness of the world and unfair fate.

poetry_tang_e38b624e.title: Lotus Picking Song
poetry_tang_e38b624e.summary: A girl picks lotus flowers and shyly bows when meeting her lover, accidentally dropping her hairpin. The scene is lively, capturing the sweet, bashful essence of young love.

poetry_tang_deefd237.title: Zhaojun's Lament Song
poetry_tang_deefd237.summary: The poet laments Zhaojun’s neglect, blaming the emperor’s fickle favor rather than her portrait. It critiques court injustice and expresses deep sympathy for her tragic fate.

poetry_tang_9db9428c.title: Tragic Journey Song
poetry_tang_9db9428c.summary: Scholars toil in poverty while privileged heirs enjoy unearned luxury. The sharp contrast highlights the poet's frustration with social inequality and the unfairness of life.

poetry_tang_dc97fae8.title: Vast Song
poetry_tang_dc97fae8.summary: Facing the passage of time and unfulfilled ambitions, the poet laments life's brevity. He eventually chooses to let go, finding solace and perspective in wine.

poetry_tang_3005d56c.title: Longing
poetry_tang_3005d56c.summary: A woman yearns for her distant lover through the changing seasons. Her desire to be inseparable like intertwined branches conveys deep, enduring longing.

poetry_tang_ec2706d0.title: Living Separation Song
poetry_tang_ec2706d0.summary: Living separation is more bitter than gall, and the bleak departure scene is heart-wrenching. The poem captures the agony of parting and the toll it takes on the soul.

poetry_tang_c639bfc3.title: Hidden Separation Song
poetry_tang_c639bfc3.summary: Lovers are forced to part in silence, knowing they will never meet again. The poem is filled with suppressed despair, conveying an unspeakable, profound sorrow.

poetry_tang_23263621.title: Difficult Farewell Song
poetry_tang_23263621.summary: Returning from a farewell, the poet finds his tears exhausted, leaving only dust behind. The poem poignantly captures the hollow, overwhelming grief following a final departure.

poetry_tang_ab1f0556.title: Joyful World Song
poetry_tang_ab1f0556.summary: Lively music contrasts with the poet's aging illness. It leaves a sense of melancholy amidst joy.

poetry_tang_55add646.title: Urgent Joyful World Song
poetry_tang_55add646.summary: A seamstress hears an oriole, triggering seasonal sorrows. It reflects on the prevalence of life's disappointments.

poetry_tang_3f467119.title: He Manzi Song
poetry_tang_3f467119.summary: The poem recounts the tragic origin of a song composed before execution. It evokes deep, lingering heartbreak.

poetry_tang_3bd4b5f5.title: Bamboo Branch Song, Part 1
poetry_tang_3bd4b5f5.summary: Cold moonlight at the gorge meets sorrowful singing, stirring the cries of apes. It creates a desolate, haunting scene.

poetry_tang_3535de4f.title: Bamboo Branch Song, Part 2
poetry_tang_3535de4f.summary: Local folk songs echo through the silent night. The poet feels overwhelmed by sorrow and physical illness.

poetry_tang_e257fa1e.title: Bamboo Branch Song 3
poetry_tang_e257fa1e.summary: The poem depicts a cold, rainy scene on the river. It captures a sense of damp, lonely beauty.

poetry_tang_dd67f435.title: Bamboo Branch Song 4
poetry_tang_dd67f435.summary: The bitter tune is revealed to be the work of an exiled official. It highlights the weight of political suffering.

poetry_tang_fc1c440d.title: Willow Branch Song 1
poetry_tang_fc1c440d.summary: Beautiful willow branches sway in an abandoned garden, unseen by anyone. It leaves a feeling of neglect and solitude.

poetry_tang_6f13de42.title: Willow Branch Song 2
poetry_tang_6f13de42.summary: The poem contrasts withered willows with heavenly branches, reflecting on shifting fortunes. Through celestial imagery, it leaves a sense of cosmic uncertainty.

poetry_tang_49e51c76.title: Willow Branch Song 3
poetry_tang_49e51c76.summary: The poet depicts the willow's graceful, emotive swaying in the breeze. The scene of falling blossoms and delicate branches evokes a poignant, elegant beauty.

poetry_tang_36f5d222.title: Willow Branch Song 4
poetry_tang_36f5d222.summary: The poem captures a serene spring scene by a river after rain. The sight of countless drooping willow branches creates a tranquil and poetic atmosphere.

poetry_tang_a7185a68.title: Willow Branch Song 5
poetry_tang_a7185a68.summary: The poet compares willows in Suzhou and Qiantang, then shifts to seeking a local beauty. It conveys a romantic longing for the charm of Jiangnan.

poetry_tang_5c5e4932.title: Willow Branch Song 6
poetry_tang_5c5e4932.summary: The poem depicts a girl playing with willow branches in the wind, crafting rings and flutes. These vivid details capture the spirit of youthful innocence.

poetry_tang_bdf968bb.title: Willow Branch Song 7
poetry_tang_bdf968bb.summary: Comparing willow leaves to teary eyes and dancing waists, the poet pleads for mercy from those who pluck them. It expresses deep empathy for nature.

poetry_tang_fd9e7748.title: Willow Branch Song 8
poetry_tang_fd9e7748.summary: The poet equates willow threads with sorrowful hearts, lamenting the finality of parting. The imagery of broken branches leaves a lingering sense of despair.

poetry_tang_e94a7f83.title: Waves Washing Sand Song 1
poetry_tang_e94a7f83.summary: Waves washing sand symbolize the relentless cycle of worldly turmoil. The poet yearns for the day when nature finds peace, reflecting a desire for tranquility.

poetry_tang_f2f05a27.title: Waves Washing Sand Song 2
poetry_tang_f2f05a27.summary: The poem depicts vast waves and sands, reflecting on the relentless passage of time. It evokes a sense of impermanence and the power of nature.

poetry_tang_de340eac.title: Waves Washing Sand Song 3
poetry_tang_de340eac.summary: The poet travels alone through rain-swept lakes, listening to waves hitting the boat at night. The scene conveys profound loneliness and travel-weary sorrow.

poetry_tang_dbbf8aed.title: Waves Washing Sand Song 4
poetry_tang_dbbf8aed.summary: A woman compares love to tides, lamenting that human hearts are less constant. This contrast reveals that the pain of longing exceeds the deep sea.

poetry_tang_25eee6cc.title: Waves Washing Sand Song 5
poetry_tang_25eee6cc.summary: Using cosmic changes as a metaphor, the poet questions why a lover departs forever. The lines express deep resentment toward an eternal separation.

poetry_tang_40ef5123.title: Waves Washing Sand Song 6
poetry_tang_40ef5123.summary: An exile drifts to the ends of the earth, noting few return. It warns those regaining status not to forget the hardships of their wandering.

poetry_tang_5c2b49f1.title: Peaceful Music Song 1
poetry_tang_5c2b49f1.summary: The poem celebrates a time of harvest and peace, praising the ruler's virtue. It reflects an optimistic hope for a stable, prosperous era.

poetry_tang_d6009739.title: Peaceful Music Song 2
poetry_tang_d6009739.summary: Drawing on the legends of Yao and Shun, the poet expresses a longing for a harmonious society. It emphasizes benevolent, people-centered governance.

poetry_tang_e220259b.title: Remembering Jiangnan Song 3
poetry_tang_e220259b.summary: Recalling the fine wine and dances of Jiangnan, the poet expresses deep nostalgia for the past. It is filled with a yearning for reunion.

poetry_tang_fc8ddee6.title: New Minor Tune Song 1
poetry_tang_fc8ddee6.summary: The palace shines in the autumn sky as music plays. The poet celebrates the emperor's reign, wishing for such prosperity to last forever.

poetry_tang_dfa6dadb.title: New Minor Tune Song 2
poetry_tang_dfa6dadb.summary: Bright moonlight illuminates red skirts in the early autumn palace. The poet lingers in the cool night, savoring the slow passage of time.

poetry_tang_c6036df8.title: Boudoir Lament Song 1
poetry_tang_c6036df8.summary: A woman resents the singing birds and jealous of paired swallows. Unable to bear the separation, she weeps until dawn.

poetry_tang_f94e8f58.title: Boudoir Lament Song 2
poetry_tang_f94e8f58.summary: Cold moonlight fills the room as the woman faces her lamp alone. Her tears on the pillow turn to ice, reflecting deep sorrow.

poetry_tang_70517a46.title: Joyful Reunion, Then Farewell
poetry_tang_70517a46.summary: After ten years of war, a brief reunion ends in another farewell. As they part, the vast autumn mountains loom ahead.

poetry_tang_2efaeacf.title: Jiangnan Lyric
poetry_tang_2efaeacf.summary: A woman laments her merchant husband's constant absence. She regrets not marrying a tide-watcher who keeps his promises.

poetry_tang_3fcb9188.title: Flute at Night on Border
poetry_tang_3fcb9188.summary: Under the frosty moonlight of the border, a flute plays a mournful tune. It stirs deep homesickness in the soldiers guarding the city.

poetry_tang_cb9ba831.title: Jiangnan Tune
poetry_tang_cb9ba831.summary: A woman laments her merchant husband's constant absence. She regrets not marrying a tide-watcher who keeps his promises.

poetry_tang_ca0ba648.title: Purple Steed Cavalry Song
poetry_tang_ca0ba648.summary: The poem depicts a lively cockfighting scene, shifting to lament the fleeting spring and the husband's absence. It leaves a feeling of profound loneliness and sorrow for the abandoned wife.

poetry_tang_f02cca21.title: Setting Up a Feast Song
poetry_tang_f02cca21.summary: Reflecting on the brevity of life during a feast, the poet turns to a desire for transcendence and immortality. The poem is filled with helplessness toward aging and a heavy sigh over life's transience.

poetry_tang_553ef61a.title: Joys & Sorrows of Army
poetry_tang_553ef61a.summary: The poem portrays the hardships and heroism of frontier warfare, shifting to emphasize that one must bear their own joys and sorrows. It leaves a sense of stoic resilience after experiencing life's trials.

poetry_tang_5fb5525a.title: Palace Lament
poetry_tang_5fb5525a.summary: The poem contrasts the vibrant palace festivities with the endless, slow drip of the water clock. It captures the profound isolation and sorrow of a neglected palace woman.

poetry_tang_66b8de3c.title: Youth of Han Palace Song
poetry_tang_66b8de3c.summary: The poem details the decadent lives of noble youths, shifting to lament the fickleness of fortune and power. It leaves a sense of desolation and powerlessness after the collapse of prosperity.

poetry_tang_4bd3d9a0.title: Frivolity Song
poetry_tang_4bd3d9a0.summary: The poem depicts the wild, unrestrained nature of a young knight-errant, shifting to reflect on the coldness of the world. It conveys a sense of hedonism mixed with lingering resentment.

poetry_tang_1ad475cc.title: Song of the Wandering Son
poetry_tang_1ad475cc.summary: The poet expresses frustration with worldly judgment, shifting to urge readers to cherish the fleeting present. It leaves a feeling of clarity and urgency regarding the passage of time.

poetry_tang_699f6699.title: Ancient Parting Song
poetry_tang_699f6699.summary: Using the separation of twin swords to symbolize lovers parting, the poem shifts to accept fate's cruel design. It is enveloped in a sense of fatalistic sorrow and resignation.

poetry_tang_8c42a0e6.title: Partridge Lyric
poetry_tang_8c42a0e6.summary: The Xiang River's spotted bamboo and flying partridges create a melancholic scene. The poet shifts to the speaker's longing, asking after her husband's return with a sense of deep loneliness.

poetry_tang_b8927562.title: Joys & Sorrows of Army
poetry_tang_b8927562.summary: The poem depicts the hardships and heroic spirit of military life on the frontier. By contrasting suffering with duty, it reveals the soldier's complex resolve to serve his country.

poetry_tang_c3aa40d6.title: Climbing the Great Wall
poetry_tang_c3aa40d6.summary: Standing on the ancient Great Wall, the poet reflects on the desolate frontier history. He shifts to praise the current emperor's peaceful reign, expressing relief and reflection.

poetry_tang_17b91f40.title: Miscellaneous Tune
poetry_tang_17b91f40.summary: A young wife bids farewell to her husband, affirming her loyalty to their humble bond. The poem is filled with the sorrow of parting and a fervent hope for enduring love.

poetry_tang_f77a4b80.title: Farewell to Liaoyang Envoy
poetry_tang_f77a4b80.summary: The poet sees off an envoy to Liaoyang, contrasting spring's arrival with lingering war memories. Urging the envoy to defend the border, he expresses a passionate patriotic spirit.

poetry_tang_13679456.title: Early Swallows Farewell
poetry_tang_13679456.summary: Early swallows return to weave through the chilly spring palace. The poet uses the birds to lament the passage of time and separation, leaving a sense of lingering melancholy.

poetry_tang_76743ded.title: Autumn Thoughts by Stream
poetry_tang_76743ded.summary: By a stream on an autumn night, the poet misses a friend amidst the cold scenery. In his lonely musings, he expresses admiration for noble character and deep longing.

poetry_tang_f307df15.title: Moonlit Stream, Letter to Yang
poetry_tang_f307df15.summary: Under the moonlit stream, the poet sends his thoughts to a friend. Amidst the year-end chill, he expresses hopes for his friend's success and personal resolve.

poetry_tang_70533c39.title: Late Spring, Falling Flowers
poetry_tang_70533c39.summary: Late spring flowers fall as birds and butterflies scatter. The poet laments the fading season, leaving a sense of lingering sorrow.

poetry_tang_4add4b5c.title: Hearing of a Friend's Zither
poetry_tang_4add4b5c.summary: A friend is gone, leaving only a zither. Facing the stringless instrument, the poet weeps for the lost companion.

poetry_tang_dbaad104.title: Gifted Mirror, a Poetic Reply
poetry_tang_dbaad104.summary: The mirror reflects graying hair, sparking memories of youth. The poet reflects on time's passage, wishing for eternal perfection.

poetry_tang_3632da06.title: Feast Song
poetry_tang_3632da06.summary: Amidst wine, the poet laments life's brevity and yearns for transcendence. He rejects aging, seeking the freedom of immortals.

poetry_tang_72f33ef5.title: Farewell to Daoist, Night
poetry_tang_72f33ef5.summary: A Daoist departs into the misty mountains. Watching him leave, the poet is filled with the melancholy of parting.

poetry_tang_96360112.title: Observing Retreating Army
poetry_tang_96360112.summary: The moon shines over the returning army on the desolate ridge. The poet uses the sobbing stream to mourn the fallen soldiers.

poetry_tang_496833f4.title: South Temple of Hua Mountain
poetry_tang_496833f4.summary: In the quiet temple amidst spring grass, the poet offers prayers. He reflects on history, pleading for the protection of the righteous.

poetry_tang_1df83fea.title: Joy of Friend's Visit
poetry_tang_1df83fea.summary: Old friends reunite during the rain to share their journeys. Amidst the gloomy city, the poet finds a rare moment of comfort.

poetry_tang_f6a13443.title: Farewell at Bamboo Garden
poetry_tang_f6a13443.summary: Farewell in the bamboo garden amidst cold winds. Inner melancholy deepens as the departure brings a chilling sense of sorrow.

poetry_tang_133f9f00.title: Moonlit Joy, Friend's Arrival
poetry_tang_133f9f00.summary: Joy fills the moonlit night upon a friend's arrival. The beauty of the scene transforms loneliness into a lingering sense of happiness.

poetry_tang_f89516d0.title: Arriving North at Taiyuan
poetry_tang_f89516d0.summary: Arriving in Taiyuan, the poet reflects on the arduous founding of the Tang. The rugged landscape evokes thoughts on the endurance of the state.

poetry_tang_f3259e67.title: Visiting Hermit at Hua Mountain
poetry_tang_f3259e67.summary: Visiting a mountain hermitage, the poet finds an unreadable celestial text. He laments the futility of his official career and lost aspirations.

poetry_tang_4ed0b68a.title: Mirror Dismissed
poetry_tang_4ed0b68a.summary: Gazing into the mirror, the poet is struck by his aging reflection. He chooses to hide the mirror to avoid the pain of self-recognition.

poetry_tang_99da87d8.title: Hua Yin Spring Gathering
poetry_tang_99da87d8.summary: Gathering by the spring, the poet admires the landscape while reflecting on his life as a wandering official, feeling adrift and homesick.

poetry_tang_e57d13e2.title: Reply to Guo Huangzhong
poetry_tang_e57d13e2.summary: Like a drifting cloud, the poet laments his distance from home. As winter approaches, he encourages his friend to endure the fading year.

poetry_tang_2d37684d.title: Waiting by Creek in Vain
poetry_tang_2d37684d.summary: Waiting alone by the creek, the poet finds only the cold autumn night. His friend fails to appear, leaving him to his solitary thoughts.

poetry_tang_833e8e36.title: Bamboo Stream
poetry_tang_833e8e36.summary: The poet visits a quiet bamboo stream, marveling at the serene forest. This pure natural beauty leaves him with a sense of reverence and longing.

poetry_tang_20a56958.title: Farewell to Official Wang
poetry_tang_20a56958.summary: The poet bids farewell to a friend heading to a distant post, filled with sorrow. Facing the sunset and cold waves, he is left with endless longing.

poetry_tang_8cf973e7.title: After Retirement, Gathering Herbs
poetry_tang_8cf973e7.summary: Retired, the poet gathers herbs and encounters signs of immortality. He laments humanity's obsession with fame, yearning only for eternal peace in the mountains.

poetry_tang_c35a417d.title: Summer Retreat at Fayun Temple
poetry_tang_c35a417d.summary: The poet retreats to a temple to escape the summer heat and frontier dust. Amidst the mountain breeze, he sheds worldly worries to find inner liberation.

poetry_tang_508d9fb7.title: From Cavalry General Dou
poetry_tang_508d9fb7.summary: The poet follows a general to war but is discarded after success. Drinking alone in the autumn wind, he laments the fickleness of the world and his unfulfilled potential.

poetry_tang_fec5d4a7.title: Night Departure from Camp
poetry_tang_fec5d4a7.summary: A sudden war report stirs the camp at night, and soldiers prepare for battle. Amidst the chaotic front lines, they fight for honor with fearless resolve.

poetry_tang_d152a5a8.title: Early Start to Shuofang
poetry_tang_d152a5a8.summary: The poet sets out for the frontier, his heart filled with duty despite the cold. Though he feels the sorrow of departure, his resolve to serve his patron remains.

poetry_tang_cf7fb304.title: Youth by the City
poetry_tang_cf7fb304.summary: A frontier youth is brave and skilled in war, hunting beneath the Yin Mountains. Proud of capturing enemies, he embodies a bold and heroic spirit.

poetry_tang_5ba289c5.title: Song of the Wandering Son
poetry_tang_5ba289c5.summary: The poet laments the fickleness of human relationships and urges others to cherish time. It conveys a sense of weariness toward social pretense and the fleeting nature of life.

poetry_tang_5913d253.title: Watering Horses Song
poetry_tang_5913d253.summary: Using the chaotic scene of horses fighting over muddy water, the poet metaphors political intrigue. He feels deep melancholy and concern over the inability to find clarity in a corrupt world.

poetry_tang_3425773d.title: Lotus Pond Inn
poetry_tang_3425773d.summary: The poem depicts the beautiful scenery of the southern water towns and the charm of lotus-picking girls. The poet uses the landscape to express the sorrow of travel and longing.

poetry_tang_20b8f433.title: On the Five Cities Road
poetry_tang_20b8f433.summary: It describes the harsh life of frontier soldiers and the desolate environment. The poem is filled with sympathy for the troops and deep anxiety over the endless wars.

poetry_tang_af037d26.title: Ascending Qinglong Temple
poetry_tang_af037d26.summary: Ascending to view historical ruins, the poet laments the rise and fall of dynasties. He reflects on unfulfilled ambitions and the melancholy of aging as time passes.

poetry_tang_24bdd99b.title: Six-State Barbarian Children Song
poetry_tang_24bdd99b.summary: The poem depicts frontier life and the homesickness of soldiers. Through exotic imagery, it captures the heartbreaking sorrow of those longing for a distant homeland.

poetry_tang_7825cff3.title: Farewell North After Peace
poetry_tang_7825cff3.summary: After the rebellion, the poet bids farewell to a friend returning north, feeling the weight of change. The desolate frontier landscape highlights his sorrow and nostalgia.

poetry_tang_1be081f2.title: Farewell at Yunyang Inn
poetry_tang_1be081f2.summary: Reuniting after a long time only to part again, the poet feels profound loneliness in the cold rain. It conveys deep affection for a friend and the sorrow of parting.

poetry_tang_6b01fd11.title: Joy at Cousin's Stay
poetry_tang_6b01fd11.summary: A poor poet lives alone in a rainy, desolate home until his cousin visits. The contrast between the bleak setting and their warm reunion evokes deep gratitude and melancholy.

poetry_tang_7709820a.title: Zither Song: Autumn Thoughts
poetry_tang_7709820a.summary: In his lonely twilight years, the poet reflects on past regrets amidst autumn scenery. Playing the zither to soothe his sorrow, he conveys a sense of bleak, quiet resignation.

poetry_tang_4bb6a540.title: Princess's Mountain Pool
poetry_tang_4bb6a540.summary: The poem depicts the desolate remains of a princess's residence, where past glory has vanished. This sense of transience highlights the ethereal yet haunting emptiness of the scene.

poetry_tang_bc716bc3.title: Farewell to Magistrate Cui
poetry_tang_bc716bc3.summary: The poet bids farewell to Magistrate Cui as he travels through misty, rain-swept landscapes. The parting sorrow blends with the scenery, revealing deep concern for his friend's journey.

poetry_tang_12b2ab9a.title: Farewell to Cao San
poetry_tang_12b2ab9a.summary: Bidding farewell at an autumn mountain temple, the poet longs for future reunions and music. His parting words express a yearning for a life of reclusive freedom.

poetry_tang_829caa96.title: Farewell to Secretary Cui
poetry_tang_829caa96.summary: As a friend leaves for a post in Zizhou, the poet describes the treacherous mountain paths. The farewell is tinged with concern for the journey and enduring camaraderie.

poetry_tang_277f4368.title: Farewell to Envoy Ban
poetry_tang_277f4368.summary: Bidding farewell to Envoy Ban as he travels to Kuizhou, the poet captures the grand river scenery. His praise for the envoy reflects both parting sorrow and high expectations.

poetry_tang_8c1704d1.title: Farewell to Magistrate Wang
poetry_tang_8c1704d1.summary: The poet bids farewell to an aging friend, reflecting on the choice between official duty and seclusion. His advice against premature retirement reveals deep concern and worldly wisdom.

poetry_tang_f72a1664.title: Farewell to Monk Taiyi
poetry_tang_f72a1664.summary: The poet bids farewell to a monk heading to Luoyang amidst early spring snow. The departure leaves a lingering sense of quiet, spiritual solitude.

poetry_tang_06c8c478.title: Autumn Begins
poetry_tang_06c8c478.summary: As autumn begins, the poet observes the subtle shift in nature through cicadas and cooling breezes. The scene evokes a reflective mood on the changing seasons.

poetry_tang_f6eddb9d.title: Roses to Secretary Xu
poetry_tang_f6eddb9d.summary: The poet admires the vibrant beauty and fragrance of blooming roses. This appreciation turns into a heartfelt expression of longing for a distant friend.

poetry_tang_fe17244a.title: Winter Night
poetry_tang_fe17244a.summary: On a cold winter night, a friend's visit stirs memories of the deceased. The snowy landscape mirrors the poet's blend of solitude and gratitude.

poetry_tang_8146aabb.title: Early Spring by Ci'en Pond
poetry_tang_8146aabb.summary: Visiting the pond in early spring, the poet feels a touch of melancholy amidst budding nature. Walking with a monk at dusk brings a serene, meditative peace.

poetry_tang_d7fa82eb.title: Rainy Night Offering
poetry_tang_d7fa82eb.summary: Amidst a stormy, rainy night, the poet observes the lightning and thunder from within. The scene captures a sense of atmospheric isolation and quiet contemplation.

poetry_tang_b43f03aa.title: Moonlight at Dragon Pool Temple
poetry_tang_b43f03aa.summary: Gazing at the moon from the temple, the poet feels a shared connection with distant friends. The bright moonlight serves as a bridge for their mutual longing.

poetry_tang_115d182b.title: Autumn Night, Missing Miao Fa
poetry_tang_115d182b.summary: On an autumn night, the poet recalls past days spent with a monk while watching the frost. The vast, flowing water reflects his deep yearning for his friend.

poetry_tang_e261cd74.title: To Brother Zheng Sixteen
poetry_tang_e261cd74.summary: The poet gazes at the autumn moon while ill, finding the scenery beautiful but lonely. He laments the absence of his brother, leaving a sense of melancholy.

poetry_tang_4c53190a.title: Reply to Magistrate Wei's Loquats
poetry_tang_4c53190a.summary: The poet receives loquat leaves, praising their fresh, dew-like appearance. He values them for their medicinal use, finding them a superior gift compared to mere poetry.

poetry_tang_65a89fc6.title: Passing Qingbao Temple
poetry_tang_65a89fc6.summary: The ancient temple is deserted, inhabited only by nature. Witnessing this decay, the poet reflects on the inevitable decline of even sacred places.

poetry_tang_fa4bff48.title: Reply to Hermit Gao
poetry_tang_fa4bff48.summary: Officials and a hermit gather in the office, engaged in deep conversation. The poet urges the guest to serve the people rather than retreat to the mountains.

poetry_tang_d5b877bc.title: Farewell to Governor Yan
poetry_tang_d5b877bc.summary: The poet bids farewell to a friend leaving his post. They share wine on a spring night, their parting emotions drifting away with the river.

poetry_tang_3b25bd46.title: Farewell to Liu Zhen
poetry_tang_3b25bd46.summary: As a friend returns to Shu, the poet describes the spring scenery along the way. He feels the weight of parting, watching his friend depart with lingering regret.

poetry_tang_9b62e525.title: Farewell to Magistrate Miao
poetry_tang_9b62e525.summary: The poet describes the serene landscape of a friend's new post, admiring his quiet lifestyle. He uses this to express his own desire for tranquility.

poetry_tang_ce97a59f.title: To Officials Zheng and Qian
poetry_tang_ce97a59f.summary: As spring arrives, the poet laments his aging reflection. Facing the transience of life, he lingers at the crossroads, lost in deep contemplation.

poetry_tang_601e7392.title: Reply to Zheng Fourteen
poetry_tang_601e7392.summary: The exiled poet cannot sleep, missing friends. It leaves a lonely sorrow.

poetry_tang_1c011793.title: Late Spring View, to Qian Qi
poetry_tang_1c011793.summary: Old and ill, the poet laments aging amidst spring. It leaves twilight grief.

poetry_tang_e1fb3dcb.title: Farewell to Wang's Son
poetry_tang_e1fb3dcb.summary: A youth passes exams and returns home, parting at dusk. It leaves pride and sorrow.

poetry_tang_4c96014e.title: Stone Bamboo Flowers at Yunyang
poetry_tang_4c96014e.summary: Temple pinks bloom through seasons unnoticed. It leaves enduring quiet beauty.

poetry_tang_f748b487.title: Farewell to Gao Sheng
poetry_tang_f748b487.summary: A friend journeys by spring rivers to visit patrons. It leaves eager anticipation.

poetry_tang_eac9239f.title: Garden Notes, to Chang Dang
poetry_tang_eac9239f.summary: Waking in a quiet garden, the poet checks his graying hair. It leaves aging sorrow.

poetry_tang_6a148f21.title: Visiting Official Qian
poetry_tang_6a148f21.summary: Visiting an impoverished retired official living simply. It leaves serene detachment.

poetry_tang_32c8209e.title: To Censor Yu
poetry_tang_32c8209e.summary: Recalling youth amidst aging and melancholy music. It leaves a deep sigh over time.

poetry_tang_e058054a.title: To Li Duan
poetry_tang_e058054a.summary: The poet recalls past travels with Li Duan, lamenting the wasted years since their separation. It evokes a sense of longing for reunion and sorrow over fleeting time.

poetry_tang_7942c2e5.title: Farewell to the Exile
poetry_tang_7942c2e5.summary: Describing the exile's desolate journey, the poet expresses deep pity for his friend's plight. Parting with tears, the poem conveys profound sympathy and lingering sorrow.

poetry_tang_6624514e.title: Seeing Wang Wei's Writings
poetry_tang_6624514e.summary: Finding Wang Wei's writings, the poet laments the passing of old friends. Brushing dust off the pages, he expresses nostalgia for the past and a deep sense of solitude.

poetry_tang_d6245489.title: Farewell to Governor Lang
poetry_tang_d6245489.summary: Seeing Governor Lang off to his post, the poet captures the scenic beauty of the journey. Amidst the landscape, he weaves a sense of parting care for his friend.

poetry_tang_e124845e.title: Watching the Hunt
poetry_tang_e124845e.summary: The poem depicts the agile and imposing figures of nobles during a hunt. Behind the lively scene, it subtly reflects on the extravagance of the elite.

poetry_tang_d7a01c29.title: Lodging with Monk Chang
poetry_tang_d7a01c29.summary: Lodging at a temple, the poet finds brief peace amidst the evening bells. The tranquil night soothes his wandering heart, inspiring a desire for spiritual retreat.

poetry_tang_446969dd.title: Farewell to Qiao Guang
poetry_tang_446969dd.summary: Seeing off a failed candidate, the poet describes the desolate path home. His words offer comfort for the friend's disappointment while lamenting his unfulfilled potential.

poetry_tang_6461ee61.title: Kite
poetry_tang_6461ee61.summary: As a kite drifts in the wind, the poet sits listening to the sounds of nature. The ethereal atmosphere leads to solitude, reflecting a detached, meditative state.

poetry_tang_5436da72.title: Leisure, to Miao Fa
poetry_tang_5436da72.summary: The poet lives in quiet solitude, lamenting his aging. He yearns to escape worldly affairs and pursue a reclusive life like Xie An.

poetry_tang_7f722741.title: Farewell to Mr. Wang
poetry_tang_7f722741.summary: The poet praises Mr. Wang's reclusive life in the Southern Mountains. He expresses a deep desire to follow him and live in anonymity.

poetry_tang_79577aed.title: To Master Xiu
poetry_tang_79577aed.summary: The poet depicts the transcendent life of a monk at Tiantai Mountain. He longs to visit the master to seek wisdom and resolve his doubts.

poetry_tang_9abee3f4.title: Farewell to Xiahou Shen
poetry_tang_9abee3f4.summary: The poet bids farewell to Xiahou Shen, describing the misty landscapes along the journey. He feels deep respect for his friend's literary talent.

poetry_tang_c60e995a.title: Farewell to Governor Lu
poetry_tang_c60e995a.summary: The poet sees off Governor Lu to Kuizhou, gazing at the autumn scenery of Ba. He hopes his friend will govern well and benefit the people.

poetry_tang_48d678eb.title: Night Geese Returning
poetry_tang_48d678eb.summary: The sound of returning geese at night stirs the poet's deep homesickness. He uses the geese to convey his longing for his friend, Su.

poetry_tang_7fe08b5e.title: Poem on Sails Approaching Port
poetry_tang_7fe08b5e.summary: Sails return to port under the sunset, creating a serene and vast scene. This sight evokes the poet's wandering spirit and melancholy.

poetry_tang_8b6842a0.title: Autumn Thoughts for Yin Zhi
poetry_tang_8b6842a0.summary: The withered autumn scenery triggers the poet's sorrow over aging. He sits playing the lute, filled with an irrepressible sense of grief.

poetry_tang_bb257504.title: Listening to Zither
poetry_tang_bb257504.summary: The poet listens to zither music, lamenting that ancient melodies find few listeners today. The piece evokes a sense of refined isolation and quiet melancholy.

poetry_tang_8d511dd8.title: Farewell to an Ascetic Monk
poetry_tang_8d511dd8.summary: The poet advises a monk to hide in the mountains, avoiding worldly fame. It conveys a deep longing for spiritual detachment and seclusion.

poetry_tang_f10f6ec8.title: Farewell to Monk Lingche
poetry_tang_f10f6ec8.summary: Amidst evening bells, a monk walks alone into the distance. The scene is serene and evocative, leaving a lingering sense of peaceful solitude.

poetry_tang_31c2e82c.title: New Year's Day
poetry_tang_31c2e82c.summary: On New Year's Day, the poet laments his failed career and aging in exile. The poem is heavy with the sorrow of a lonely wanderer.

poetry_tang_bc49ea0d.title: Autumn View from Wugong Terrace
poetry_tang_bc49ea0d.summary: Autumn at an ancient terrace prompts reflections on the rise and fall of dynasties. The historical decay leaves a profound sense of melancholy.

poetry_tang_384120bb.title: Visiting Nankou Hermitage
poetry_tang_384120bb.summary: Seeking a hermit, the poet finds peace in the natural landscape and Zen stillness. The experience culminates in a state of wordless tranquility.

poetry_tang_c3d038d7.title: Farewell to Wang XI
poetry_tang_c3d038d7.summary: Watching a friend depart, the poet feels the vastness of the river mirroring his grief. The fading sail leaves behind only deep longing.

poetry_tang_d287dbed.title: Farewell to Xue & Liu
poetry_tang_d287dbed.summary: Reuniting only to part again, the poet laments his aging and the unpredictability of life. The farewell is filled with gratitude for his friends.

poetry_tang_a7a8bffa.title: Passing Jia Yi's Home
poetry_tang_a7a8bffa.summary: The poet visits Jia Yi's former home, reflecting on his tragic exile. The desolate autumn scene evokes a deep resonance between the poet and the ancient scholar's plight.

poetry_tang_ba676206.title: Evening View of Yueyang
poetry_tang_ba676206.summary: Gazing at the distant autumn waters of Dongting, the poet sends thoughts to a friend. He invokes Jia Yi's exile to express his own loneliness and political anxiety.

poetry_tang_652854d3.title: Composed On A Given Theme
poetry_tang_652854d3.summary: Amidst spring birdsong, a woman longs for her husband fighting on the frontier. She entrusts her yearning to the moon, hoping for an end to war and a reunion.

poetry_tang_65400762.title: Ballad: Wang Zhaojun
poetry_tang_65400762.summary: Wang Zhaojun is sent to the Xiongnu due to a painter's deceit. Her pipa music carries the eternal sorrow of a beautiful life wasted in distant exile.

poetry_tang_c4b21ede.title: Ballad: Bronze Sparrow Terrace
poetry_tang_c4b21ede.summary: The once-vibrant Bronze Sparrow Terrace is now overgrown and desolate. The poet laments the transience of glory, noting that only spring grass remains.

poetry_tang_6fffc85e.title: Ballad: Marching Song 1
poetry_tang_6fffc85e.summary: Han troops are surrounded on the battlefield in a desperate situation. The poet depicts the brutal reality of war and the helplessness of the trapped soldiers.

poetry_tang_7f3a06e0.title: Ballad: Marching Song 2
poetry_tang_7f3a06e0.summary: The general loses his way and fails, yet seeks undeserved glory. The poet expresses indignation at such incompetence through a critique of false military honors.

poetry_tang_7320f993.title: Ballad: Marching Song 3
poetry_tang_7320f993.summary: Amidst the withered grass of the frontier, Han soldiers weep at the sound of enemy horses. The poet uses their sorrow to condemn the rulers' indifference.

poetry_tang_d0af22fe.title: Ballad: Marching Song 4
poetry_tang_d0af22fe.summary: It depicts frontier spring and lonely warfare. Shifting to aging in battle while others enjoy peace, it leaves a desolate sorrow.

poetry_tang_6c1e6bd7.title: Ballad: Marching Song 5
poetry_tang_6c1e6bd7.summary: Dusk at the watchtower stirs homesickness and flute sorrow. Turning to the empty flowing river, it leaves lingering melancholy.

poetry_tang_4b549571.title: Ballad: Marching Song 6
poetry_tang_4b549571.summary: Vast sands highlight an aging soldier's plight. Turning to a broken sword yet surviving home, it leaves a cold, solemn echo.

poetry_tang_7bb001fb.title: Ballad: Changmen Lament
poetry_tang_7bb001fb.summary: Deep palace seclusion highlights a concubine's loneliness. Shifting to fading flowers driven by lost favor, it leaves a tragic sigh.

poetry_tang_08bc0869.title: Zither Song: Xiang Consort
poetry_tang_08bc0869.summary: Autumn winds over the Xiang river evoke thoughts of ancient goddesses. Turning to the lonely moon for millennia, it leaves eternal sorrow.

poetry_tang_9964b5bc.title: Misc Song: Mount Taihang Heat
poetry_tang_9964b5bc.summary: Mount Taihang's scorching heat torments the marching troops. Shifting to national concern and victory hopes, it leaves a resolute spirit.

poetry_tang_2b5c167d.title: Misc Song: Young Warrior's Journey
poetry_tang_2b5c167d.summary: Young warriors enjoy lavish hunting and revelry. Shifting to fragrant spring evenings, it leaves a spirited, joyful vibe.

poetry_tang_c1f383f7.title: Snowy Night at Furong Mountain
poetry_tang_c1f383f7.summary: Dusk and snowy huts paint a cold scene. Turning to a barking dog and a returning traveler, it leaves midnight warmth.

poetry_tang_79fb5b85.title: Farewell to Zhang & Cui
poetry_tang_79fb5b85.summary: The poet bids farewell to friends heading to a distant land, lamenting their shared poverty and lack of recognition. The departure evokes a deep sense of sympathy for their uncertain future.

poetry_tang_d0e03881.title: To Hermit Qin Xi
poetry_tang_d0e03881.summary: The poet admires the hermit Qin Xi’s contentment with poverty, yet feels melancholy seeing him age in isolation. It conveys a complex mix of admiration and sorrow for his secluded life.

poetry_tang_6e113002.title: To Qin Xi, an Exile
poetry_tang_6e113002.summary: Reflecting on Qin Xi’s wandering life and past favors, the poet looks toward the southern mountains. The poem is filled with empathy for the friend's displaced existence.

poetry_tang_f715a10e.title: Night Snow for Qin Xi
poetry_tang_f715a10e.summary: Under the moonlit snow, the poet contemplates Qin Xi’s recent divorce and loneliness. The falling snow stirs deep sorrow, leaving the poet’s heart in a state of restless melancholy.

poetry_tang_c8c46abd.title: Speckled Bamboo
poetry_tang_c8c46abd.summary: Speckled bamboo stands by the Xiang River, embodying the ancient grief of the Xiang goddesses. The tear-like stains on the branches evoke a sense of eternal, lingering sorrow.

poetry_tang_ba9dec99.title: Reflecting at Palace
poetry_tang_ba9dec99.summary: Spring grass grows in the old palace, bearing the faint color of ancient silk skirts. The sight of the ruins highlights the absence of the monarch and the desolation of time.

poetry_tang_e4ad601f.title: Morning Mirror Reflection
poetry_tang_e4ad601f.summary: At the start of a new year, the poet looks in the mirror to find his face withered and hair turned white. The reflection leaves him with a profound sense of helplessness toward aging.

poetry_tang_8f0a7846.title: Sending Li Duan
poetry_tang_8f0a7846.summary: As the poet watches his friend depart and heads home alone, the twilight mountains deepen his melancholy. The separation across the river leaves a lingering sense of solitude.

poetry_tang_bac30f8e.title: Farewell to Zhang XVIII
poetry_tang_bac30f8e.summary: The poet watches a friend depart by boat under the moonlight. The cold tide and night air create a deep sense of longing.

poetry_tang_9cd7fb81.title: Visiting White Crane Temple
poetry_tang_9cd7fb81.summary: The poet fails to find a hermit, imagining him in a fairyland. The emptiness of the room shifts into a yearning for transcendence.

poetry_tang_b36e4ce2.title: Visiting South Garden
poetry_tang_b36e4ce2.summary: Sunflowers in the shade still yearn for the sun. The poet uses this to express his own steadfast integrity despite adversity.

poetry_tang_c0e53cb0.title: Late Blooming Peach Blossom
poetry_tang_c0e53cb0.summary: Peach blossoms bloom late in a deep ravine due to the terrain. The poet admires their unique vitality despite being overlooked.

poetry_tang_0756465a.title: Farewell to Sons-in-Law 1
poetry_tang_0756465a.summary: Plum blossoms bloom at the ferry as friends depart for Yangzhou. The vibrant spring scenery contrasts with the melancholy of parting.

poetry_tang_276e4622.title: Farewell to Sons-in-Law 2
poetry_tang_276e4622.summary: Amidst spring birds and falling flowers, friends depart for the new year. The petals drifting on water symbolize fleeting time and sorrow.

poetry_tang_55193b7c.title: Farewell to Sons-in-Law 3
poetry_tang_55193b7c.summary: As geese fly away, the poet stands alone by the receding tide. Closing the door at sunset leaves a lingering sense of solitude.

poetry_tang_98926da6.title: Farewell to Relatives, Four Poems
poetry_tang_98926da6.summary: The poet asks his guest not to speak of the fairyland. He expresses a desire to retreat from the world and live simply.

poetry_tang_a0e655f9.title: To Daoist Xu Faleng
poetry_tang_a0e655f9.summary: White clouds drift over green mountains as a Daoist burns incense alone. The serene scene leaves a tranquil, solitary feeling.

poetry_tang_933b70b6.title: Reply at Zhuyu Bay
poetry_tang_933b70b6.summary: A desolate posthouse stands far from civilization amid ancient trees of Sui gardens. The bleak view stirs a sense of historical vicissitudes.

poetry_tang_64147e9f.title: Blocked on Way to Chuzhou
poetry_tang_64147e9f.summary: Shallow waters delay the journey toward Chuzhou as twilight falls over the cold pond. The delay leaves a lingering sense of travel-worn anxiety.

poetry_tang_5bedf467.title: Moon over the River
poetry_tang_5bedf467.summary: Autumn river mists clear as the moon rises, illuminating a lone boat crossing the water. The solitary night leaves a quiet, distant feeling.

poetry_tang_c17c4dcf.title: Visit at Green Stream Villa
poetry_tang_c17c4dcf.summary: Fallen leaves blanket a desolate village road until a friend arrives in the cold mountains. The rare visit warms the heart with shared empathy.

poetry_tang_d58a091e.title: First Visit to Green Stream
poetry_tang_d58a091e.summary: Basking in the early winter sun, the poet drifts with white clouds and falling leaves. The quiet retreat leaves a peaceful, aging reflection.

poetry_tang_f34bd060.title: Farewell to Monk Shaowei
poetry_tang_f34bd060.summary: A monk journeys alone to Tiantai Mountain amidst pine gates and echoing chants. The ethereal voyage leaves a pure, transcendent resonance.

poetry_tang_c32b5c6b.title: Returning to Muzhou
poetry_tang_c32b5c6b.summary: An exile revisits Qili Shoal at dusk amid chilling waters and fading light. Annual plum blossoms leave a sorrowful sense of recurring displacement.

poetry_tang_f71796f5.title: Drinking with Yan Wei
poetry_tang_f71796f5.summary: The poet drinks in a humble lane, letting clouds drift by. Invoking the hermit Zi Ling, he expresses a serene desire for a reclusive life.

poetry_tang_ae61b09c.title: On Zhu Fang's Return
poetry_tang_ae61b09c.summary: A lonely monument by the river marks the passage of time. The poet laments the transience of life and the fading of legacies, feeling profound grief.

poetry_tang_23b2ab39.title: Great Dyke Ballad
poetry_tang_23b2ab39.summary: The great dyke is filled with spring revelers. The poem shifts to a sense of loss, leaving a melancholy feeling that beauty and youth are fleeting.

poetry_tang_bc4204de.title: Hunting with Minister Zhang
poetry_tang_bc4204de.summary: The poet joins a hunt but finds no joy in the sport. The vibrant scene contrasts with his inner detachment, highlighting his loneliness and homesickness.

poetry_tang_b59da5a3.title: Climbing Solitary Isle
poetry_tang_b59da5a3.summary: The tranquil isle evokes memories of a departed friend. Looking toward home, the poet feels a mix of longing and loss, leaving a lingering sadness.

poetry_tang_70a73872.title: Sick in Late Spring
poetry_tang_70a73872.summary: Confined by illness in late spring, the poet contrasts nature's vitality with his own isolation. He laments the lack of understanding, feeling deeply discouraged.

poetry_tang_e5a075fd.title: Entering Gorge to Brother
poetry_tang_e5a075fd.summary: The treacherous gorges and mournful apes heighten the poet's homesickness. He writes to his brother, expressing deep longing amidst the hardships of travel.

poetry_tang_dfadbec8.title: Boating on Lake to Yan Jiu
poetry_tang_dfadbec8.summary: Drifting on a boat, the poet gazes toward home in vain. He uses historical allusions to express his travel-weary sorrow and longing for his friend.

poetry_tang_1e829c29.title: Great Dyke Ballad to Wan Qi
poetry_tang_1e829c29.summary: The poem depicts the lively spring scene of crowds on the Great Dyke. It turns to lament the passage of time, leaving a sense of melancholy over lost companionship.

poetry_tang_9510648b.title: Returning Home in Midsummer
poetry_tang_9510648b.summary: The poet returns to the countryside but struggles between public duty and filial piety. It concludes with a longing for the hermit life of Tao Yuanming.

poetry_tang_c6f26e24.title: Inscribed at Yunmen Mountain
poetry_tang_c6f26e24.summary: The poet travels through Yunmen Mountain, enjoying its beautiful scenery. He then turns to miss his friends at court, revealing a sense of professional isolation.

poetry_tang_24eff503.title: Overnight at Yangzi Ferry
poetry_tang_24eff503.summary: Staying at Yangzi Ferry, the poet gazes toward Jianye across the river. Longing fills the misty waves, leaving a lingering sense of solitude and sorrow.

poetry_tang_248fc709.title: Writing to Capital Friends
poetry_tang_248fc709.summary: The poet reflects on his scholarly heritage and his frustration with unfulfilled potential. He turns to express a desire for recognition, revealing the pain of unrealized ambitions.

poetry_tang_1b38fc69.title: Returning to Mountains
poetry_tang_1b38fc69.summary: The poet retires to the mountains in his later years, finding companionship with a monk. Amidst the serene Zen environment, he finds peace and detachment from the world.

poetry_tang_add1ce34.title: Autumn Night Thoughts
poetry_tang_add1ce34.summary: The autumn night is cold under the moonlight, with desolate scenes in the courtyard. Standing and gazing at the moon, the poet is left with deep longing and loneliness.

poetry_tang_e17ff0b0.title: Farewell to Li Zhubu
poetry_tang_e17ff0b0.summary: The poet bids farewell to his friend and begins a wandering journey to Tiantai. Amidst the drifting waves, he expresses attachment to his home and uncertainty about the path ahead.

poetry_tang_cd627100.title: Farewell to Ding Daifeng
poetry_tang_cd627100.summary: The poet praises Ding's talent but laments his failed exams. He urges his friend to seek help from influential acquaintances.

poetry_tang_105af1de.title: Farewell to Wu Yue
poetry_tang_105af1de.summary: Comparing Wu to a phoenix, the poet worries he will lack appreciation in the south. The poem reflects deep concern for his friend's future.

poetry_tang_e37dcf1c.title: Farewell to Zhang and Shentu
poetry_tang_e37dcf1c.summary: The poet meets friends by chance while traveling, but they must soon part. He uses drifting clouds to symbolize their enduring bond.

poetry_tang_8450be06.title: Farewell to Chen Qi
poetry_tang_8450be06.summary: Chen leaves his books to join the army, inspiring the poet. As they head in different directions, the poet anticipates a triumphant reunion.

poetry_tang_e97faf4f.title: Farewell to Cousin Yong
poetry_tang_e97faf4f.summary: The poet watches his cousin sail away after failing the exams. The sudden separation of kin leaves him feeling deeply unsettled and sad.

poetry_tang_da023d48.title: Missed Farewell to Xin Da
poetry_tang_da023d48.summary: Missing the chance to bid farewell, the poet wanders alone by the river. The vast landscape mirrors his lingering regret and loneliness.

poetry_tang_08a23d48.title: Parting with Exile
poetry_tang_08a23d48.summary: Two dejected souls part ways at Yellow Crane Tower to face exile. The uncertainty of their future creates a heavy, sorrowful atmosphere.

poetry_tang_9b744d0f.title: Feast at Bao Er's Home
poetry_tang_9b744d0f.summary: The poet enjoys a peaceful summer feast at a friend's home. The joyful gathering ends with a contented return in the twilight.

poetry_tang_665d9bcd.title: Feast with Wang Changling
poetry_tang_665d9bcd.summary: The poet feasts with friends in a Taoist's room, feeling as if in a fairyland. This scene captures a transcendent joy that leaves the reader longing for such peace.

poetry_tang_384a3c7c.title: Drinking at Xiangyang Duke's
poetry_tang_384a3c7c.summary: The poet enjoys a banquet at a duke's residence amidst spring scenery. It reflects an open-minded attitude of disregarding worldly status to cherish the present joy.

poetry_tang_6085ecbf.title: Visiting Monk Zhan
poetry_tang_6085ecbf.summary: The poet visits a remote temple and talks with a monk all night. It expresses a deep yearning for a reclusive life, leaving the reader with a sense of serenity.

poetry_tang_9cd833af.title: Visiting Monk Fu's Hermitage
poetry_tang_9cd833af.summary: The poet and a friend visit a secluded hermitage to contemplate Buddhist truth. The poem shifts toward renouncing worldly attachments, offering a sense of spiritual liberation.

poetry_tang_e87c4553.title: Overnight at Tongbai Abbey
poetry_tang_e87c4553.summary: Traveling to Mount Tiantai, the poet seeks the way of immortality at Tongbai Abbey. It reveals a weariness with worldly troubles and a pursuit of spiritual longevity.

poetry_tang_1df2e052.title: At Xiantan Pool
poetry_tang_1df2e052.summary: The poet fishes at Xiantan Pool and enjoys a fresh catch. It turns from the act of fishing to dismissing worldly delicacies, highlighting a carefree, contented mood.

poetry_tang_38427e44.title: At Cuiwei Temple
poetry_tang_38427e44.summary: The poet visits Cuiwei Temple to discuss philosophy with a monk. Praising the mountain's tranquility, the poem leaves the reader with a feeling of detached, quiet reflection.

poetry_tang_15ce7d92.title: Early Spring Boating, Hanzhong
poetry_tang_15ce7d92.summary: In early spring, the poet boats and feasts in Hanzhong. It captures the fleeting nature of such beautiful moments, leaving a lingering sense of joyful, ephemeral beauty.

poetry_tang_04bf42c4.title: Boating on Yexi Stream
poetry_tang_04bf42c4.summary: The poet boats on Yexi stream, encountering an old fisherman and a maiden. Their silent exchange leaves a lingering sense of serene melancholy.

poetry_tang_75df20a4.title: Looking at Lushan from Lake Pengli
poetry_tang_75df20a4.summary: Gazing at the majestic Lushan from a lake, the poet admires its beauty. This inspires a longing for seclusion, contrasted by the burden of his official duties.

poetry_tang_2e3148a1.title: Ascending Lu Men Mountain
poetry_tang_2e3148a1.summary: The poet ascends Lu Men Mountain to seek remnants of a hermit, captivated by the scenery. He departs at sunset, leaving a deep yearning for a reclusive life.

poetry_tang_adfffbc2.title: Visiting Master Ming's Hermitage
poetry_tang_adfffbc2.summary: The poet visits a Zen master in the mountains, observing his meditative life. After discussing the dharma, he departs, feeling a sense of otherworldly peace.

poetry_tang_6cc2875a.title: Reply to General Zhang's Border Song I
poetry_tang_6cc2875a.summary: The general issues a command, and thousands of troops respond in unison. The poem captures the strict discipline and high morale of the border army.

poetry_tang_3bd6b75d.title: Reply to General Zhang's Border Song II
poetry_tang_3bd6b75d.summary: Mistaking rustling grass for an enemy at night, the general shoots an arrow deep into a rock. It highlights his sharp vigilance and immense strength.

poetry_tang_1ce3451d.title: Reply to General Zhang's Border Song III
poetry_tang_1ce3451d.summary: As the enemy flees under cover of darkness, the general prepares to pursue them. Amidst heavy snow, the soldiers' fearless spirit is vividly portrayed.

poetry_tang_9e95e8c2.title: Reply to General Zhang's Border Song IV
poetry_tang_9e95e8c2.summary: At a victory banquet, soldiers dance in their armor. The thunderous sound of drums echoing through the mountains conveys a scene of triumphant celebration.

poetry_tang_3f3dda55.title: Evening at Ezhou
poetry_tang_3f3dda55.summary: The poet drifts on the river, witnessing post-war desolation and the impossibility of returning home. The bleak autumn scenery and distant war drums leave a profound sense of national and personal sorrow.

poetry_tang_a7d0aa77.title: To Duke Li
poetry_tang_a7d0aa77.summary: The poet parts with a friend amidst cold clouds and twilight snow, lamenting his wandering life. Their tearful farewell reveals the hopelessness and helplessness of reuniting in troubled times.

poetry_tang_282a5fe5.title: Army Song
poetry_tang_282a5fe5.summary: The poem depicts the brutality of the frontier battlefield and the soldiers' exhaustion. The ending uses the Li Ling allusion to express melancholy over the cruelty of war and imperial indifference.

poetry_tang_0813b2c3.title: Long Gate Lament Song
poetry_tang_0813b2c3.summary: In the cold, empty palace, the moon shines on discarded dance costumes. Through this desolate scene, the poet conveys the loneliness and sorrow of a woman abandoned by the emperor.

poetry_tang_911987bc.title: My Unfortunate Fate Song
poetry_tang_911987bc.summary: A woman recounts her tragic life after twice marrying reckless men. The lines bluntly expose the injustice of her fate, leaving a bitter lament for her shattered dignity.

poetry_tang_98b3c92c.title: Eternal Heaven and Earth Song I
poetry_tang_98b3c92c.summary: Spring breezes brush against the palace flowers, seemingly carrying the emperor's favor. The poem is light, depicting a peaceful scene where spring sunlight favors the blossoms before the hall.

poetry_tang_072bcb09.title: Eternal Heaven and Earth Song II
poetry_tang_072bcb09.summary: The rainbow bridge spans the water, creating a serene and opulent atmosphere for the emperor's summer retreat. The poem captures the quiet elegance of royal gardens and courtly leisure.

poetry_tang_3abbe080.title: Eternal Heaven and Earth Song III
poetry_tang_3abbe080.summary: A court lady expresses her devotion to the emperor while worrying about her fading youth. The poem implies the helplessness of vying for favor, leaving a lingering sense of sorrow.

poetry_tang_d2cffe54.title: Eternal Heaven and Earth Song IV
poetry_tang_d2cffe54.summary: The northern tribes bring tribute in a peaceful era, rendering harsh border governance unnecessary. It conveys relief at the prevailing tranquility.

poetry_tang_43660586.title: Eternal Heaven and Earth Song V
poetry_tang_43660586.summary: In the cool palace, the emperor bestows gifts and leisure. Palace ladies compete in archery, creating a scene of refined and joyful court life.

poetry_tang_20a024c0.title: Emperor's Gratitude Song I
poetry_tang_20a024c0.summary: The poem celebrates the emperor's majestic power and the auspicious harmony of nature. It is filled with reverence for the stable imperial reign.

poetry_tang_4e12ce19.title: Emperor's Gratitude Song II
poetry_tang_4e12ce19.summary: This depicts the magnificent and solemn imperial procession amidst auspicious clouds. It conveys a sense of sacred royal grandeur.

poetry_tang_952da3cf.title: Emperor's Gratitude Song III
poetry_tang_952da3cf.summary: The poem praises the emperor for ending wars and achieving great governance. The subsequent festivities highlight the nation's strength and prosperity.

poetry_tang_5143af51.title: Emperor's Gratitude Song IV
poetry_tang_5143af51.summary: Celestial music descends as the emperor watches court dances. The scene creates an ethereal and serene atmosphere of royal grace.

poetry_tang_12461e6e.title: Farewell to Reverend Wei Liang
poetry_tang_12461e6e.summary: A monk returns home, reading scriptures on a quiet boat. Facing fog and illness, the poem reflects deeply on the impermanence of life.

poetry_tang_f820fa84.title: Farewell to Commander Han
poetry_tang_f820fa84.summary: A veteran commander, his troops gone, crosses the pass in old age. The image evokes the poignant loneliness of a fading hero.

poetry_tang_6fdb7305.title: Farewell to Jizhongfu
poetry_tang_6fdb7305.summary: The poet bids farewell to a friend returning to seclusion, depicting serene landscapes and parting sorrow. The ending reflects on the chaos of the times, leaving a sense of longing for retreat mixed with melancholy.

poetry_tang_4b77685e.title: Farewell to Cousin Pei Jun
poetry_tang_4b77685e.summary: Recalling a deep bond with a cousin, the poem laments the passage of time and family changes. As they part, the poet offers heartfelt wishes for his cousin's official career.

poetry_tang_947ba2b5.title: Farewell to Cui, Dengzhou Official
poetry_tang_947ba2b5.summary: The poet praises the magnificent scenery of the official's new post, capturing the quietude of the border city. It conveys warm wishes for the friend's success and a lingering sense of companionship.

poetry_tang_a3c478b1.title: Farewell to Pei, Salt Official
poetry_tang_a3c478b1.summary: Bidding farewell to an official heading to Shu, the poet describes the region's prosperity and natural beauty. He encourages his friend to remain indifferent to worldly changes, evoking a sense of detachment.

poetry_tang_7429d8aa.title: Farewell to Wei Guang
poetry_tang_7429d8aa.summary: Following Wei Guang's failure in exams, the poet depicts a vast, spring-filled landscape. He offers comfort, suggesting that future opportunities will surely arise, encouraging the friend to remain hopeful.

poetry_tang_7f8303e8.title: Farewell to Pan Shu
poetry_tang_7f8303e8.summary: As Pan Shu returns home after failing his exams, the poem is filled with sorrow and intoxication. Through descriptions of the journey, the poet expresses deep empathy for his friend's disappointment.

poetry_tang_13dc3234.title: Farewell to Cousin Guang
poetry_tang_13dc3234.summary: Sending a relative to Shu, the poet describes the treacherous journey and unique local scenery. Using a classical allusion, he conveys a poignant sense of reluctance at their parting.

poetry_tang_56b97f22.title: Farewell to Song, Collator
poetry_tang_56b97f22.summary: Bidding farewell to a friend heading to a military post in Xuanzhou, the poet captures the serene river scenery and the official atmosphere. It blends praise for the friend's prospects with a deep sense of parting.

poetry_tang_80ef2a1b.title: Farewell to Li Zong
poetry_tang_80ef2a1b.summary: The poet bids farewell to Li Zong as he departs for Changzhou. Reflecting on their brief meeting, he offers warm wishes for Li's future success.

poetry_tang_dc06ad71.title: Farewell to Yuan Zanfu
poetry_tang_dc06ad71.summary: The poet praises Yuan Zanfu's appointment to Longmen, capturing the scenic journey. He admires Yuan's noble character and independent spirit.

poetry_tang_91a34522.title: Farewell to Li Sui
poetry_tang_91a34522.summary: The poet sees off the talented Li Sui to Yangdi amidst a vibrant spring setting. He uses elegant metaphors to express his hopes for Li's success.

poetry_tang_df327c08.title: Farewell to Zhao, Danyang Official
poetry_tang_df327c08.summary: The poet bids farewell to Zhao as the rain clears over the river. He envisions his friend's future career with a mix of melancholy and hope.

poetry_tang_d69741d7.title: Farewell to Wang, Jukutan Official
poetry_tang_d69741d7.summary: The poet sees off Wang to Jukutan, describing a serene journey through mountains. He wishes him a successful term and a peaceful retirement.

poetry_tang_b1ead2a6.title: Farewell to Chen, Pingxian Official
poetry_tang_b1ead2a6.summary: The poet bids farewell to Chen, painting a picture of his journey south. He expresses hope that Chen will achieve lasting fame through good governance.

poetry_tang_cfeb65fe.title: Farewell to Shentu Zhengzi
poetry_tang_cfeb65fe.summary: The poet sees off Shentu Zhengzi to Hunan, capturing the bustling river scenes. He wishes him a safe journey and honors his filial devotion.

poetry_tang_5551d159.title: Farewell to Li Shangshu
poetry_tang_5551d159.summary: The poet bids farewell to the Li brothers, describing a grand and dignified departure. He celebrates their talent and filial piety, praising the era's peace.

poetry_tang_e05ccfe2.title: Farewell to Zhang Tiao
poetry_tang_e05ccfe2.summary: The poet bids farewell to Zhang Tiao amidst grand river landscapes. He reflects on the passage of time, leaving a sense of longing for their future reunion.

poetry_tang_ef5d2b55.title: Farewell to Ma Shangshu
poetry_tang_ef5d2b55.summary: The poet sees off Ma Langjun, capturing frontier autumn scenes. He shifts to imagining the warmth of home, evoking a deep sense of camaraderie.

poetry_tang_9e84ba23.title: Farewell to Zhang Chengji
poetry_tang_9e84ba23.summary: The poet uses weeping willows to depict a bright spring pond. He shifts to imagining flower-filled boats, offering warm wishes for his friend's journey.

poetry_tang_3aac6fbc.title: Farewell to Magistrate Wang
poetry_tang_3aac6fbc.summary: The poet bids farewell to Magistrate Wang amidst a snowy city. He praises his integrity, expressing a sincere desire to be his neighbor.

poetry_tang_c229a765.title: Farewell to Li Zhubu
poetry_tang_c229a765.summary: The poet praises Li Zhubu’s elegance and his graceful return home. He humbly reflects on his own status, feeling glad for his friend's success.

poetry_tang_a502a5df.title: Farewell to Uncle Cheng
poetry_tang_a502a5df.summary: The poet sees his uncle off to Xichuan, describing the serene beauty of the mountains. He contrasts this with his own quiet life, wishing his uncle well.

poetry_tang_c7930e2b.title: Farewell to Wan Ju
poetry_tang_c7930e2b.summary: The poet bids farewell to Wan Ju amidst a bleak late-autumn scene. He laments the sorrow of parting, leaving a sense of lonely longing.

poetry_tang_b81f4c50.title: Roadside Farewell to Zhang, Liu
poetry_tang_b81f4c50.summary: Caught in rain, the poet describes the thunder and his horse. He shifts to lamenting his own aging and inability to serve, revealing deep sorrow.

poetry_tang_5a31fb4b.title: Farewell to Governor Ban
poetry_tang_5a31fb4b.summary: Morning light illuminates the fleet against a grand landscape. The poet bids farewell to his uncle, feeling both pride in his appointment and deep longing.

poetry_tang_3ea56b7c.title: Farewell to Uncle Guang
poetry_tang_3ea56b7c.summary: The journey to Shu is perilous and long. The poet reflects on the hardships of travel and the prestige of office, expressing deep affection for his departing uncle.

poetry_tang_f2f22339.title: Untitled
poetry_tang_f2f22339.summary: The poet rejects fame, finding solace in wine. Despite the troubled times, he maintains a detached and carefree spirit amidst his drunken revelry.

poetry_tang_26d869b0.title: Inscription at Nianji Temple
poetry_tang_26d869b0.summary: The temple is quiet as flowers bloom in the rain. Reflecting on deceased friends and his own exile, the poet feels a profound, melancholic longing.

poetry_tang_e921c86b.title: Hearing Qin at River Mouth
poetry_tang_e921c86b.summary: Under the moonlight, a Taoist plays the qin on the river. The evocative melody stirs a deep sense of homesickness among the traveling merchants.

poetry_tang_0f429fec.title: Farewell to Xiahou Xiaoshu
poetry_tang_0f429fec.summary: The friend returns to a simple, rustic life in the mountains. Watching him leave, the poet feels a sense of envy for such tranquil seclusion.

poetry_tang_996e77ce.title: Seeking Hermit, Unmet
poetry_tang_996e77ce.summary: Failing to meet the hermit, the poet finds peace in the mountain's solitude. He leaves satisfied, having discovered a quiet clarity in nature.

poetry_tang_547e9617.title: Inscription at Farmer's Hut
poetry_tang_547e9617.summary: Spring arrives, and farmers are busy in the fields. The poet captures the industrious and peaceful rhythm of rural life by the lake.

poetry_tang_a807ef13.title: Boating on Ruoye Stream
poetry_tang_a807ef13.summary: The poet depicts a tranquil life by the Ruoye Stream, highlighting harmony with nature. The poem ends with a closed gate, evoking a sense of secluded peace.

poetry_tang_fc968fa7.title: Letter from the Lake
poetry_tang_fc968fa7.summary: The poet reflects on his leisurely life by the lake. The poem concludes by contrasting his detached state with official life, expressing a longing for transcendence.

poetry_tang_d91617d3.title: Ascending Runzhou City
poetry_tang_d91617d3.summary: Standing atop Runzhou city, the poet gazes at the spring tide and rain, feeling deep homesickness. The final look toward Guangling leaves a lingering sense of melancholy.

poetry_tang_67de2f2f.title: Visiting Cui Zhenjun
poetry_tang_67de2f2f.summary: Visiting a recluse in his quiet dwelling, the poet reflects on the passage of time. The contrast between the hermit's peace and his own wasted life evokes deep sorrow.

poetry_tang_5b91962f.title: Farewell to Wang Wei
poetry_tang_5b91962f.summary: The poet bids farewell to Wang Wei, struggling with his emotions on the journey home. The final image of looking back repeatedly captures his profound attachment.

poetry_tang_841c37f7.title: Remaining Snow under Bamboo
poetry_tang_841c37f7.summary: Remaining snow under bamboo glows in the moonlight, creating a cold, crystalline scene. The poet uses this imagery to reflect his solitary spirit and dedication to tranquility.

poetry_tang_bf9278de.title: Farewell to Yan Jiaoshu
poetry_tang_bf9278de.summary: Bidding farewell to a friend traveling to Yue, the poet describes the beautiful scenery along the way. The ending encourages the friend to cherish the recluse's life.

poetry_tang_f2f4c2ff.title: Summer Heat Exam
poetry_tang_f2f4c2ff.summary: The poem depicts the intense heat of summer, emphasizing the power of nature. It concludes with a traveler hesitating on his journey, reflecting the helplessness of life's struggles.

poetry_tang_40af4f66.title: Pear Blossoms at Zuo Ye
poetry_tang_40af4f66.summary: Pear blossoms look colder and whiter than snow, drifting toward the jade steps. The poet expresses a lingering sense of melancholy over the fleeting spring.

poetry_tang_b5dd67f1.title: Crossing the Han River
poetry_tang_b5dd67f1.summary: The poet drifts on the Han River, finding peace in its clarity. He ultimately expresses a desire to abandon public life for a reclusive existence.

poetry_tang_86693f91.title: Winter Solstice Letter Home
poetry_tang_86693f91.summary: Writing home on the Winter Solstice, the poet encourages his brother to study hard and succeed. The poem conveys deep care and high expectations for his kin.

poetry_tang_f13f4e07.title: Reply to Han Zhang
poetry_tang_f13f4e07.summary: The poet politely declines a political career, preferring the life of a fisherman. It reveals his integrity and desire for freedom over bowing to power.

poetry_tang_16990a98.title: Visiting Cihe Temple
poetry_tang_16990a98.summary: Climbing the temple to view the scenery, the poet finds serenity in the mountains. The sight of birds returning home stirs his longing for a reclusive life.

poetry_tang_9938b7b8.title: Hearing Orioles in Rain
poetry_tang_9938b7b8.summary: Listening to orioles in the rain evokes the poet's homesickness. He envies the birds' freedom while lamenting his own wandering, lonely life.

poetry_tang_bd4687b2.title: Clouds on Secluded Islet
poetry_tang_bd4687b2.summary: Clouds drift aimlessly over the islet, shifting in form. The poet uses this imagery to express his desire to avoid stagnation and reach greater heights.

poetry_tang_fc5a5d28.title: Mourning the River Hermit
poetry_tang_fc5a5d28.summary: Mourning the death of an old river hermit, the poet reflects on the transience of life. Through descriptions of abandoned tools, he expresses deep sorrow.

poetry_tang_fcbfd5b4.title: Yellow Crane Tower
poetry_tang_fcbfd5b4.summary: The poet gazes from the tower, lamenting the departed immortal amidst drifting clouds. At dusk, the misty river evokes a profound sense of homesickness.

poetry_tang_79bd8e92.title: Passing Through Huayin
poetry_tang_79bd8e92.summary: The poet depicts the majestic Mount Taihua, marveling at nature's craftsmanship. He advises fame-seekers to abandon their pursuits and seek immortality here instead.

poetry_tang_e51a24e3.title: Changgan Song I
poetry_tang_e51a24e3.summary: A woman stops her boat at Hengtang to ask a stranger where they live. Hoping to find a fellow villager, she reveals a simple, earnest expectation.

poetry_tang_2e0e29d3.title: Changgan Song II
poetry_tang_2e0e29d3.summary: Living by the Jiujiang River, a woman encounters travelers. Though both are from Changgan, they are strangers, creating a sense of gentle detachment.

poetry_tang_920e39ac.title: Miscellaneous Song: Changgan I
poetry_tang_920e39ac.summary: A woman stops her boat at Hengtang to ask if a stranger is a fellow villager. The poem captures the proactive and candid nature of a river-town woman.

poetry_tang_19307cb6.title: Miscellaneous Song: Changgan II
poetry_tang_19307cb6.summary: Living by the Jiujiang, a woman crosses paths with travelers. Despite sharing a hometown, their lack of acquaintance highlights the mystery of fate.

poetry_tang_a2225bce.title: Transverse Flute Song: Chang'an Road
poetry_tang_a2225bce.summary: The poem depicts the fleeting glory of Chang'an elites, warning against greed for power. Wealth is transient and eventually fades like cold ashes.

poetry_tang_6703614e.title: Matching Song: Meeting Each Other
poetry_tang_6703614e.summary: A woman proudly boasts of her family's high status and immense wealth. She remains immersed in the luxury and endless joy of palace life.

poetry_tang_1a531e2c.title: Qin Song: General Huo
poetry_tang_1a531e2c.summary: The poem depicts a general's bustling residence, then turns to warn that power is fleeting. It leaves a sense of detachment regarding worldly success.

poetry_tang_9ddbd6ae.title: Misc Song: Weicheng Youth
poetry_tang_9ddbd6ae.summary: The poem captures the vibrant spring in Chang'an and the hedonistic lifestyle of wealthy youths. It evokes a festive, carefree atmosphere of indulgence.

poetry_tang_df7da225.title: Misc Song: Wanderer
poetry_tang_df7da225.summary: A young warrior displays courage and martial skill on the battlefield. The poem leaves a feeling of heroic pride and adventurous spirit.

poetry_tang_3da14585.title: Misc Song: Hard Road
poetry_tang_3da14585.summary: Flowers bloom in the palace but are scattered by the wind, mirroring the fading beauty and favor of court ladies. It leaves a melancholic tone.

poetry_tang_ff084de8.title: Misc Song: Changgan, Pt. 3
poetry_tang_ff084de8.summary: As lotus boats vanish amidst the waves, a woman returns alone against the tide. It leaves a poignant sense of loneliness and longing.

poetry_tang_c0174827.title: Misc Song: Changgan, Pt. 4
poetry_tang_c0174827.summary: Amidst surging tides and winds, the poet compares the lotus to a light, resilient spirit. It leaves a feeling of bold, carefree optimism.

poetry_tang_8391371b.title: Misc Song: Maiden Lu
poetry_tang_8391371b.summary: In the warmth of spring, Lady Lu prepares to perform for the king. The poem creates an atmosphere of refined, quiet anticipation.

poetry_tang_1e68ed51.title: Misc Song: Lady Lu
poetry_tang_1e68ed51.summary: Lady Lu enjoys a life of luxury and favor in the prince's mansion. It leaves a vivid impression of worldly splendor and sudden elevation.

poetry_tang_159bbb09.title: Old Wanderer to Generals
poetry_tang_159bbb09.summary: A young warrior returns from the battlefield with pride and glory. The poem depicts his heroic military life, evoking a sense of bold ambition.

poetry_tang_e137495c.title: To General Qingche
poetry_tang_e137495c.summary: A friend returns from afar, leading to a heartfelt reunion over wine. It reflects on the pain of separation and war, ending in warm camaraderie.

poetry_tang_36c81e09.title: To Wang Weigu
poetry_tang_36c81e09.summary: A frontier general leaves a hunt to repel invaders. The poem highlights his swift duty to the nation, leaving a feeling of heroic resolve.

poetry_tang_2be8600b.title: To Master Huaiyi
poetry_tang_2be8600b.summary: Master Huaiyi preaches at court before traveling to enlighten the masses. It honors his Buddhist devotion, leaving a sense of spiritual reverence.

poetry_tang_e992b331.title: Visiting Tianzhu Temple
poetry_tang_e992b331.summary: Climbing Tianzhu Mountain at dawn, the poet finds clarity amidst the serene landscape. The beauty of nature purifies his mind, leaving a sense of detachment.

poetry_tang_7fad8921.title: Entering Ruoye Stream
poetry_tang_7fad8921.summary: A light boat glides into a tranquil, misty forest. Immersed in the quiet scenery, the poet finds a feeling of profound, leisurely peace.

poetry_tang_87229949.title: Miscellaneous Poem
poetry_tang_87229949.summary: A beautiful woman adorns herself before a mirror in the spring. The poem captures her delicate charm, leaving a bright and gentle impression.

poetry_tang_b1fe5013.title: Jailing in Dingxiang
poetry_tang_b1fe5013.summary: The poet resolves local disputes, allowing the people to return to farming. It recounts his fair governance, leaving a sense of civic satisfaction.

poetry_tang_5538fbfa.title: Road to Chang'an
poetry_tang_5538fbfa.summary: The poem depicts the luxury and snobbery of Chang'an elites, then turns to lament the impermanence of wealth. Observing with detachment, the poet leaves a sense of existential emptiness.

poetry_tang_27520f6a.title: Hard Road
poetry_tang_27520f6a.summary: Using the rise and fall of a palace maid, the poem laments the fleeting spring and the pain of longing. It shifts from past joy in plucking flowers to present lonely yearning, evoking deep melancholy.

poetry_tang_e73f05b9.title: Mengmen Journey
poetry_tang_e73f05b9.summary: Using the oriole and slander as metaphors, the poem reveals the difficulty of maintaining integrity. It shifts from festive joy to warning against sycophants, leaving a sense of anxiety regarding worldly malice.

poetry_tang_2d497311.title: Weicheng Youth
poetry_tang_2d497311.summary: The poem depicts the bustling spring in Chang'an, then shifts to the traveler's loneliness. Amidst the lively markets and music, a subtle sorrow for home emerges.

poetry_tang_1d776728.title: Lady Lu
poetry_tang_1d776728.summary: The poem describes Lady Lu's luxurious life in the Prince of Wei's mansion, shifting to praise her favored status. Through opulent imagery, it leaves a sense of envy for such high-born privilege.

poetry_tang_ae7ffe31.title: Riverside Old Man's Sorrow
poetry_tang_ae7ffe31.summary: An old man recounts his family's tragic decline, contrasting it with the arrogance of youth. The shift of eras leaves a profound sense of sorrow over life's unpredictability.

poetry_tang_a2098da1.title: Handan Palace Maid's Lament
poetry_tang_a2098da1.summary: A palace maid recounts her journey from favor to abandonment, lamenting that glory is a dream. From past golden-house splendor to present autumnal decay, it leaves a sigh for fate's instability.

poetry_tang_94b0241f.title: River Girl
poetry_tang_94b0241f.summary: The poem sketches a girl returning by boat in her evening makeup, then shifts to the anxiety of rising winds at dusk. Beneath the clear, beautiful scene lies the sorrow of traveling alone.

poetry_tang_6c3e6116.title: Yanmen Barbarian Song
poetry_tang_6c3e6116.summary: It depicts the rugged frontier scenery of barbarians hunting. The peaceful absence of war leads to drunken leisure, leaving a relaxed mood.

poetry_tang_cddb659d.title: Woman's Reply to Youth
poetry_tang_cddb659d.summary: It portrays a neglected wife regretting her marriage to a knight-errant. Her anticipation shifts to silent sorrow, leaving a deep sense of loneliness.

poetry_tang_344a9ad1.title: Qixi Festival
poetry_tang_344a9ad1.summary: It depicts Qixi night scenes of women threading needles and palace maids lamenting. Contrasting earthly hopes with celestial separation, it leaves a lingering sorrow.

poetry_tang_a83c769b.title: Changmen Lament
poetry_tang_a83c769b.summary: It shows the desolate Changmen Palace of a fallen consort. From past favor to mossy solitude, it leaves an overwhelming sense of grief and desolation.

poetry_tang_def78d3d.title: Wang Family Young Woman
poetry_tang_def78d3d.summary: It portrays a young, pampered wife's carefree aristocratic life. Radiating youthful joy and innocence, it leaves a lively and charming impression.

poetry_tang_216e3d50.title: Watching Singer at Qi King's
poetry_tang_216e3d50.summary: It presents a warm spring scene of palace singers preparing to perform. Their meticulous adornment aims to please the monarch, leaving a brilliant impression.

poetry_tang_b31bdf31.title: Shangsi Festival
poetry_tang_b31bdf31.summary: It depicts the lively Chang'an crowds celebrating the Shangsi Festival by the water. The bustling festivities leave a vibrant, joyous holiday atmosphere.
