poetry_tang_4a05d3be.title: To Governor Zhang of Liangzhou
poetry_tang_4a05d3be.summary: It praises Governor Zhang for defending the frontier and serving the state. Expressing a steadfast loyalty, it leaves a deeply patriotic and respectful tone.

poetry_tang_9ebfa41d.title: To Lu Baxiang
poetry_tang_9ebfa41d.summary: The poet watches a friend depart, lamenting the distance. The sorrow of parting deepens as the letter remains unwritten.

poetry_tang_e446e7f0.title: Titled at Tong Pass Tower
poetry_tang_e446e7f0.summary: The poet views the majestic Tong Pass from a tower. Amidst the evening mist, a profound sense of homesickness arises.

poetry_tang_288ecf6c.title: Titled at Shen Yin Hou's Tower
poetry_tang_288ecf6c.summary: Ascending the ancient tower, the poet reflects on the past. Facing the moonlit river, he is filled with historical melancholy.

poetry_tang_dee639d4.title: Evening Entry to Bian River
poetry_tang_dee639d4.summary: Traveling north by boat, the destination nears. Amidst spring breezes and songs, the traveler's sorrow fades into a hopeful mood.

poetry_tang_382dd838.title: Departing Jinsha Village
poetry_tang_382dd838.summary: Drifting alone at year's end, the poet feels the biting cold. His haste to reach the destination highlights his weary journey.

poetry_tang_a6625d05.title: Farewell to Protector Pei
poetry_tang_a6625d05.summary: Bidding farewell to a friend heading to the frontier, the poet offers caution. Despite war concerns, he hopes for swift victory.

poetry_tang_481ab696.title: Written in Liaoxi
poetry_tang_481ab696.summary: Spring arrives late to the harsh frontier. The poet asks a messenger to convey the hardships and longing of border life home.

poetry_tang_8da81b14.title: To Palace Officials at Night
poetry_tang_8da81b14.summary: The palace night duty is solemn and bright with stars. Feeling inadequate, the poet admires his peers while feeling lonely.

poetry_tang_9ac705ed.title: Boat Journey to Shan
poetry_tang_9ac705ed.summary: The poet sails into Shan stream amidst endless mountains. It ends with longing for sages and regret over passing time.

poetry_tang_8b8b18b4.title: Clear Water Like a Mirror
poetry_tang_8b8b18b4.summary: The poem praises clear water as a moral mirror. It concludes with a firm resolve to uphold integrity and virtue.

poetry_tang_9b6af16d.title: Gazing at Jimen
poetry_tang_9b6af16d.summary: Gazing at the snowy frontier, the poet feels a sudden shock. He ends yearning to serve his country like a true hero.

poetry_tang_53943568.title: Lingering Snow on Zhongnan
poetry_tang_53943568.summary: Lingering snow floats atop Mount Zhongnan. The twilight brings growing cold to the city, leaving a crisp, serene scene.

poetry_tang_52a91baf.title: Ancient Tune I
poetry_tang_52a91baf.summary: This poem recalls King Fucha's excesses. It laments the fleeting beauty and the tragic equality of death in dust.

poetry_tang_a4455145.title: Ancient Tune II
poetry_tang_a4455145.summary: The poet seeks the Chu king at Wuchuan. Meeting a goddess in a dream who vanishes as morning clouds, he feels a lingering sorrow.

poetry_tang_d9f73d4e.title: Crossing Huai River to Pei Yi
poetry_tang_d9f73d4e.summary: Crossing the Huai River, the poet sees turbulent waves and hazy shores. The dense trees evoke a bleak, solitary mood.

poetry_tang_0b7adf1e.title: Farewell at Rufun Mountain Villa
poetry_tang_0b7adf1e.summary: Leaving for his rural villa, the poet bids farewell to a friend. He concludes with deep gratitude and lingering bonds of friendship.

poetry_tang_3b21263c.title: Evening Stop at Putian Inn
poetry_tang_3b21263c.summary: The poet travels through Zheng, weary amidst sunset and village smoke. Despite the fatigue, he pushes on at night, feeling a sense of lonesome urgency.

poetry_tang_9bd26e3f.title: Farm Life
poetry_tang_9bd26e3f.summary: Living in seclusion at Donggao, the poet delights in the rustic scenery. He finds inner peace here, savoring the joys of nature and a reclusive life.

poetry_tang_e496eadb.title: Escorting at Yusu Pond
poetry_tang_e496eadb.summary: Escorting the emperor to the capital, the poet observes the strict imperial guard. Amidst the grand surroundings, he remains deeply nostalgic for the imperial court.

poetry_tang_58dedde6.title: Gift to Miao Fa
poetry_tang_58dedde6.summary: The rain-washed mountains are serene, filled with the sounds of cranes and cicadas. Despite his illness, the poet cherishes the chance to accompany his friend.

poetry_tang_9af73c3a.title: Reply to Wang Wei's Invitation
poetry_tang_9af73c3a.summary: Meeting after years, the joy of reunion is shadowed by the prospect of parting. Their silent understanding speaks volumes, transcending the need for words.

poetry_tang_9366a5bc.title: Farewell at Changle Post
poetry_tang_9366a5bc.summary: Parting at the post station, the poet is overcome with sorrow. He laments the hardships of his official career, yet accepts the farewell with resignation.

poetry_tang_00a3f2a7.title: Seeing Liu Gaoyou Off
poetry_tang_00a3f2a7.summary: Seeing a friend off to the capital, the river echoes with mournful songs. As autumn deepens, the rising tide stirs a profound sense of parting sorrow.

poetry_tang_83f769cd.title: Feast at Prince Wu's Residence
poetry_tang_83f769cd.summary: A lively banquet unfolds at Prince Wu's residence amidst spring. Guests enjoy the bamboo breeze and fine wine, wishing the night's revelry would never end.

poetry_tang_b5580d65.title: Viewing Mount Hua
poetry_tang_b5580d65.summary: The poet gazes at the majestic Mount Hua amidst clouds and pines. It leaves a feeling of awe and wonder.

poetry_tang_6c56968a.title: Feng Shijun's South Tower
poetry_tang_6c56968a.summary: The poet views the evening waters, troubled by winds hindering his return. It leaves a deep sense of homesickness.

poetry_tang_726565ac.title: Su Family Villa
poetry_tang_726565ac.summary: The poet retreats to a serene villa embraced by nature. It leaves a feeling of tranquil detachment from the world.

poetry_tang_2612443d.title: Rufun Separate Villa
poetry_tang_2612443d.summary: The poet farms in seclusion at Rufun, surrounded by simple nature. It leaves a quiet, melancholy yet peaceful mood.

poetry_tang_13f64186.title: Luhun Water Pavilion
poetry_tang_13f64186.summary: The poet enjoys the bright, tranquil post-rain scenery by the pavilion. It leaves a lingering sense of serene peace.

poetry_tang_395893cc.title: Passing Zheng
poetry_tang_395893cc.summary: The poet sails through Zheng amidst autumn mist and night sounds. It leaves a cool, lonely traveler's melancholy.

poetry_tang_13bcde88.title: Overnight at Chenliu
poetry_tang_13bcde88.summary: The poet spends a restless night listening to autumn rain and drums. It leaves a profound sense of traveler's sorrow.

poetry_tang_44986256.title: Inscription for Han's Pavilion
poetry_tang_44986256.summary: The poet admires the secluded water pavilion amidst bustling life. It leaves a feeling of detachment and quiet joy.

poetry_tang_c9867f77.title: Inscription for Yuan's Platform
poetry_tang_c9867f77.summary: The poem depicts a secluded, quiet monastery. Through the contrast of nature's stillness and movement, it conveys a profound sense of detachment from the world.

poetry_tang_cfb777a0.title: Meeting Miao Fa at Zhongfeng
poetry_tang_cfb777a0.summary: Living in seclusion at Zhongfeng, the poet unexpectedly meets a friend. The mountain filled with stars and moonlight highlights a complex feeling of solitude mixed with joy.

poetry_tang_ec578878.title: Southern Journey Feelings
poetry_tang_ec578878.summary: Traveling in the south, the poet gazes at mountains and misses home, lamenting the long journey back. Facing the desolate autumn scene, he expresses a melancholy sense of displacement.

poetry_tang_fdb783e2.title: Anchoring at Yangzhou Ferry
poetry_tang_fdb783e2.summary: Anchoring at Yangzhou, the poet observes river lights and sails. The encroaching chill of the autumn night evokes a deep, lingering longing for his distant home.

poetry_tang_92c50ff2.title: Evening Anchor at Jinling Pavilion
poetry_tang_92c50ff2.summary: Jinling's ancient ruins appear desolate in the autumn light, prompting the poet to reflect on the past. Facing the cold tide, he feels the weight of historical transience.

poetry_tang_5d430803.title: Qixi Festival
poetry_tang_5d430803.summary: Young women thread needles on the Qixi Festival, creating a lively atmosphere. Through delicate observation, the poet captures the innocent and hopeful spirit of the holiday.

poetry_tang_9af8130d.title: Night Sit at Home to Guo Wei
poetry_tang_9af8130d.summary: On a quiet night after rain, the poet sits alone thinking of a friend. The cold moonlight and bamboo shadows highlight his loneliness and frustration at being unrecognized.

poetry_tang_703bcf34.title: Replying to Li Biejia's Gift
poetry_tang_703bcf34.summary: The poet laments the hardships of travel but finds comfort in a friend's hospitality. The poem is filled with gratitude and highlights the depth of their bond.

poetry_tang_f43110d9.title: Qingming Feast at Liu's Villa
poetry_tang_f43110d9.summary: The poet enjoys a spring feast at a villa, surrounded by lush, serene scenery. This idyllic atmosphere evokes a deep desire for reclusion.

poetry_tang_c29fb7ce.title: Rufun Autumn Hearing Oriole
poetry_tang_c29fb7ce.summary: Hearing an oriole in autumn, the poet reflects on his lonely life. The bird's eventual flight leaves him with a lingering sense of melancholy.

poetry_tang_cbd21f6f.title: Seeing Qiu Wei Off
poetry_tang_cbd21f6f.summary: After his friend fails the exam, the poet laments the lack of recognition for talent. The spring scenery prompts a shared desire to retire.

poetry_tang_ea3c1ba6.title: To Wang Changshi
poetry_tang_ea3c1ba6.summary: In the quiet mountains, the poet misses his old friend, finding only orchids by the fence. The solitude highlights his profound longing.

poetry_tang_63d575a7.title: Parting Regret
poetry_tang_63d575a7.summary: At the ferry, the poet lingers mid-stream, unable to turn back. The scene captures a poignant, reluctant moment of parting.

poetry_tang_7807fa1d.title: Chanting at Ministry Gate
poetry_tang_7807fa1d.summary: Chanting at the ministry gate, the poet laments the coldness of official life. The withered plants mirror his own inner desolation.

poetry_tang_24b52719.title: Visiting Heshan Temple
poetry_tang_24b52719.summary: Visiting the ancient temple, the poet reflects on the sage's legacy. Despite the ruin, the site inspires reverence for his enduring wisdom.

poetry_tang_e77275fe.title: Lines
poetry_tang_e77275fe.summary: Resting his chin on his hand, the official smiles while wearing his court cap. This line captures a brief, relaxed moment of his life.
